zh.tag: 纯 C 零依赖引擎，把 744B~2.8T MoE 大模型跑在消费级硬件上
zh.what: Colibrì 是一个纯 C 编写、零引擎依赖的 MoE 推理引擎，把显存、内存和磁盘当作统一的多级推理层级，让 744B 到 2.8T 参数的前沿 MoE 模型能在消费级与异构硬件上运行。它同时是开放研究平台，追求推理侧软硬件边界的性能优化，并承诺绝不悄悄改变模型精度或路由语义。
zh.content: 仓库包含每个模型家族一个 C 文件的实现（GLM-5.x、Kimi K3、DeepSeek V4.x、Qwen3.x、OLMoE 等九大家族），统一的 coli chat / coli serve / coli web 前端，以及带实时指标、专家分层和“大脑”可视化的 Web 仪表盘。
zh.stack: 纯 C 实现，零引擎依赖，专家权重从磁盘流式加载；支持 int4 量化，可在 CPU 与多卡 GPU（如 6× RTX 5090）混合环境中运行。
zh.hot: 它以“小引擎跑超大模型”的极简路线直击显存焦虑，29840 颗星、今日 +868 登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，说明本地跑前沿大模型的需求极其旺盛。
uses: 想在本地或自有硬件上跑 744B+ MoE 大模型的个人与实验室研究者
关注推理引擎、内存分层、存储 I/O 与 CPU/GPU 重叠等系统优化的工程师
需要在消费级 GPU 或异构集群上低成本部署大模型的团队
对量化、专家流式加载与投机解码等前沿推理技术感兴趣的学习者

en.tag: Pure C, zero-dep engine running 744B–2.8T MoE models on consumer hardware
en.what: Colibrì is a pure-C, zero-dependency MoE inference engine that treats VRAM, RAM and storage as one multitier hierarchy, letting frontier 744B–2.8T-parameter MoE models run on consumer and heterogeneous hardware. It doubles as an open research platform for inference-side performance across the software/hardware boundary, with a hard guarantee that it never silently changes model precision or router semantics.
en.content: It ships one C file per model family (GLM-5.x, Kimi K3, DeepSeek V4.x, Qwen3.x, OLMoE and more — nine families), a unified coli chat / coli serve / coli web front end, and a web dashboard with live metrics, expert tiers and a 'brain' visualization.
en.stack: Written in pure C with zero engine dependencies, streaming experts from disk; supports int4 quantization and runs across CPU plus multi-GPU setups such as 6× RTX 5090.
en.hot: Its 'tiny engine, immense model' approach directly addresses VRAM anxiety; with 29,840 stars and +868 today it tops GitHub Trending, showing huge demand for running frontier models locally.
uses: Individuals and labs wanting to run 744B+ MoE models on hardware they already own
Engineers working on inference engines, memory tiering, storage I/O and CPU/GPU overlap
Teams needing low-cost deployment of large models on consumer GPUs or heterogeneous clusters
Learners curious about quantization, expert streaming and speculative decoding

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.

zh.tag: 自主AI渗透测试代理系统
zh.what: PentAGI 是一个全自主的 AI 代理系统，能够执行复杂的渗透测试任务。它利用先进的人工智能技术，为信息安全专业人员、研究人员和爱好者提供强大且灵活的安全测试解决方案。

zh.tag: 符号规划驱动的开源音乐生成模型，支持零样本翻唱与智能体编辑
zh.what: YuE2 是一个前沿级音乐生成模型：输入歌词和风格提示，它先写出旋律与和弦的符号化编曲方案，再渲染成带人声与伴奏的完整歌曲。它支持零样本翻唱和通过对话式智能体对乐谱、编曲、歌词进行编辑。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 推理与训练代码、快速开始脚本、Agent skill 集成、基准评测文档（docs/benchmarks.md）以及演示素材；模型权重 YuE2-3B、MERT2、SheetSage2 与 WildSongBench 数据集托管在 Hugging Face，原 YuE 代码保留在 YuE-v1 分支。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，围绕 PyTorch 深度学习栈构建，依赖 Hugging Face 模型与数据集生态，并提供 Agent skill 接口用于智能体调用。
zh.hot: YuE2 在 WildSongBench 上 best-of-8 达到 6.9632 SongBench 均分，号称可与 Suno v5/v6 竞争，加上符号化可编辑与智能体编辑的新玩法，今日新增 210 star、总数 7298 并登上 GitHub 日榜第 14 名。

en.tag: Open-source music generation with symbolic planning, zero-shot covers, and agentic editing
en.what: YuE2 is a frontier-quality music generation model: given lyrics and a style prompt, it first writes a symbolic melody-and-chord plan, then renders it into a full song with vocals and accompaniment. It supports zero-shot covers and conversational agentic editing of score, arrangement, and lyrics.
en.content: The repo contains Python inference and training code, quick-start scripts, an Agent skill integration, benchmark docs (docs/benchmarks.md), and demo assets; model weights YuE2-3B, MERT2, SheetSage2, and the WildSongBench dataset live on Hugging Face, while the original YuE code is preserved on the YuE-v1 branch.
en.stack: Primarily Python built on the PyTorch deep learning stack, relying on the Hugging Face model and dataset ecosystem, and exposing an Agent skill interface for agent integration.
en.hot: YuE2 claims a best-of-8 score of 6.9632 SongBench Avg on WildSongBench, competitive with Suno v5/v6, plus novel symbolic editability and agentic editing; it gained 210 stars today for a total of 7,298, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Music creators and producers — quickly generate editable full-song demos from lyrics and style prompts
AI researchers and engineers — study a frontier model unifying symbolic planning and audio generation
Agent developers — integrate music generation and editing into automated workflows via the Agent skill
Cover and remix enthusiasts — do zero-shot style covers and conversational refinement of existing recordings

zh.tag: 面向 Android TV 的开源媒体客户端，可自定义浏览与播放规则
zh.what: SmartTube 是一个免费开源的 Android TV/电视盒子媒体客户端，让用户在电视优化界面中浏览和播放来自多个公共源的内容。它支持 SponsorBlock、8K、60fps、HDR 等高级播放特性，且不依赖 Google 服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Android 应用源码（Java 为主），以及截图、安装徽章、FAQ、构建说明和更新日志等文档，发布包通过 GitHub Releases 和 F-Droid 分发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Java 开发，基于 Android TV 框架，不依赖 Google 服务，集成 SponsorBlock 等第三方功能。
zh.hot: 凭借 33,216 颗星和今日新增 136 星登上 GitHub 日榜第 9，因其在电视端提供无广告、可定制的媒体播放体验而广受欢迎。
uses: Android TV 或电视盒子用户，希望获得更自由、可定制的媒体浏览与播放体验
想避开官方客户端广告和限制、需要 SponsorBlock 等增强功能的观众
开发者或爱好者，希望研究 Android TV 应用开发或自行构建修改版本

en.tag: Open-source media client for Android TV with customizable browsing and playback rules
en.what: SmartTube is a free and open-source media client for Android TVs and TV boxes, letting users browse and play content from various public sources in a TV-optimized interface. It supports SponsorBlock, 8K, 60fps, HDR, and works without Google Services.
en.content: The repo contains the Android app source (mostly Java), along with screenshots, install badges, FAQ, build instructions, and changelog; releases are distributed via GitHub Releases and F-Droid.
en.stack: Primarily Java-based, built on the Android TV framework, independent of Google Services, and integrates third-party features like SponsorBlock.
en.hot: With 33,216 stars and 136 added today, it ranks 9th on GitHub Trending daily, popular for delivering an ad-free, customizable media playback experience on TV.
uses: Android TV or TV box users seeking a freer, customizable media browsing and playback experience
Viewers who want to avoid official client ads and restrictions, and need enhancements like SponsorBlock
Developers or enthusiasts interested in Android TV app development or building modified versions

zh.tag: 本地优先的并行科研智能体工作台
zh.what: OpenResearch 把 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 等编码智能体改造成科研助手，可自动做文献综述、提出假设、跑实验并产出研究产物。它支持多个智能体并行探索不同研究方向，并用 git 原生实验树记录每次运行的不可变快照。
zh.content: 仓库提供桌面应用与 CLI（orx），包含本地仪表盘、实验树管理、技能安装（orx install-skills）以及远程/集群运行支持，另附本地模型接入文档。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，提供 macOS/Linux 安装脚本，可对接 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode 及 LM Studio、Ollama 等本地模型端点。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获约 990 星、单日新增 210 星并登上 Rust 日榜第 3，契合了「让编码智能体自动做科研」这一热门方向。
uses: 想用 AI 智能体自动化文献调研与实验迭代的研究者
需要并行探索多个技术方向并保证实验可复现的工程团队
希望在本地或自有 GPU 集群上运行智能体、掌控数据的开发者
想把 Claude Code、Codex 等编码智能体接入科研工作流的 AI 工具爱好者

en.tag: Local-first workspace for parallel research agents
en.what: OpenResearch turns coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode into research agents that can review literature, form hypotheses, run experiments, and produce research artifacts. It lets multiple agents explore directions in parallel while a git-native experiment tree preserves each run's immutable snapshot.
en.content: The repo ships a desktop app plus an orx CLI, including a local dashboard, experiment-tree management, skill installation (orx install-skills), and remote/cluster execution support, along with docs for connecting local models.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it offers macOS/Linux install scripts and integrates with Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, plus local model endpoints like LM Studio and Ollama.
en.hot: It quickly reached ~990 stars with 210 added in a day and ranked #3 on the Rust daily trending list, riding the hot wave of using coding agents for automated research.
uses: Researchers who want AI agents to automate literature review and experiment iteration
Engineering teams needing parallel exploration with reproducible experiments
Developers who want to run agents locally or on their own GPU clusters while owning their data
AI tooling enthusiasts looking to plug Claude Code, Codex, and similar agents into research workflows

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 为 Claude 打造的红队攻防技能库，78 个 SKILL.md 即插即用
zh.what: claude-red 是面向 Claude Skills 系统的攻击性安全技能库，每个技能都是一份结构化的 SKILL.md，把 Claude 武装成特定攻击面的专家。覆盖从 SQL 注入、shellcode 到 EDR 绕过、ADCS 滥用等场景，按对话触发词按需加载。
zh.content: 仓库包含 78 个技能、23 个分类，按 Web 应用、认证与身份、Active Directory、无线等目录组织，附安装脚本、技能索引与路线图。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，核心产物是 Markdown 格式的 SKILL.md；通过 git clone 或 sparse-checkout 装入 ~/.claude/skills，也可用 claude --system-file 注入。
zh.hot: 上线不久即收获 3602 星、今日新增 113 星并登上日榜第 13，踩中 Claude Skills 生态与红队自动化的双重热点。
uses: 授权红队与渗透测试人员，快速获得专家级攻击方法论
漏洞赏金猎人与安全研究者，用于漏洞分类与攻击面梳理
CTF 选手与安全学员，作为系统化的攻防训练参考
安全团队评估 AI 辅助攻防能力的实验场景

en.tag: Offensive security skill library for Claude — 78 drop-in SKILL.md files
en.what: claude-red is a curated offensive security skill library for the Claude Skills system. Each skill is a structured SKILL.md that primes Claude with expert-level methodology for a specific attack surface, from SQL injection and shellcode to EDR evasion and ADCS abuse, loading on demand via conversational triggers.
en.content: The repo ships 78 skills across 23 categories, organized into directories like Web Application, Auth & Identity, Active Directory and Wireless, plus an install script, skill index and roadmap.
en.stack: Primarily Python with Markdown-based SKILL.md files as the core artifact; installed via git clone or sparse-checkout into ~/.claude/skills, or piped through claude --system-file.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 3,602 stars with 113 added today, ranking 13th on the daily trending list, riding both the Claude Skills ecosystem and red-team automation hype.
uses: Authorized red teamers and pentesters seeking expert-level attack methodology
Bug bounty hunters and security researchers triaging vulnerabilities and mapping attack surfaces
CTF players and security learners wanting structured offensive training material
Security teams evaluating AI-assisted offensive capabilities in lab settings

zh.tag: 阿里内部验证的混合架构 AI 代码审查 CLI 工具
zh.what: Open Code Review 是阿里巴巴内部孵化并开源的 AI 代码审查命令行工具，采用确定性流水线加 LLM Agent 的混合架构。它能在代码行级别给出精确评论，并内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则集。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 编写，提供 CLI 主程序、内置规则集与 Agent 集成配置，并附带官网、多语言 README 与 npm 包发布脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 @alibaba-group/open-code-review 分发，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 接口，并支持 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent。
zh.hot: 背靠阿里内部两年、数万开发者与数百万缺陷的实战验证，加上 22734 星、今日新增 264 星并登上 Go 日榜第 11 名，关注度持续攀升。
uses: 希望把 AI 代码审查接入 CI/CD 的工程团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 Agent 的开发者
需要 NPE、线程安全、SQL 注入等规则检查的 Go/多语言项目
想借鉴混合架构与规则集设计的 AI 工具开发者

en.tag: Alibaba's battle-tested hybrid-architecture AI code review CLI
en.what: Open Code Review is an open-sourced AI code review CLI incubated inside Alibaba, combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent. It produces precise line-level comments and ships with a built-in multi-language ruleset covering NPE, thread-safety, XSS and SQL injection.
en.content: Written in Go, the repo contains the CLI, built-in rule sets and agent integration configs, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and npm publishing setup.
en.stack: Primary language is Go, distributed via the npm package @alibaba-group/open-code-review, compatible with OpenAI and Anthropic APIs, and integrates with Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.
en.hot: Backed by two years of internal Alibaba use by tens of thousands of developers and millions of defects found, it has reached 22,734 stars with 264 added today, ranking 11th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Engineering teams wanting AI code review in CI/CD
Developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor agents
Go and multi-language projects needing NPE, thread-safety and SQL injection checks
AI tool builders studying hybrid architecture and ruleset design

zh.tag: 专为数学建模打造的自动化 Agent，一键生成可提交论文
zh.what: MathModelAgent 是一个面向数学建模竞赛的 AI Agent，能够自动完成从问题分析、建模、编码、绘图到论文撰写的全流程，最终生成一份格式规范、可直接提交的完整论文。它支持多 Agent 协作与多模型配置，并内置人机协作与容错机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面版安装包（macOS/Windows）、SKILLS 驱动的核心逻辑、17 套 Typst 论文模板、内置建模知识库与 RAG 检索模块，以及 Web 搜索、代码解释器等组件。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 开发，使用 litellm 接入多种大模型，支持 Jupyter 本地代码解释器及 E2B、Daytona 云端解释器，结合 ChromaDB 与 Rerank 实现 RAG，并采用 Typst 排版论文。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 129 星，总星数达 4858，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名。其“3 天比赛变 1 小时”的愿景和开箱即用的桌面版极大降低了数学建模门槛，吸引了大量学生与研究者关注。
uses: 参加数学建模竞赛的学生，可快速生成完整论文初稿
需要自动化建模与论文撰写的科研人员或工程师
希望学习数学建模流程与最佳实践的初学者
需要批量处理建模任务并集成自定义模板的团队

en.tag: An agent that automates mathematical modeling and generates submission-ready papers
en.what: MathModelAgent is an AI agent for mathematical modeling competitions that automates the entire workflow—problem analysis, modeling, coding, plotting, and paper writing—to produce a complete, submission-ready paper. It supports multi-agent collaboration, multi-LLM configuration, and includes human-in-the-loop and fault-tolerance mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes desktop installers (macOS/Windows), SKILLS-driven core logic, 17 Typst paper templates, a built-in modeling knowledge base with RAG retrieval, plus web search and code interpreter components.
en.stack: Built in Python, it uses litellm for multi-LLM support, Jupyter local and E2B/Daytona cloud code interpreters, ChromaDB with Rerank for RAG, and Typst for paper typesetting.
en.hot: It gained 129 stars today, reaching 4,858 total and ranking #11 on GitHub Trending daily. Its vision of turning a 3-day competition into 1 hour and the out-of-the-box desktop version greatly lower the barrier to mathematical modeling, attracting many students and researchers.
uses: Students in math modeling competitions who need a complete paper draft quickly
Researchers or engineers seeking automated modeling and paper writing
Beginners wanting to learn the modeling workflow and best practices
Teams needing to batch-process modeling tasks with custom templates

zh.tag: 一站式下载器：课程、视频、音乐、书籍，无需命令行
zh.what: OmniGet 是一款免费开源的桌面应用，支持从 Udemy、Hotmart、YouTube 等 1800+ 网站下载课程、视频、音乐和电子书。内置播放器、PDF/EPUB 阅读器和音乐库，所有文件保存在本地，无需命令行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 后端、Svelte/Tauri 前端、桌面安装包及多语言 README。提供图形界面、快捷键下载、内置播放器等功能，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 和 Tauri 构建，使用 Svelte 作为前端框架，依赖 yt-dlp 进行下载。
zh.hot: 今日新增 102 星，总星数达 9480，在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）排名第 10。其精准的 SEO 标签策略使其在多个下载器细分领域（如课程下载、YouTube 下载）中排名第一，吸引了大量用户。
uses: 在线学习者：需要下载 Udemy、Hotmart 等平台的付费课程以便离线观看。
内容创作者：希望保存 YouTube、TikTok 等平台的视频素材用于二次创作。
音乐与书籍爱好者：想要下载音乐和电子书并在应用内管理阅读。
技术小白：希望无需命令行即可轻松下载网络资源。

en.tag: All-in-one downloader for courses, videos, music & books — no terminal needed
en.what: OmniGet is a free, open-source desktop app that downloads courses, videos, music, and books from 1,800+ sites including Udemy, Hotmart, and YouTube. It features a built-in player, PDF/EPUB reader, and music library, keeping all files on your computer with no terminal required.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust backend, Svelte/Tauri frontend, desktop installers, and multilingual READMEs. It offers a GUI, hotkey downloads, built-in player, and supports Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri, using Svelte for the frontend, and powered by yt-dlp for downloads.
en.hot: Gained 102 stars today, reaching 9,480 total, ranking #10 on GitHub Trending (Rust) daily. Its strategic SEO tagging makes it #1 in niche downloader categories (e.g., course-downloader, youtube-downloader), driving significant attention.
uses: Online learners who need to download paid courses from Udemy, Hotmart, etc. for offline viewing.
Content creators who want to save videos from YouTube, TikTok, etc. for remixing or reference.
Music and book enthusiasts who wish to download media and manage them within the app.
Non-technical users who prefer a GUI over command-line tools for downloading online content.

zh.tag: 抖音批量下载工具，去水印，支持视频、图集、合集与音乐
zh.what: 这是一个抖音内容批量下载工具，支持单条链接下载和作者主页批量抓取，可保存视频、图集、合集、收藏夹以及原声音乐。内置进度显示、失败重试、SQLite 去重和下载完整性校验，并提供浏览器回退方案应对反爬。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 脚本为主体，包含中英文 README、命令行入口与配置示例，另有基于同一后端的桌面 GUI「Douzy」截图与 Releases 构建，覆盖抖音、TikTok、YouTube 三个平台的工作区。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 编写，依赖 requests 等 HTTP 库与 SQLite 做去重记录，并通过浏览器回退机制处理登录与风控；桌面端为同一后端的 GUI 封装。
zh.hot: 抖音内容存档需求旺盛，加上去水印与批量下载的实用定位，项目已积累 11363 颗星，今日新增 452 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 17 名。
uses: 需要批量备份自己或他人抖音作品的普通用户
做短视频素材收集与二次创作的内容创作者
研究爬虫、反爬与浏览器回退方案的技术学习者
希望本地归档抖音收藏、喜欢与合集的重度用户

en.tag: A practical Douyin batch downloader with watermark removal for videos, galleries, collections and music
en.what: This is a practical Douyin downloader that handles both single-item and profile batch downloads, saving videos, image-notes, collections, favorites and original music. It ships with progress display, retries, SQLite deduplication, download integrity checks and a browser fallback for anti-bot scenarios.
en.content: The repo centers on Python scripts with bilingual READMEs, a CLI entry point and config samples, plus screenshots and Releases builds for a desktop GUI called Douzy built on the same backend, covering Douyin, TikTok and YouTube workspaces.
en.stack: Written mainly in Python, it relies on HTTP libraries like requests plus SQLite for dedup records, and uses a browser fallback to handle login and risk control; the desktop app is a GUI wrapper over the same backend.
en.hot: Strong demand for archiving Douyin content plus its practical watermark-free batch downloading have pushed it to 11,363 stars, with 452 added today and a No.17 spot on the GitHub Trending daily list.
uses: Everyday users who want to batch back up their own or others' Douyin posts
Content creators collecting short-video material for remixing
Developers studying scraping, anti-bot and browser-fallback techniques
Heavy Douyin users archiving favorites, likes and collections locally

zh.tag: 复古 CRT 风格终端模拟器，主打怀旧视觉与可定制特效
zh.what: cool-retro-term 是一款终端模拟器，模拟老式阴极射线管屏幕的外观与质感。它追求视觉上的「好看」、可定制且相对轻量，支持 Linux 和 macOS。
zh.content: 仓库包含 QML 编写的界面与效果代码、基于 qmltermwidget 的终端组件，以及截图、构建说明和发布用的 AppImage/dmg 打包配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 QML，依赖 Qt6 和 qtermwidget 的 QML 移植版 qmltermwidget，支持 Linux 与 macOS。
zh.hot: 凭借独特的复古 CRT 视觉风格和 26k+ stars 的长期人气，今日再登 GitHub 日榜第 18 名，新增 57 星。
uses: 喜欢复古终端外观、想让命令行界面更有氛围感的开发者
需要录制演示视频或截图、追求视觉效果的极客用户
在 Linux 或 macOS 上寻找轻量且可定制终端模拟器的用户

en.tag: A retro CRT-style terminal emulator focused on nostalgic visuals and customizable effects
en.what: cool-retro-term is a terminal emulator that mimics the look and feel of old cathode tube screens. It is designed to be eye-candy, customizable, and reasonably lightweight, running on Linux and macOS.
en.content: The repo contains QML-based UI and effect code, a terminal widget built on qmltermwidget, plus screenshots, build instructions, and packaging for AppImage/dmg releases.
en.stack: Primarily QML, depending on Qt6 and the QML port of qtermwidget (qmltermwidget), supporting Linux and macOS.
en.hot: With its unique retro CRT visual style and long-standing popularity of 26k+ stars, it re-entered GitHub's daily trending at #18 today with 57 new stars.
uses: Developers who love retro terminal aesthetics and want a more atmospheric CLI
Geeks recording demos or screenshots who care about visual flair
Users on Linux or macOS looking for a lightweight, customizable terminal emulator

zh.tag: 最主流的开源模型定义与训练推理框架
zh.what: Transformers 是 Hugging Face 推出的模型定义框架，统一了文本、视觉、音频和多模态的 SOTA 模型接口。它同时支持推理与训练，让用户用几行代码即可加载、微调和部署各类预训练模型。

zh.tag: 跨千余市场的开源自主 AI 交易代理，支持预测市场与加密合约
zh.what: Clodds 是一个自托管的个人 AI 交易终端，基于 Claude 驱动，可在预测市场、加密现货、永续合约、代币发行和 Bittensor 子网挖矿中自主扫描套利机会并即时执行。它还能通过自然对话管理投资组合，并内置机器对机器支付的代理商业协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 编写的交易代理核心、118+ 交易策略、21 个消息平台接入、WebChat 界面，以及覆盖 10 个预测市场和 7 个期货交易所的适配器。
zh.stack: 基于 Node.js 22+ 和 TypeScript 5.3，通过 npm 全局安装，依赖 Claude 模型，集成 Solana（Jupiter、Pump.fun、Raydium 等）与多条 EVM 链。
zh.hot: 上线 12 天即获 1647 星、今日新增 277 星，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 4，14 天内被克隆 10.7k 次，叠加 Colosseum 黑客松与加密交易热度。
uses: 加密交易者：希望用 AI 自动扫描预测市场与合约套利机会
开发者：想研究或二次开发自主交易代理与代理支付协议
量化爱好者：需要多交易所、多链的统一交易终端与策略库
自托管用户：重视隐私，想在自己机器上运行交易机器人

en.tag: Open-source autonomous AI trading agent across 1000+ prediction and crypto markets
en.what: Clodds is a self-hosted personal AI trading terminal powered by Claude that autonomously scans for edge and executes trades across prediction markets, crypto spot, perpetual futures, token launches, and Bittensor subnet mining. It also manages portfolios through natural conversation and ships an agent commerce protocol for machine-to-machine payments.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript trading agent core, 118+ trading strategies, integrations for 21 messaging platforms, a WebChat UI, and adapters covering 10 prediction markets and 7 futures exchanges.
en.stack: Built on Node.js 22+ and TypeScript 5.3, installed globally via npm, powered by Claude, with Solana (Jupiter, Pump.fun, Raydium, etc.) and multiple EVM chain integrations.
en.hot: It gained 1,647 stars in 12 days with 277 added today, ranking #4 on GitHub Trending, plus 10.7k clones in 14 days, fueled by the Colosseum hackathon and crypto trading hype.
uses: Crypto traders who want AI to auto-scan prediction markets and futures arbitrage
Developers researching or extending autonomous trading agents and agent payment protocols
Quant enthusiasts needing a unified multi-exchange, multi-chain trading terminal and strategy library
Self-hosting users who value privacy and want to run a trading bot on their own machine

zh.tag: 开源游戏启动器，一站式管理你的游戏库
zh.what: Hydra Launcher 是一个开源游戏平台，目标是成为管理游戏库所需的唯一工具。它支持添加自有游戏、云存档、成就解锁，并通过强大的推荐算法浏览丰富目录、发现新游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron + React 桌面客户端源码、Python 与 Rust 原生模块（hydra-native），以及构建脚本和文档截图。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Node.js（Electron、React、TypeScript）、Python 3.9+ 和 Rust，使用 Yarn 管理依赖，Rust 原生插件在 postinstall 时自动构建。
zh.hot: 凭借开源、跨平台且聚合多平台游戏库的定位，它已累积约 1.7 万 star，今日再增 18 星，稳居 GitHub TypeScript 日榜第 8。
uses: 想统一管理多平台游戏库的 PC 玩家
喜欢开源、可自建与二次开发的用户
需要云存档和成就追踪的休闲玩家
对 Electron + Rust 桌面应用感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Open-source game launcher to manage your entire gaming library in one place
en.what: Hydra Launcher is an open-source gaming platform designed to be the single tool you need to manage your gaming library. It lets you add owned games, sync saves to the cloud, unlock achievements, and browse a rich catalogue with a powerful suggestion algorithm.
en.content: The repo contains the Electron + React desktop client source, Python and Rust native modules (hydra-native), plus build scripts and documentation screenshots.
en.stack: Built with Node.js (Electron, React, TypeScript), Python 3.9+, and Rust; dependencies are managed via Yarn, and the Rust native addon builds automatically on postinstall.
en.hot: With its open-source, cross-platform, all-in-one game library approach, it has gathered ~16.9k stars, adding 18 today and ranking 8th on GitHub's TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: PC gamers who want a unified multi-platform game library
Users who prefer open-source, self-hostable, hackable tools
Casual players needing cloud saves and achievement tracking
Developers curious about Electron + Rust desktop apps

zh.tag: 跨平台 iOS 侧载工具，一键安装 SideStore 并导入配对文件
zh.what: iloader 是一款面向普通用户的 iOS 侧载工具，帮助你在电脑上给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 等应用。它会自动导入证书和 rppairing/lockdown 配对文件，并支持导入任意 IPA、管理配对文件与吊销开发证书。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 TypeScript 编写的桌面应用源码（含本地化文件 src/loc*）、构建工作流与发布配置，官网 iloader.app 是唯一官方下载渠道。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，桌面端应用，依赖 usbmuxd（Windows 需 iTunes，macOS 自带，Linux 视发行版而定），并提供 NixOS flake 与社区维护的 Homebrew/AUR/COPR 包。
zh.hot: iOS 侧载长期缺少好用的跨平台图形工具，iloader 把繁琐的配对与证书流程自动化，今日新增 50 star、总数 2908，冲上 GitHub 日榜第 3。
uses: 想给 iPhone/iPad 安装 SideStore 或任意 IPA 的普通 iOS 用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 上管理配对文件与开发证书的进阶玩家
希望本地化 iloader 到更多语言的翻译贡献者

en.tag: Cross-platform iOS sideloader that installs SideStore and imports pairing files with ease
en.what: iloader is a user-friendly iOS sideloading tool that helps you install SideStore and other apps onto your iPhone/iPad from a computer. It automatically imports certificates and rppairing/lockdown pairing files, and supports importing any IPA, managing pairing files, and revoking development certificates.
en.content: The repo contains the TypeScript desktop app source (including localization files under src/loc*), build workflows, and release configuration; iloader.app is the only official download channel.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript as a desktop app, it depends on usbmuxd (iTunes on Windows, built-in on macOS, distro-dependent on Linux), and ships a NixOS flake plus community-maintained Homebrew/AUR/COPR packages.
en.hot: iOS sideloading has long lacked a good cross-platform GUI tool; iloader automates the tedious pairing and certificate flow, gaining 50 stars today for a total of 2,908 and hitting #3 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Everyday iOS users who want to install SideStore or any IPA on their iPhone/iPad
Advanced users managing pairing files and development certificates on Windows/macOS/Linux
Translation contributors who want to localize iloader into more languages

zh.tag: 聚合34家免费LLM提供商的统一API网关
zh.what: FreeLLMAPI 是一个开源项目，将数十家免费 LLM 提供商的免费额度聚合到一个 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 端点后面。它提供智能路由、自动故障转移和加密密钥管理，让开发者无需管理多个 API 密钥即可访问大量免费模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 TypeScript 编写的 API 网关，支持 Docker 自托管、桌面应用（macOS/Windows）和 Android 应用。它提供了一个仪表板，用于监控每月 token 预算，并包含一个自动更新的模型目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，支持 Docker 部署，并提供桌面和移动端应用。依赖 OpenAI 兼容 API 标准，集成多个 LLM 提供商。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得近 2 万星标，日增 174 星。它解决了开发者对免费 LLM 资源分散、难以管理的痛点，提供了一站式解决方案。
uses: 个人开发者：快速集成多个免费 LLM，无需单独注册和付费。
原型开发：在项目初期使用免费模型验证想法，降低开发成本。
学习与研究：探索不同 LLM 的能力，进行对比实验。
自动化工具：为聊天机器人、内容生成等应用提供统一 API 接口。

en.tag: Unified API gateway aggregating 34 free LLM providers
en.what: FreeLLMAPI is an open-source project that aggregates free tiers from dozens of LLM providers behind a single OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. It offers smart routing, automatic failover, and encrypted key management, allowing developers to access a vast array of free models without managing multiple API keys.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based API gateway with Docker self-hosting, desktop apps for macOS/Windows, and an Android app. It includes a dashboard for monitoring monthly token budgets and an auto-updating model catalog.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, with Docker deployment and desktop/mobile apps. Relies on OpenAI-compatible API standards and integrates multiple LLM providers.
en.hot: The project has gained nearly 20k stars with 174 new stars today, addressing the pain point of scattered free LLM resources by offering a one-stop solution.
uses: Individual developers: Quickly integrate multiple free LLMs without separate registrations and payments.
Prototyping: Validate ideas with free models in early stages, reducing development costs.
Learning and research: Explore capabilities of different LLMs and run comparative experiments.
Automation tools: Provide a unified API for chatbots, content generation, and more.

zh.tag: 面向模型生成界面的开源标准与流式渲染框架
zh.what: OpenUI 是一套全栈、与渲染器无关的生成式 UI 框架，核心是紧凑、流式优先的 OpenUI Lang。它让模型输出不再只是文本，而是可边生成边渲染的结构化界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenUI Lang 语言规范、内置组件库（图表、表单、表格、布局）、从组件库生成提示词的机制，以及 React 流式渲染器和现成聊天界面。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主，官方支持 React，提供 CLI 脚手架（npx @openuidev/cli）和组件库，其他框架由社区集成支持。
zh.hot: 生成式 UI 是当下热门方向，OpenUI Lang 比 JSON 最多省 67% token，加上 MIT 开源与日增 85 star 冲上 TypeScript 日榜第 11。
uses: 想为 AI 助手或 Copilot 快速搭建流式生成界面的前端开发者
需要让模型输出图表、表单、表格等结构化 UI 的产品团队
希望用更省 token 的 DSL 替代 JSON 做模型输出协议的研究者
想基于开源标准扩展自定义组件库与渲染器的工程团队

en.tag: The open standard and streaming renderer for model-generated UI
en.what: OpenUI is a full-stack, renderer-agnostic Generative UI framework built around the compact, streaming-first OpenUI Lang. It turns model output from plain text into structured UI that renders progressively as tokens arrive.
en.content: The repo ships the OpenUI Lang spec, built-in component libraries (charts, forms, tables, layouts), prompt generation from your component library, plus a React streaming renderer and ready-to-use chat interfaces.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with official React support, a CLI scaffolder (npx @openuidev/cli) and component libraries, while other frameworks are covered by community integrations.
en.hot: Generative UI is a hot space, OpenUI Lang uses up to 67% fewer tokens than JSON, and with MIT licensing it gained 85 stars today to rank #11 on the TypeScript daily trending list.
uses: Frontend developers building streaming generative UI for AI assistants or copilots
Product teams that need models to output structured UI like charts, forms and tables
Researchers seeking a token-efficient DSL to replace JSON as a model output protocol
Engineering teams extending custom component libraries and renderers on an open standard

zh.tag: 用大白话解释 AI 编程术语的词典
zh.what: 这是一个 AI 编程术语词典，用通俗英语解释 AI 编码中的专业词汇。它旨在帮助开发者理解 AI 编程中的基本概念，消除困惑，让 AI 编程不再像猜测。
zh.content: 仓库包含按主题分节的术语解释，如模型、会话、工具、失败模式等，每个术语都有简明定义。内容由 Markdown 文件生成，并有一个网站 aicodingdictionary.com。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，依赖 Node.js 和 npm 脚本进行生成。内容以 Markdown 编写，通过脚本生成最终文件。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 131 星，总星数达 4569，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 TypeScript 第 12 名。它因切中 AI 编程术语混乱的痛点而受欢迎，提供清晰易懂的解释。
uses: AI 编程初学者 —— 快速理解常见术语，降低入门门槛
经验开发者 —— 澄清模糊概念，提升与团队沟通效率
技术写作者 —— 参考术语定义，用于文档或教程编写
产品经理 —— 了解 AI 编程基础，更好地与开发团队协作

en.tag: AI coding jargon explained in plain English
en.what: This is a dictionary of AI coding jargon, explaining technical terms in plain English. It aims to help developers understand basic concepts in AI coding, removing confusion and making AI coding less like guesswork.
en.content: The repository contains term explanations organized by sections such as The Model, Sessions, Tools, and Failure Modes, each with concise definitions. Content is generated from Markdown files and has a companion website at aicodingdictionary.com.
en.stack: Primarily uses TypeScript, with Node.js and npm scripts for generation. Content is written in Markdown and generated into final files via scripts.
en.hot: The project gained 131 stars today, reaching 4,569 total, and ranked #12 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript) daily. It's popular for addressing the pain point of confusing AI coding jargon with clear, accessible explanations.
uses: AI coding beginners — quickly understand common terms and lower the entry barrier
Experienced developers — clarify ambiguous concepts and improve team communication
Technical writers — reference term definitions for documentation or tutorials
Product managers — learn AI coding basics to collaborate better with dev teams

zh.tag: 腾讯云出品的团队级 AI Agent 记忆中枢，把对话、文档与代码沉淀为可复用记忆资产
zh.what: TencentDB Agent Memory 是一个面向 AI Agent 的团队级记忆中心，把对话、文档和代码转化为四类可复用记忆资产：Chat Memory、Skill、LLM-Wiki 和 Code-Graph。这些记忆资产可被治理、共享，并在不同 Agent 与框架之间通用，让 Agent 拥有跨会话、跨工具的长期记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MemoryCore、MemoryHub 与 proxy 三大服务，提供一键部署脚本（deploy/global-images 下的 start-all.sh）、Web 管理面板、安装文档 INSTALL.md 以及 v2→v3 数据迁移工具。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Node.js（>=22.16），通过 npm 包 @tencentdb-agent-memory/memory-tencentdb 分发，默认存储后端可切换，MongoDB 后端为实验性可选，采用 MIT 许可。
zh.hot: 上线即获得约 2.66 万 Star，今日再涨 145，冲上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 日榜第 13 名；大厂腾讯云背书加上「Agent 长期记忆」这一热门痛点，使其迅速受到关注。
uses: 想让多个 AI Agent 共享长期记忆、避免重复上下文的开发团队
需要把团队对话、文档和代码沉淀为可检索知识资产的工程组织
使用 Claude Code、CodeBuddy 等编码 Agent，希望统一记忆后端的个人开发者
研究 Agent 记忆治理、跨框架记忆复用的 AI 平台与基础设施团队

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's team-level memory hub turning chats, docs and code into reusable memory assets for AI agents
en.what: TencentDB Agent Memory is a team-level memory hub for AI agents that turns conversations, docs and code into four reusable memory assets: Chat Memory, Skill, LLM-Wiki and Code-Graph. These assets are governed, shared and equipped across agents and frameworks, giving agents persistent memory across sessions and tools.
en.content: The repo ships three services — MemoryCore, MemoryHub and proxy — with a one-command deploy script (start-all.sh under deploy/global-images), a web panel, INSTALL.md docs, and a v2→v3 data migration tool.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript on Node.js (>=22.16), distributed via the npm package @tencentdb-agent-memory/memory-tencentdb, with a swappable storage backend (MongoDB is experimental and off by default) under the MIT license.
en.hot: It has already gathered roughly 26.6k stars, adding 145 today and landing at No.13 on GitHub Trending (TypeScript); Tencent Cloud's backing plus the hot pain point of long-term agent memory explains the rapid traction.
uses: Dev teams that want multiple AI agents to share long-term memory and avoid repeating context
Engineering orgs that need to turn team chats, docs and code into searchable knowledge assets
Individual developers using coding agents like Claude Code or CodeBuddy who want a unified memory backend
AI platform and infra teams researching memory governance and cross-framework memory reuse

zh.tag: 将 Claude Code 接入 TradingView 桌面端，实现 AI 辅助图表分析与 Pine 脚本开发。
zh.what: 这是一个 MCP 桥接工具，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 将 Claude Code 连接到本地运行的 TradingView 桌面应用。它允许 AI 代理读取和操作图表，辅助技术分析、Pine 脚本编写和工作流自动化。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器实现、与 TradingView Electron 应用交互的 CDP 客户端代码，以及配置和使用文档。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 Chrome DevTools Protocol 和 MCP 协议，需要本地安装 TradingView 桌面应用并启用远程调试端口。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上已获得 6167 颗星，今日新增 17 星，位列 JavaScript 日榜第三。它解决了 AI 与专业交易工具集成的痛点，同时引发了关于金融数据安全和自动化的讨论。
uses: 量化交易者和技术分析师，希望用自然语言快速分析图表和编写 Pine 脚本。
AI 代理开发者，研究 LLM 与桌面金融应用交互的可行性和限制。
TradingView 高级用户，寻求自动化重复性图表操作和工作流。
金融科技研究者，探索 AI 在实时数据环境中的决策支持应用。

en.tag: Connects Claude Code to TradingView Desktop for AI-assisted chart analysis and Pine Script development.
en.what: An MCP bridge that connects Claude Code to your locally running TradingView Desktop app via Chrome DevTools Protocol. It enables AI agents to read and interact with charts for technical analysis, Pine Script development, and workflow automation.
en.content: The repository contains the MCP server implementation, CDP client code for interacting with the TradingView Electron app, and configuration and usage documentation.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/Node.js, relies on Chrome DevTools Protocol and the MCP protocol. Requires a local TradingView Desktop installation with remote debugging enabled.
en.hot: With 6,167 stars and 17 added today, it ranks #3 on the JavaScript daily trending list. It addresses the pain point of integrating AI with professional trading tools and sparks discussions on financial data security and automation.
uses: Quant traders and technical analysts who want to analyze charts and write Pine Script using natural language.
AI agent developers researching the feasibility and limits of LLM interaction with desktop financial apps.
Advanced TradingView users seeking to automate repetitive chart operations and workflows.
Fintech researchers exploring AI decision support in real-time data environments.

zh.tag: 把 Claude 变成资深设计架构师的技能包
zh.what: 这是一套面向 AI 代理的结构化指令与知识层，把 Claude 变成拥有 15 年以上经验的设计系统与无障碍专家。它能生成 DTCG 设计令牌、设计 42 个组件并输出任意框架的生产级代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含 17 个可运行技能、37 个客观检查门、138 套品牌级设计系统、16 个框架适配器，以及 DTCG 令牌与组件规范文档。
zh.stack: 纯指令与知识层，无需构建工具或运行时依赖；主语言 JavaScript，通过 npm 包分发，适配 React 19、Next.js 15、SwiftUI 6、Tailwind v4 等任意框架。
zh.hot: 上线不久即获 1244 星，今日新增 63 星，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 4，说明开发者对 AI 辅助设计系统与无障碍代码生成需求强烈。
uses: 前端工程师想用 AI 快速产出符合设计系统的组件代码
设计系统团队需要统一令牌、无障碍与组件规范
独立开发者或小团队想低成本获得资深设计架构能力
使用 React、SwiftUI、Vue 等任意框架并关注 WCAG 2.2 的开发者

en.tag: A skill kit that turns Claude into a senior design architect
en.what: A structured instruction and knowledge layer that turns Claude into a design-systems and accessibility expert with 15+ years of experience. It generates DTCG design tokens, designs 42 components, and outputs production-ready code for any framework.
en.content: The repo ships 17 runnable skills, 37 objective gates, 138 brand-grade design systems, 16 framework adapters, plus DTCG token and component specification docs.
en.stack: A pure instruction and knowledge layer with no build tools or runtime dependencies; written mainly in JavaScript, distributed via npm, and adaptable to React 19, Next.js 15, SwiftUI 6, Tailwind v4, and any framework.
en.hot: It quickly reached 1,244 stars with 63 added today, ranking 4th on GitHub Trending's JavaScript daily list, reflecting strong demand for AI-assisted design systems and accessible code generation.
uses: Frontend engineers who want AI to generate design-system-compliant component code
Design system teams needing unified tokens, accessibility, and component specs
Solo developers or small teams seeking senior design architecture at low cost
Developers on React, SwiftUI, Vue, or any framework who care about WCAG 2.2

zh.tag: Node.js 高性能低开销 Web 框架，插件架构强大
zh.what: Fastify 是一个专注开发者体验、以最小开销处理高并发请求的 Node.js Web 框架。它受 Hapi 和 Express 启发，内置 JSON Schema 校验与序列化，号称是当下最快的 Web 框架之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、类型定义、测试套件与文档，主分支对应 v6 版本，另有 5.x 分支维护 v5。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，使用 neostandard 代码风格，依赖 npm 生态，并提供 TypeScript 类型支持。
zh.hot: 作为老牌高性能框架，Fastify 已积累 37,120 颗星，今日再登 JavaScript 日榜第 5，说明其在生产环境中的持久需求。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟 API 服务的 Node.js 后端开发者
希望用插件化架构构建可维护微服务的团队
从 Express 迁移并追求性能与 Schema 校验的项目
学习现代 Node.js Web 框架设计与基准测试的工程师

en.tag: Fast and low-overhead web framework for Node.js with a powerful plugin architecture
en.what: Fastify is a Node.js web framework focused on developer experience, minimal overhead, and handling high request volumes efficiently. Inspired by Hapi and Express, it ships with built-in JSON Schema validation and serialization and is known as one of the fastest web frameworks around.
en.content: The repo contains the core framework source, TypeScript typings, test suites, and docs; the main branch tracks v6 while the 5.x branch maintains v5.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js with neostandard code style, relying on the npm ecosystem and shipping TypeScript typings.
en.hot: As a mature high-performance framework, Fastify has gathered 37,120 stars and ranks 5th on today's JavaScript trending list, reflecting sustained production demand.
uses: Node.js backend developers needing high-throughput, low-latency API services
Teams building maintainable microservices with a plugin-based architecture
Projects migrating from Express that want performance and schema validation
Engineers studying modern Node.js web framework design and benchmarking

zh.tag: 模块化物流与供应链操作系统
zh.what: Fleetbase 是一个模块化的物流与供应链操作系统，旨在简化供应链行业的管理、规划、优化和运营控制。它提供订单管理、实时追踪、路线优化、司机调度等功能，适用于电商、餐饮、快递、现场服务等多个领域。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心平台代码、模块化扩展、API 接口、控制台界面以及相关文档。主要目录包括 api、console、modules 等，支持自定义扩展。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js 构建，使用 Ember.js 前端框架，依赖 PostgreSQL 数据库和 Redis 缓存，提供 RESTful API。
zh.hot: Fleetbase 在 GitHub 上获得 2649 颗星，今日新增 12 星，登上 JavaScript 日榜第 6 名。其模块化设计和开源特性吸引了物流和供应链领域的开发者。
uses: 电商与零售企业 —— 管理配送、追踪订单并优化最后一公里物流
餐饮与快递服务 —— 协调配送、调度司机并实时追踪订单
现场服务公司 —— 安排技术人员、管理服务区域并跟踪任务完成情况
开发者与集成商 —— 基于模块化架构和完整 API 构建定制供应链解决方案

en.tag: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system
en.what: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system designed to streamline management, planning, optimization, and operational control across the supply chain industry. It offers order management, real-time tracking, route optimization, driver dispatch, and more, suitable for e-commerce, food delivery, courier services, and field services.
en.content: The repository contains core platform code, modular extensions, API interfaces, console UI, and documentation. Main directories include api, console, modules, etc., supporting custom extensions.

en.hot: Fleetbase has 2,649 stars on GitHub, with 12 new stars today, ranking 6th on the JavaScript daily trending list. Its modular design and open-source nature attract developers in logistics and supply chain.
uses: E-commerce & retail businesses — manage deliveries, track orders, and optimize last-mile logistics
Food & beverage and courier services — coordinate deliveries, dispatch drivers, and track real-time orders
Field service companies — schedule technicians, manage service areas, and track job completion
Developers & integrators — build custom supply chain solutions with modular architecture and full API access

zh.tag: 免费领取高颜值 .is-a.dev 子域名的开源注册服务
zh.what: is-a.dev 是一个面向开发者的免费子域名服务，任何人都可以为自己搭建的个人网站、博客或项目申请一个简洁好看的 .is-a.dev 子域名。申请者通过向仓库提交 Pull Request 来登记自己的 DNS 记录，合并后几分钟内即可生效。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 domains 目录，里面按子域名存放一份份 JSON 配置文件，记录该子域名的 DNS 记录；此外还有文档链接、滥用举报模板和 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，核心是 JSON 格式的 DNS 记录配置，DNS 托管由 Cloudflare 的 Project Alexandria 计划支持，注册流程依托 GitHub PR 与 CI 校验。
zh.hot: 免费又好看的开发者子域名几乎是刚需，加上 11k+ star 的社区口碑和极低的使用门槛，让它持续登上 JavaScript 日榜。
uses: 想给个人主页、博客或作品集配一个简洁域名的独立开发者
预算有限但希望拥有专业感网址的学生与开源爱好者
需要为小型项目或演示站点快速绑定域名的团队
想学习 DNS 记录与 GitHub PR 协作流程的新手

en.tag: A free service giving developers a sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain
en.what: is-a.dev is a free subdomain service that lets any developer claim a clean, sweet-looking .is-a.dev subdomain for their personal site, blog, or project. You register by opening a pull request with your DNS records, and they go live within minutes of being merged.
en.content: The repo is essentially a domains directory holding one JSON config file per subdomain that defines its DNS records, plus docs links, an abuse-report template, and a Discord community.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with DNS records stored as JSON configs; DNS hosting is backed by Cloudflare's Project Alexandria, and registration runs through GitHub PRs and CI checks.
en.hot: A free, good-looking developer subdomain is near-universal demand, and with 11k+ stars of community trust and a very low barrier to entry, it keeps trending on the JavaScript daily chart.
uses: Indie developers wanting a clean domain for a personal homepage, blog, or portfolio
Students and open-source hobbyists who want a professional-looking URL on a budget
Teams needing a quick domain for a small project or demo site
Beginners learning DNS records and the GitHub PR workflow

zh.tag: 浏览器里的免费数据库 ERD 编辑器与 SQL 生成器
zh.what: drawDB 是一个完全运行在浏览器中的数据库实体关系图（ERD）编辑器，无需注册账号即可使用。用户通过拖拽点击即可绘制表结构关系图，并一键导出、导入 SQL 脚本或生成数据库迁移语句。
zh.content: 仓库主体是基于 JavaScript 的前端应用，包含 src 源码目录、图标等静态资源、Dockerfile 与 npm 构建脚本，另配套一个可选的 drawdb-server 用于文件分享。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，使用 npm 管理依赖，支持本地 npm run dev/build 开发构建，也可通过 Docker 镜像部署，分享功能需配合独立服务端与 .env 环境变量。
zh.hot: 近 3.9 万 star、日榜 JavaScript 第 6，说明开发者对免登录、纯浏览器、可导出 SQL 的轻量建模工具需求旺盛，替代笨重商业 ERD 软件的呼声很高。
uses: 后端与全栈工程师快速设计数据库表结构与关系
需要从 ERD 生成建表 SQL 或迁移脚本的开发者
教学场景中讲解数据库建模与实体关系的学生和讲师
希望自托管、免账号使用建模工具的团队

en.tag: Free browser-based database ERD editor and SQL generator
en.what: drawDB is a database entity relationship diagram (ERD) editor that runs entirely in the browser with no account required. Users can build schema diagrams with a few clicks, then export or import SQL scripts and generate database migrations.
en.content: The repo is a JavaScript front-end app containing the src source tree, static assets like icons, a Dockerfile and npm build scripts, plus an optional companion drawdb-server for file sharing.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with npm-managed dependencies, supporting local npm run dev/build workflows and Docker image deployment; sharing requires a separate server and .env variables.
en.hot: With nearly 39.5k stars and 6th on the JavaScript daily trending list, it shows strong demand for a login-free, browser-native modeling tool that exports SQL, as an alternative to heavyweight commercial ERD software.
uses: Backend and full-stack engineers sketching database schemas and relations quickly
Developers who need to generate CREATE TABLE SQL or migration scripts from an ERD
Students and instructors teaching database modeling and entity relationships
Teams wanting a self-hosted, account-free modeling tool

zh.tag: 洛雪音乐播放器的第三方音源脚本合集
zh.what: 这是为洛雪音乐（lx-music）桌面版与移动版提供的第三方音源脚本仓库，用户把其中的 JS 链接导入播放器后即可扩展可搜索、可播放的曲库。内容整理自网络，聚合了多个来源的音源接口。
zh.content: 仓库按来源分目录存放脚本，如 sixyin、huibq、flower、lx、ikun、grass、juhe、qdy 等，每个目录下有 latest.js 供在线导入，README 同时给出原始链接与多个 GitHub 加速镜像地址。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 编写，运行在洛雪音乐播放器的自定义音源机制中，无复杂构建依赖，主要通过 GitHub Raw 链接分发，并借助 ghproxy 等加速站点访问。
zh.hot: 洛雪音乐本身拥有大量用户，而官方音源受限，社区音源因此成为刚需；该仓库已积累约 8.7k star，今日新增 35，稳居 JavaScript 日榜第 9。
uses: 洛雪音乐桌面版/移动版用户，想扩展可搜索播放的曲库
网络访问 GitHub 受限、需要加速镜像链接的用户
想自建或研究第三方音乐源脚本的开发者

en.tag: A collection of third-party music source scripts for the LX Music player
en.what: This repo hosts third-party music source scripts for the LX Music (lx-music) desktop and mobile players. Users import the JS links into the player to expand the searchable and playable music catalog; the content is aggregated from various online sources.
en.content: Scripts are organized into per-source folders such as sixyin, huibq, flower, lx, ikun, grass, juhe and qdy, each containing a latest.js for online import. The README lists both raw links and several GitHub proxy mirrors.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript and executed by LX Music's custom source mechanism, with no heavy build dependencies. Distribution is mainly via GitHub Raw links, with ghproxy-style mirrors for restricted networks.
en.hot: LX Music has a large user base, and since official sources are limited, community sources are in high demand. The repo has reached about 8.7k stars with 35 added today, ranking 9th on the JavaScript daily trending list.
uses: LX Music desktop/mobile users who want a larger searchable and playable catalog
Users with restricted GitHub access who need proxy mirror links
Developers interested in building or studying third-party music source scripts

zh.tag: 固执己见的代码格式化器，统一团队代码风格
zh.what: Prettier 是一个固执己见的代码格式化工具，通过解析代码并按自己的规则重新打印，自动统一代码风格。它会考虑最大行宽，在必要时自动换行，让开发者不再为格式问题争论。
zh.content: 仓库包含格式化器核心实现、各语言解析器与打印器、CLI、插件系统以及完整的文档与测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要用 JavaScript 编写，基于 Node.js，通过 npm 分发，支持编辑器、pre-commit 钩子和 CI 集成。
zh.hot: 作为前端生态最主流的格式化工具，已积累 52254 颗星，今日仍登上 JavaScript 日榜第 10 名，是团队协作的标配。
uses: 前端与全栈团队，统一多人协作项目的代码风格
个人开发者，在编辑器保存时自动格式化代码
CI/CD 流程，检查代码库格式是否一致
开源维护者，减少代码审查中的格式争论

en.tag: The opinionated code formatter that ends style debates
en.what: Prettier is an opinionated code formatter that parses your code and re-prints it with its own rules, enforcing a consistent style automatically. It takes maximum line length into account and wraps code when necessary, ending nit-picky style debates.
en.content: The repo contains the core formatter, language parsers and printers, the CLI, a plugin system, plus extensive docs and test suites.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript on Node.js, distributed via npm, with integrations for editors, pre-commit hooks, and CI.
en.hot: As the dominant formatter in the frontend ecosystem, it has amassed 52,254 stars and still ranks 10th on today's JavaScript trending list, a staple for team collaboration.
uses: Frontend and full-stack teams unifying code style across collaborators
Individual developers auto-formatting on save in their editor
CI/CD pipelines checking that a codebase stays consistently formatted
Open-source maintainers reducing formatting nitpicks in code review

zh.tag: 可链式调用的 JS SDF 库，附离散结构生成器层
zh.what: sdf-js 是一个 JavaScript 有符号距离场（SDF）建模库，用可链式调用的 API 描述和组合 3D 几何体。它是 fogleman/sdf 的移植与扩展，并新增了基于 SDF 的离散结构生成器层，把「形态」与「生成器」解耦。上层 Atlas 项目用它把 LLM 提示词编译成可编辑的 3D 场景。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 sdf-js 库本体，另含 scripts/regression 回归脚本、docs 示例图与 GitHub Pages 在线画廊（8 个预生成场景，可用 WASD 漫游）。
zh.stack: 纯 JavaScript 实现，依赖 Node.js 与 npm 生态，测试走 GitHub Actions；渲染侧由 BOB GPU 的两遍沙画着色器负责。
zh.hot: 269 星、日增 10，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 11。它踩中「SDF + LLM 是扩散模型无法企及的插画范式」这一叙事，且提供免 API key 的在线画廊，上手门槛极低。
uses: 想用代码而非建模软件构建 3D 几何的程序员与创意开发者
研究 LLM 生成结构化 3D 场景、可编辑 SceneData 的 AI 应用开发者
需要把提示词编译为精确几何（时钟、建筑等结构敏感场景）的插画/生成艺术作者
想学习有符号距离场与链式几何 API 的图形学入门者

en.tag: Chainable JS SDF library with a discrete-structure generator layer
en.what: sdf-js is a JavaScript signed distance function (SDF) modeling library with a chainable API for describing and composing 3D geometry. It is a port and extension of fogleman/sdf, adding a discrete-structure generator layer that decouples form from generator. The Atlas project builds on it to compile LLM prompts into editable 3D scenes.
en.content: The repo centers on the sdf-js library itself, plus regression scripts under scripts/regression, docs images, and a GitHub Pages live gallery with 8 pre-lifted scenes explorable via WASD.
en.stack: Pure JavaScript with the Node.js/npm ecosystem and GitHub Actions for tests; rendering is handled by BOB GPU's two-pass sand-painting shader.
en.hot: 269 stars with +10 today, ranking #11 on GitHub Trending (JavaScript). It rides the narrative that SDF + LLM is an illustration paradigm diffusion can't reach, and its no-API-key live gallery makes it easy to try.
uses: Programmers and creative coders who prefer building 3D geometry in code over modeling software
AI app developers exploring LLM-generated structured 3D scenes and editable SceneData
Illustrators and generative artists needing prompts compiled into exact geometry (clocks, architecture)
Graphics learners wanting to study signed distance fields and chainable geometry APIs

zh.tag: 驱动所有 Stremio 应用的 Rust 核心引擎
zh.what: stremio-core 是 Stremio 媒体中心所有客户端共享的 Rust 核心逻辑库，涵盖用户与插件状态、插件协议、媒体库、通知、播放状态和深度链接。各平台 UI 只是薄薄一层，真正的应用逻辑都在这个 crate 里。
zh.content: 仓库包含 types、addon 系统、UI models 与 runtime 等模块，采用受 Elm 架构启发的单向状态流设计，并附有完整的 API 文档与 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 编写，遵循 MSRV 策略，通过 Env trait 抽象平台能力（HTTP 请求、存储、任务执行与时间），可跨整个技术栈集成。
zh.hot: 作为 Stremio 全平台应用的核心引擎，它把复杂状态管理收敛到单一 Rust 代码库，今日新增 12 星、以 2380 星登上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 3。
uses: 想为 Stremio 开发插件或客户端的开发者，可直接复用其 types 与插件协议
研究 Rust 状态管理与 Elm 架构实践的工程师，可参考其单向数据流设计
需要跨平台共享核心逻辑的媒体/流媒体应用团队，可借鉴其 Env 抽象方案

en.tag: The Rust engine that powers every Stremio app
en.what: stremio-core is the shared Rust core logic library behind all Stremio media center clients, covering user and addon state, the addon protocol, library, notifications, playback state, and deep links. Platform UIs are thin layers on top — this crate is effectively the app itself.
en.content: The repo contains modules for types, the addon system, UI models, and the runtime, built around a unidirectional state flow inspired by the Elm Architecture, along with full API docs and CI workflows.
en.stack: Written in Rust with an MSRV policy, it abstracts platform capabilities (HTTP fetch, storage, task execution, time) behind an Env trait and integrates across the whole stack.
en.hot: As the core engine for every Stremio app, it consolidates complex state management into a single Rust codebase, gaining 12 stars today and ranking #3 on GitHub's daily Rust trending with 2,380 stars.
uses: Developers building Stremio addons or clients who want to reuse its types and addon protocol
Engineers studying Rust state management and Elm Architecture patterns via its unidirectional data flow
Media or streaming teams needing cross-platform shared core logic, who can learn from its Env abstraction

zh.tag: 基于 TurboQuant 的 Rust 向量索引，内存省 8 倍且搜索快过 FAISS
zh.what: turbovec 是一个用 Rust 编写、提供 Python 绑定的向量索引库，基于 Google Research 的 TurboQuant 量化算法。它无需训练阶段即可在线摄入向量，把千万级文档语料的 float32 内存占用从 31 GB 压到 4 GB，同时搜索速度超过 FAISS。
zh.content: 仓库提供 Rust crate 与 PyPI 包 turbovec，核心 API 包括 TurboQuantIndex 与支持稳定 ID 的 IdMapIndex，支持 add/search/write/load 以及增量持久化的 sync(path)。
zh.stack: 主体为 Rust，通过 PyO3/maturin 提供 Python 绑定；手写 SIMD 内核覆盖 ARM NEON SDOT/SMMLA 与 x86 AVX-512 VNNI、vpermb，并带 AVX2 与标量回退。
zh.hot: 它直击 RAG 场景的内存与延迟痛点，宣称比 FAISS 快 3.4 倍（4-bit）且完全本地运行，已收获 16937 颗星，今日再涨 91，位列 GitHub Rust 日榜第 7。
uses: 需要本地化、隐私优先 RAG 的开发者，可用它搭配开源嵌入模型搭建完全离线的检索栈
内存受限或追求低延迟的向量检索服务，可用 4-bit/2-bit 量化大幅压缩索引体积
熟悉 Rust 并希望用 Python 快速验证的工程师，可直接 pip install turbovec 上手
需要增量写入、崩溃安全持久化与搜索时过滤的检索系统，可借助 sync 与 id 白名单能力

en.tag: A Rust vector index built on TurboQuant — 8x less memory, faster than FAISS
en.what: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings, built on Google Research's TurboQuant quantization algorithm. It ingests vectors online with no training phase, shrinking a 10M-document float32 corpus from 31 GB to 4 GB while searching faster than FAISS.
en.content: The repo ships a Rust crate and the turbovec PyPI package, with core APIs TurboQuantIndex and IdMapIndex for stable IDs, supporting add/search/write/load plus incremental persistence via sync(path).
en.stack: Written in Rust with Python bindings via PyO3/maturin; hand-written SIMD kernels cover ARM NEON SDOT/SMMLA and x86 AVX-512 VNNI/vpermb, with AVX2 and scalar fallbacks.
en.hot: It targets RAG memory and latency pain points, claiming 3.4x faster than FAISS at 4-bit while staying fully local — now at 16,937 stars, up 91 today, ranking #7 on GitHub's Rust daily trending.
uses: Developers building privacy-first, fully local RAG stacks paired with open-source embedding models
Vector search services constrained by memory or latency, using 4-bit/2-bit quantization to shrink indexes
Rust engineers who want quick Python validation via pip install turbovec
Retrieval systems needing incremental writes, crash-safe persistence, and search-time filtering via sync and id allowlists

zh.tag: 追踪仓库中 AI 生成代码的 Git 扩展
zh.what: Git AI 是一个开源 Git 扩展，用于追踪仓库中由 AI 生成的代码。安装后，每一行 AI 代码都会关联到生成它的代理、模型和提示词，从而保留代码背后的意图、需求和架构决策。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的 Git 扩展源码、Git AI 标准规范文档（specs/git_ai_standard_v3.0.0.md）、安装脚本以及展示各 AI 代理（如 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等）的文档资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，依赖 Git 钩子机制，提供跨平台安装脚本（Mac/Linux/Windows WSL），并支持多种 AI 代理和模型。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 生成代码的普及，追踪其来源和上下文变得至关重要。该项目今日新增 44 星，总星数达 2686，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜（Rust）第 5 名，反映了开发者对 AI 代码归属和可追溯性的强烈需求。
uses: 使用 AI 代理生成代码的开发者，希望追踪每行代码的来源和提示词。
团队协作场景，需要审计和了解 AI 生成代码的意图与架构决策。
开源项目维护者，希望透明地展示 AI 贡献比例。
对 AI 代码归属和合规性有要求的企业或组织。

en.tag: A Git extension that tracks AI-generated code in your repos
en.what: Git AI is an open source Git extension that tracks AI-generated code in your repositories. After installation, every line of AI code is linked to the agent, model, and prompts that generated it, preserving the intent, requirements, and architecture decisions behind your code.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust source for the Git extension, the Git AI standard specification (specs/git_ai_standard_v3.0.0.md), installation scripts, and documentation assets showcasing various AI agents (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor).
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, it leverages Git hooks and provides cross-platform install scripts (Mac/Linux/Windows WSL), supporting multiple AI agents and models.
en.hot: As AI-generated code becomes ubiquitous, tracking its origin and context is crucial. The project gained 44 stars today, reaching 2,686 total, and ranks 5th on GitHub Trending (Rust), reflecting strong developer demand for AI code attribution and traceability.
uses: Developers using AI agents to generate code who want to trace each line's origin and prompts.
Team collaboration scenarios requiring auditing and understanding the intent and architecture behind AI-generated code.
Open source maintainers who want to transparently show the proportion of AI contributions.
Enterprises or organizations with requirements for AI code attribution and compliance.

zh.tag: 面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，用于管理 Git worktree，让开发者可以在同一仓库中并行维护多个工作目录。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理或任务能各自在独立工作区中同时运行而不互相干扰。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 源码为主体，包含 CLI 命令实现、文档站点（worktrunk.dev）与 CI/Codecov 配置，并提供 crate 发布形态。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，通过 Cargo/crates.io 分发，采用 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可，并配有 GitHub Actions CI 与 Codecov 覆盖率检测。
zh.hot: 项目已获得约 6984 颗星，今日新增 44 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明在 AI 代理并行开发这一热点方向上需求旺盛。
uses: 需要同时运行多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，用独立 worktree 隔离各自任务
在本地并行开发多个分支或功能、频繁切换上下文的工程师
希望用 CLI 简化 Git worktree 创建、切换与清理流程的团队

Everything runs on your machine, with your keys, in your workspace.

en.stack: Written in Rust (Edition 2024), dual-licensed MIT OR Apache 2.0, built with cargo and distributed as prebuilt binaries; it depends on multi-provider LLM SDKs, many messaging channel adapters and the MCP tool protocol.
en.hot: With 32,794 stars and 16 added today, it ranks 16th on GitHub's daily Rust trending list; its 'you own the agent, the data, the machine' self-hosting philosophy and single-binary lightweight deployment hit developers' demand for privacy and portability.
uses: Individual developers who want full control over their AI assistant's data and keys without cloud lock-in
Teams needing a unified agent across Discord, Telegram, email and other channels
Infrastructure engineers building pluggable LLM and tool pipelines in Rust
Hobbyists running a lightweight autonomous assistant locally or on edge devices

zh.tag: 完全离线的开源跨平台语音转文字桌面应用
zh.what: Handy 是一款跨平台桌面语音转文字工具，按下快捷键说话，松开后文字自动粘贴到任意输入框。所有识别都在本地完成，音频不会上传云端，兼顾隐私与易用性。

需要频繁口述输入文字的作者、记者、程序员
希望基于开源代码二次开发或自建语音输入工具的技术团队
在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上寻找免费替代付费听写软件的用户

en.tag: A free, open-source, offline speech-to-text desktop app
en.what: Handy is a cross-platform desktop speech-to-text app: press a shortcut, speak, and your words are pasted into any text field. Everything runs locally, so audio never leaves your computer.

Users on Windows, macOS, or Linux seeking a free alternative to paid dictation apps

zh.tag: 基于 TUN 接口的高级隧道与内网穿透工具
zh.what: Ligolo-ng 是一款简单、轻量且快速的隧道工具，允许渗透测试人员通过反向 TCP/TLS 连接建立隧道，并使用 TUN 接口（无需 SOCKS 代理）。它能在代理端创建用户态网络栈，实现高效的内网穿透和横向移动。
zh.content: 仓库包含代理端（agent）和中继/代理服务器（relay/proxy）的 Go 源码，以及文档、演示视频和 Web 界面相关文件。还提供了配置文件、自动路由管理、守护进程模式等功能的实现。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Gvisor 用户态网络栈，支持多平台（Windows、Linux、macOS、BSD），并集成 Let's Encrypt 自动证书配置。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上已获得 4976 颗星，今日新增 21 星，位列 Go 语言日榜第三。其简单易用、无需 SOCKS 代理的特性以及强大的内网穿透能力，深受渗透测试人员欢迎。

红队成员 —— 在受限网络环境中进行隐蔽通信
安全研究人员 —— 分析网络流量和测试防御措施
CTF 参赛者 —— 在挑战中快速搭建隧道

en.tag: Advanced tunneling and pivoting tool using TUN interfaces
en.what: Ligolo-ng is a simple, lightweight, and fast tunneling tool that allows pentesters to establish tunnels from a reverse TCP/TLS connection using a TUN interface (without SOCKS). It creates a userland network stack on the agent side, enabling efficient pivoting and lateral movement.
en.content: The repository contains Go source code for the agent and relay/proxy server, along with documentation, demo videos, and Web interface files. It also includes implementations for configuration files, automatic route management, daemon mode, and more.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging the Gvisor userland network stack, supporting multiple platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS, BSD), and integrating Let's Encrypt for automatic certificate configuration.
en.hot: With 4,976 stars and 21 new stars today, it ranks third on the Go daily trending list. Its simplicity, no need for SOCKS proxy, and powerful pivoting capabilities make it popular among pentesters.

Red team members — for covert communication in restricted network environments
Security researchers — for analyzing network traffic and testing defenses
CTF players — for quickly setting up tunnels in challenges

zh.tag: 可插拔传输的 TCP 隧道网络栈研究工具
zh.what: OpenFlux 是一个用 Go 编写的 TCP 隧道工具，客户端运行 SOCKS5 代理，流量经可插拔传输层送到出口节点再转发到互联网。它定位为网络栈研究项目，目前提供 Yandex 与 Max 两种实验性传输方式。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 代码：main.go 提供 client / exit-node 命令行入口，transport/ 目录定义 Transport 接口并实现压缩器与各传输方式，另有 export_ios.go 用于 iOS 静态库的 cgo 桥接。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go（要求 1.26.3+），构建 Android 客户端需 NDK 27+，iOS 客户端需 Xcode 26.6+，出口节点需 Linux VPS/VDS；传输层依赖 Yandex Docs 与 WebRTC DataChannel。
zh.hot: 今日新增 198 star、总数 1149，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 12 名，说明可插拔传输与网络栈研究这一话题正被大量开发者关注。
uses: 网络协议与传输层研究者，用于实验可插拔传输架构
Go 开发者，想学习 SOCKS5 代理与隧道出口节点的实现
需要自建 Linux VPS 出口节点做流量转发的技术用户
关注移动端网络扩展（Android APK / iOS Network Extension）的开发者

en.tag: Network stack research tool: a TCP tunnel with pluggable transports
en.what: OpenFlux is a Go-based TCP tunnel where a client-side SOCKS5 proxy sends traffic through a pluggable transport layer to an exit node that forwards it to the internet. It is framed as a network stack research project, currently shipping two experimental transports, Yandex and Max.
en.content: The repo is mostly Go code: main.go provides the client / exit-node CLI entry, transport/ defines the Transport interface plus a compressor and the transport implementations, and export_ios.go bridges cgo for the iOS static library.
en.stack: Primarily Go (requires 1.26.3+), with Android builds needing NDK 27+ and iOS builds needing Xcode 26.6+, plus a Linux VPS/VDS exit node; transports rely on Yandex Docs and WebRTC DataChannel.
en.hot: It gained 198 stars today for a total of 1,149, landing at #12 on GitHub Trending daily, showing strong developer interest in pluggable transports and network stack research.
uses: Network protocol and transport-layer researchers experimenting with pluggable transport architectures
Go developers wanting to study SOCKS5 proxy and tunnel exit-node implementations
Technical users who run their own Linux VPS exit node for traffic forwarding
Developers interested in mobile network extensions (Android APK / iOS Network Extension)

en.tag: Self-hosted AI gateway for multi-channel, multi-credential routing and failover
en.what: GPT-Load is a self-hosted AI gateway that consolidates multiple upstream channels and many API keys or subscription accounts behind a single entry point. It handles traffic scheduling, retries and failover, plus request logging and usage accounting.
en.content: The repo ships a Go backend, a web admin frontend (web/public assets), Docker packaging, and multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/JA).

Ops/platform engineers building an in-house AI relay with logging and usage stats
Small teams wanting a quick Docker deployment without vendor lock-in

en.tag: Open-source LLM knowledge platform turning documents into queryable RAG, autonomous agent, and self-maintaining Wiki

Intelligent customer service and Q&A systems: Leverage RAG-based quick Q&A to build chatbots grounded in private knowledge.

zh.tag: 单二进制、无数据库的自托管工作流编排器，用 YAML 编排脚本与容器
zh.what: Dagu 是一个本地优先的工作流引擎，把已有的脚本、SSH 命令、Docker 容器和 Kubernetes Job 用声明式 YAML 串成 DAG，并补上调度、重试、依赖、人工任务和运行历史。它面向那些主业不是编排的团队，让工作流与业务逻辑保持分离。

zh.stack: 主语言 Go，单二进制分发，无需外部数据库或消息中间件，支持 Linux/macOS/Windows，可运行 shell、Docker、K8s Job 与 SSH 远程命令。

想用 MCP 让 AI 助手检查、修改并控制工作流运行的开发者

en.tag: Self-hostable, single-binary workflow orchestrator that runs your scripts and containers from declarative YAML
en.what: Dagu is a local-first workflow engine that chains existing scripts, SSH commands, Docker containers and Kubernetes Jobs into DAGs via declarative YAML, adding scheduling, retries, dependencies, human tasks and run history. en.content: The repo contains the Go engine and CLI, a built-in Web UI (Cockpit run view, step logs, Wiki pages), a REST API spec, an MCP server, plus many YAML examples and docs.
en.stack: Written in Go, shipped as a single binary with no external DB or message broker; runs on Linux/macOS/Windows and can execute shell, Docker, K8s Jobs and remote SSH commands.

Developers wanting an MCP server so AI assistants can inspect, edit and control workflow runs

zh.tag: HashiCorp 出品的轻量灵活工作负载编排器
zh.what: Nomad 是一个易用、灵活且高性能的工作负载编排器，可在本地和云端大规模部署容器、非容器化应用（可执行文件、Java）以及虚拟机。它以单一二进制运行，自带资源管理与调度，无需外部存储或协调服务，并原生集成 Consul 与 Vault。

在多区域、多云环境中部署应用并寻求联邦集群能力的企业

en.tag: HashiCorp's simple, flexible workload orchestrator
en.what: Nomad is an easy-to-use, flexible, and performant workload orchestrator that deploys containers, non-containerized applications (executables, Java), and virtual machines across on-prem and cloud at scale. en.hot: As a lightweight alternative to Kubernetes, Nomad draws steady attention for its single-binary simplicity and mixed-workload support, holding 16,906 stars with 16 added today and ranking #8 on the Go daily trending list.

Small-to-mid clusters seeking a lower-ops alternative or complement to Kubernetes

zh.tag: 在本地运行 GitHub Actions 工作流
zh.what: act 让你在本地直接运行 .github/workflows/ 中定义的 GitHub Actions，无需每次提交推送就能验证改动。它通过 Docker API 拉取或构建镜像，并按依赖关系确定执行路径，环境变量与文件系统尽量与 GitHub 托管 runner 保持一致。

zh.hot: 近 7.2 万 star 且今日仍在 Go 日榜第 9，说明本地复现 CI 是开发者长期刚需，act 已成为事实标准工具。
uses: 需要频繁调试 GitHub Actions 工作流的开发者，可本地快速验证改动
想把 GitHub Actions 当作本地任务运行器、替代 Makefile 的团队

en.tag: Run your GitHub Actions workflows locally
en.what: act lets you run the GitHub Actions defined in .github/workflows/ locally, so you don't have to commit and push every time you want to test a change.
