en.hot: With nearly 72k stars and still ranking 9th on the Go daily trending list, act shows that locally reproducing CI is a lasting developer need and has become the de facto tool for it.
uses: Developers who frequently debug GitHub Actions workflows and want fast local validation
Teams that want to use GitHub Actions as a local task runner instead of a Makefile
Engineers who need to rehearse CI pipelines offline or in restricted networks
Open-source maintainers who want fewer commit-push cycles and faster feedback

zh.tag: 快速、安全、高效的跨平台备份程序
zh.what: restic 是一个快速、高效且安全的备份程序，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows 等主流操作系统。它通过快照和去重技术实现增量备份，并支持多种存储后端，如本地目录、SFTP、S3、B2 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含 restic 的完整源代码，主要用 Go 编写，包括命令行工具、备份引擎、加密模块、存储后端实现以及详细的文档和测试套件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 标准库和第三方库如 crypto、fuse 等，支持跨平台编译，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行持续集成。
zh.hot: restic 在 GitHub 上拥有超过 36,000 颗星，今日新增 27 星，登上 Go 日榜第 10 名，因其高效、安全且易于使用的备份解决方案而广受欢迎。
uses: 系统管理员和 DevOps 工程师用于自动化服务器备份
个人用户需要安全备份重要数据到云存储或远程服务器
开发者在 CI/CD 流程中集成备份和恢复步骤
企业团队寻求开源、可审计的备份工具替代商业方案

en.tag: Fast, secure, and efficient cross-platform backup program
en.what: restic is a fast, efficient, and secure backup program that supports major operating systems like Linux, macOS, and Windows. It uses snapshots and deduplication for incremental backups and supports various storage backends such as local directory, SFTP, S3, B2, etc.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of restic, primarily written in Go, including the CLI tool, backup engine, encryption module, storage backend implementations, and comprehensive documentation and test suites.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, relying on the Go standard library and third-party libraries like crypto and fuse, with cross-platform compilation support and continuous integration via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: restic has over 36,000 stars on GitHub, with 27 new stars today, ranking 10th on the Go daily trending list, popular for its efficient, secure, and easy-to-use backup solution.
uses: System administrators and DevOps engineers for automated server backups
Individual users needing to securely back up important data to cloud storage or remote servers
Developers integrating backup and restore steps into CI/CD pipelines
Enterprise teams looking for an open-source, auditable backup tool as an alternative to commercial solutions

zh.tag: 面向精简团队的 AI 驱动全栈可观测性平台
zh.what: Netdata 是一个开源的实时全栈可观测性平台，以秒级粒度采集并可视化服务器、容器、应用与网络的每一项指标。它内置 AI 异常检测与告警，帮助团队快速定位性能问题，无需复杂配置即可上手。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心采集与可视化引擎（C 语言）、Go 编写的 agent 与云集成组件、数百个开箱即用的数据采集插件，以及安装脚本、Docker 镜像和文档。
zh.stack: 核心以 C 语言实现高性能采集，Go 用于 agent 与云服务集成，支持 Linux、macOS、FreeBSD 及容器环境，依赖极少，可通过 Docker、包管理器或一键脚本部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 80509 颗星稳居可观测性领域头部开源项目，今日新增 10 星并登上 Go 日榜第 11 名，说明其“秒级全栈监控 + AI 告警”的定位持续吸引运维与 SRE 社区关注。
uses: 运维与 SRE 团队：需要秒级实时监控和 AI 异常检测来快速排障
中小型或精简团队：希望零配置、低成本获得全栈可观测性
开发者与自托管爱好者：想在自己的服务器或家庭实验室部署监控面板
云原生与容器环境：监控 Kubernetes、Docker 及微服务性能指标

en.tag: AI-powered full stack observability for lean teams
en.what: Netdata is an open-source, real-time full stack observability platform that collects and visualizes every metric from servers, containers, applications and networks at per-second granularity. It ships with built-in AI anomaly detection and alerting, helping teams pinpoint performance issues quickly with minimal setup.
en.content: The repo contains the core collection and visualization engine (C), Go-based agent and cloud integration components, hundreds of out-of-the-box collectors, plus install scripts, Docker images and documentation.
en.stack: Core is written in C for high-performance collection, with Go powering the agent and cloud integrations; it runs on Linux, macOS, FreeBSD and containers with minimal dependencies, deployable via Docker, package managers or a one-line script.
en.hot: With 80,509 stars it remains a top open-source observability project; adding 10 stars today and ranking 11th on the Go trending daily list shows its 'per-second full stack monitoring + AI alerting' pitch keeps drawing DevOps and SRE attention.
uses: DevOps and SRE teams needing per-second real-time monitoring and AI anomaly detection for fast troubleshooting
Small or lean teams wanting zero-config, low-cost full stack observability
Developers and self-hosters deploying monitoring dashboards on their own servers or homelabs
Cloud-native and container environments monitoring Kubernetes, Docker and microservice performance

zh.tag: 面向所有人的现代化 Docker 管理面板
zh.what: Arcane 是一个现代化的 Docker 管理工具，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理容器、镜像、网络与卷等资源。它主打易用性，让个人开发者和团队都能轻松掌控 Docker 环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务与前端管理界面，配有截图、官方文档链接、SBOM 安全清单以及 Crowdin 多语言翻译配置。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，后端模块发布在 pkg.go.dev，采用 BSD-3-Clause 许可证，并通过 Snyk 与 Greptile 做安全与质量检测。
zh.hot: 凭借 7366 颗星登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 12 名，今日新增 9 星，说明这个易用的 Docker 管理面板正持续吸引关注。
uses: 个人开发者想用图形界面替代命令行管理 Docker 容器
小团队需要轻量的自托管 Docker 运维面板
运维人员希望集中查看镜像、网络与卷等资源
关注开源与安全透明（SBOM）的 Docker 用户

en.tag: Modern Docker management, designed for everyone
en.what: Arcane is a modern Docker management tool that offers an intuitive web UI for handling containers, images, networks, and volumes. It focuses on ease of use so both individuals and teams can manage Docker environments effortlessly.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend service and a frontend management UI, along with screenshots, official docs links, an SBOM security manifest, and Crowdin localization setup.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with the backend module published on pkg.go.dev under the BSD-3-Clause license, and uses Snyk and Greptile for security and quality checks.
en.hot: With 7,366 stars and ranked 12th on the GitHub Go daily trending list (+9 today), this user-friendly Docker management panel keeps drawing attention.
uses: Individual developers wanting a GUI alternative to Docker CLI
Small teams needing a lightweight self-hosted Docker ops panel
Ops engineers wanting a centralized view of images, networks, and volumes
Docker users who value open source and security transparency (SBOM)

zh.tag: 开源自托管的轻量 Markdown 速记工具
zh.what: Memos 是一个开源、可自托管的轻量笔记工具，专为快速记录碎片化想法而设计。它以 Markdown 原生格式将日常笔记、链接、工作日志和片段汇入按时间排序的时间线，数据完全由用户掌控。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务与 web 前端目录，提供 Docker 部署、Web Clipper 浏览器扩展以及完整的部署文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，支持 Docker 一键部署，数据存储于本地目录，前端基于现代 Web 技术构建。
zh.hot: 凭借 62,992 颗星和今日新增 35 星登上 Go 日榜第 13 名，其轻量、隐私优先和零遥测的自托管理念深受开发者青睐。
uses: 希望完全掌控个人笔记数据的自托管爱好者
需要快速记录碎片化想法和日常日志的开发者
寻求轻量替代 Notion 等重型工作区的用户
注重隐私、拒绝遥测的团队或个人

en.tag: Open-source, self-hosted lightweight Markdown note-taking tool
en.what: Memos is an open-source, self-hosted lightweight note-taking tool built for capturing fleeting thoughts quickly. It flows daily notes, links, work logs, and snippets into a chronological Markdown timeline that you fully control.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend service and a web frontend directory, along with Docker deployment, a Web Clipper browser extension, and full documentation.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, deployable via a single Docker command, with data stored in a local directory and a modern web-based frontend.
en.hot: With 62,992 stars and 35 added today, it ranks 13th on the Go daily trending list, favored by developers for its lightweight, privacy-first, zero-telemetry self-hosted approach.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want full control over their note data
Developers needing to quickly capture fleeting thoughts and daily logs
Users seeking a lightweight alternative to heavy workspaces like Notion
Privacy-conscious individuals or teams rejecting telemetry

zh.tag: 为终端打造的 DeepSeek 原生编码代理，围绕前缀缓存稳定性设计，可长期常驻运行
zh.what: Reasonix 是一个跑在终端里的 AI 编码代理，专为 DeepSeek 模型深度适配。它的核心设计目标是前缀缓存（prefix cache）稳定性，让会话可以长时间常驻而不必反复重建上下文，从而降低延迟与成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的主体引擎、npm 包 reasonix 的分发入口，以及 docs 下的 Guide、ACP、Extensions、Spec 等文档与 logo 资源，另有 CI 工作流、Discord 社区与官网。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，通过 npm 包 reasonix 分发安装，配套 GitHub Actions CI，并支持 ACP 协议与扩展机制。
zh.hot: 已积累约 3.55 万 star，今日新增 50，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜 Go 语言第 8 名，说明终端型编码代理与 DeepSeek 生态正持续吸引开发者。
uses: 习惯在终端工作、希望用命令行完成编码任务的开发者
使用 DeepSeek 模型、关注前缀缓存与长会话成本优化的团队
需要长时间常驻、可扩展的 AI 编码代理工作流的高级用户

en.tag: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal, engineered around prefix-cache stability so you can leave it running
en.what: Reasonix is an AI coding agent that lives in your terminal and is purpose-built for DeepSeek models. Its core design goal is prefix-cache stability, so a session can stay running for a long time without repeatedly rebuilding context, cutting latency and cost.
en.content: The repo holds the Go-based engine, the npm package `reasonix` as a distribution entry point, plus docs for Guide, ACP, Extensions and Spec alongside logo assets, CI workflows, a Discord community and a website.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, distributed via the npm package `reasonix`, with GitHub Actions CI and support for the ACP protocol and an extension mechanism.
en.hot: With roughly 35.5k stars and 50 added today, it ranks 8th on the GitHub Trending daily Go chart, showing sustained interest in terminal coding agents and the DeepSeek ecosystem.
uses: Developers who prefer working in the terminal and want coding tasks done from the command line
Teams using DeepSeek models who care about prefix caching and long-session cost efficiency
Power users who need a long-running, extensible AI coding agent workflow

zh.tag: 自托管音乐流媒体服务器，打造个人版 Spotify
zh.what: Navidrome 是一个开源、基于 Web 的音乐收藏服务器与流媒体播放器，让你从任意浏览器或移动设备收听自己的音乐库。它兼容 Subsonic/Airsonic API，可搭配大量现成客户端使用，无需为音乐订阅付费。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI 前端、数据库迁移脚本、Docker 与多平台构建配置，以及文档和主题/翻译相关资源。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用 React/TypeScript，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL、MySQL 等数据库，常通过 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 23,497 颗星和活跃的社区，Navidrome 已成为自托管音乐流媒体的事实标准，今日再登 Go 日榜第 13 名，持续吸引想摆脱订阅制的用户。
uses: 想搭建私人音乐流媒体服务的自托管爱好者
拥有大量本地音乐收藏、希望随时随地收听的用户
希望用 Subsonic 兼容客户端接入自有音乐库的开发者
想摆脱音乐订阅费用、追求数据自主的普通听众

en.tag: Self-hosted music streaming server — your personal Spotify
en.what: Navidrome is an open-source, web-based music collection server and streamer that lets you listen to your own library from any browser or mobile device. It implements the Subsonic/Airsonic API, so it works with a wide range of existing clients without paying for music subscriptions.
en.content: The repo contains a Go backend service, a web UI frontend, database migration scripts, Docker and multi-platform build configs, plus docs and resources for themes and translations.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go with a React/TypeScript frontend, it supports SQLite, PostgreSQL and MySQL, and is commonly deployed via Docker.
en.hot: With 23,497 stars and an active community, Navidrome has become the de facto standard for self-hosted music streaming, trending again at #13 on the Go daily chart as users look to escape subscriptions.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts who want a private music streaming service
Users with large local music collections who want to listen anywhere
Developers who want to plug their own library into Subsonic-compatible clients
Listeners seeking to escape subscription fees and keep control of their data

zh.tag: 终端里的华丽 AI 编程搭档，支持多模型与 LSP
zh.what: Crush 是一个终端中的 AI 编程助手，将你的工具、代码和工作流无缝接入所选 LLM。它支持多种模型，可在会话中切换并保留上下文，还通过 LSP 增强代码理解。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 应用，提供多模型支持、会话管理、LSP 集成、MCP 扩展，以及跨平台安装脚本和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言开发，构建在 Charm 生态（如 Bubble Tea）之上，依赖 LSP 和 MCP 协议，支持 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API。
zh.hot: 凭借终端原生体验、多模型灵活性和 Charm 生态的可靠性，Crush 已获得 28k+ stars，今日新增 22，位列 Go 日榜第 16。
uses: 终端重度用户 —— 希望在命令行内直接获得 AI 编程辅助
多模型使用者 —— 需要灵活切换不同 LLM 并保留上下文
跨平台开发者 —— 在 macOS、Linux、Windows 等系统上工作
开源贡献者 —— 想要通过 MCP 扩展 AI 能力

en.tag: Glamourous agentic coding in your terminal, with multi-model and LSP support
en.what: Crush is an AI coding assistant in your terminal that wires your tools, code, and workflows into your LLM of choice. It supports multiple models, allows mid-session switching with context preservation, and enhances code understanding via LSP.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI application with multi-model support, session management, LSP integration, MCP extensibility, and cross-platform installation scripts and docs.
en.stack: Built in Go on the Charm ecosystem (e.g., Bubble Tea), relying on LSP and MCP protocols, and supporting OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs.
en.hot: With its terminal-native experience, multi-model flexibility, and Charm ecosystem reliability, Crush has gained 28k+ stars, +22 today, ranking #16 on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Terminal power users — who want AI coding assistance directly in the command line
Multi-model users — who need to switch between LLMs flexibly while preserving context
Cross-platform developers — working on macOS, Linux, Windows, and more
Open-source contributors — who want to extend AI capabilities via MCP

zh.tag: IPFS 官方 Go 实现，内容寻址的分布式存储守护进程
zh.what: Kubo 是 IPFS 协议的第一个也是目前使用最广的实现，用 Go 编写。它作为守护进程运行 IPFS 节点，存储并对外提供内容寻址（CID/DAG）的数据，支持文件与目录、点对点传输和网关访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 源码，涵盖 CLI、HTTP 网关、RPC API、WebUI 集成、FUSE 挂载、mDNS/DHT 发现与 Bitswap 传输等模块，并附有详细文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 libp2p 网络栈、Bitswap、UnixFS、Amino DHT 等 IPFS 生态组件，可编译为跨平台二进制。
zh.hot: 作为 IPFS 的旗舰实现，Kubo 拥有 17k+ stars，是去中心化存储领域的基石项目，长期受到开发者关注。
uses: 去中心化应用开发者，需要内容寻址存储与点对点分发
运维与基础设施工程师，部署 IPFS 节点或网关服务
研究人员与学习者，探索分布式网络与 P2P 协议

en.tag: The original Go implementation of IPFS: a content-addressed storage daemon
en.what: Kubo is the first and most widely used implementation of IPFS, written in Go. It runs an IPFS node as a daemon that stores and serves content-addressed data (CIDs/DAGs), supporting files, directories, peer-to-peer transfer and gateway access.
en.content: The repo contains the full Go source: CLI, HTTP Gateway, RPC API, WebUI integration, FUSE mounts, mDNS/DHT discovery and Bitswap transfer, plus extensive documentation.
en.stack: Primarily Go, built on the libp2p networking stack, Bitswap, UnixFS and Amino DHT from the IPFS ecosystem; compiles to cross-platform binaries.
en.hot: As the flagship IPFS implementation, Kubo has 17k+ stars and is a cornerstone of decentralized storage, keeping it in the developer spotlight.
uses: dApp developers needing content-addressed storage and P2P distribution
DevOps and infrastructure engineers deploying IPFS nodes or gateways
Researchers and learners exploring distributed networks and P2P protocols

zh.tag: 发现、验证并分析泄露凭证的开源密钥扫描工具
zh.what: TruffleHog 是一款强大的密钥发现、分类、验证与分析工具，用于扫描 Git、聊天、Wiki、日志、对象存储和文件系统等位置的泄露凭证。它不仅能识别 800 多种密钥类型，还能主动登录验证密钥是否仍然有效，并对常见凭证类型进行深度权限分析。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心扫描引擎、超过 800 个密钥检测器（位于 pkg/detectors）、命令行工具以及企业版相关文档，支持多种数据源和凭证类型的扫描与验证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 GoReleaser 进行发布，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可证，并集成多种 API 客户端用于凭证验证。
zh.hot: 凭借 27,803 个 Star 和今日新增 38 个 Star，TruffleHog 在 GitHub Go 语言日榜排名第 5，反映出开发者对密钥安全扫描工具的高度关注和需求。
uses: 安全工程师和 DevSecOps 团队用于持续监控代码仓库和基础设施中的凭证泄露
开发者在提交代码前扫描本地文件系统，防止敏感信息意外泄露
企业安全团队利用其验证功能评估泄露凭证的实际风险并优先响应
研究人员分析常见凭证类型的权限和影响范围，用于安全评估和报告

en.tag: Open-source secrets scanner that finds, verifies, and analyzes leaked credentials
en.what: TruffleHog is a powerful secrets discovery, classification, validation, and analysis tool that scans Git, chats, wikis, logs, object stores, and filesystems for leaked credentials. It identifies over 800 secret types, actively verifies whether they are still live, and performs deep analysis on commonly leaked credential types.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based scanning engine, over 800 secret detectors under pkg/detectors, a CLI tool, and enterprise-related documentation, supporting scanning and verification across many data sources and credential types.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, uses GoReleaser for releases, is licensed under AGPL-3.0, and integrates various API clients for credential verification.
en.hot: With 27,803 stars and 38 new stars today, TruffleHog ranks 5th on GitHub's daily Go trending list, reflecting strong developer interest and demand for secrets scanning tools.
uses: Security engineers and DevSecOps teams continuously monitor code repositories and infrastructure for credential leaks
Developers scan local filesystems before committing code to prevent accidental exposure of sensitive information
Enterprise security teams use its validation to assess real risk of leaked credentials and prioritize response
Researchers analyze permissions and impact of common credential types for security assessments and reports

zh.tag: 通用代理平台，一站式网络代理工具箱
zh.what: sing-box 是一个用 Go 编写的通用代理平台，支持 Shadowsocks、VMess、VLESS、Trojan、Hysteria 等多种协议。它提供统一的配置格式和跨平台客户端，可作为服务端或客户端运行，用于科学上网与网络流量转发。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心代理引擎、协议实现、路由与 DNS 模块、命令行工具以及多平台构建脚本，配套文档位于独立站点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖较少，支持 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android 和 iOS 等平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 37,960 颗星和今日 44 颗新增，sing-box 在 Go 日榜排名第 19，其活跃的协议支持和跨平台能力持续吸引代理工具用户。
uses: 需要科学上网或网络代理的普通用户
搭建代理服务端的运维与开发人员
研究网络协议与流量转发的技术爱好者
寻找跨平台代理方案的移动端用户

en.tag: The universal proxy platform for all-in-one networking
en.what: sing-box is a universal proxy platform written in Go, supporting protocols like Shadowsocks, VMess, VLESS, Trojan, and Hysteria. It offers a unified configuration format and cross-platform clients, running as either server or client for proxying and traffic forwarding.
en.content: The repo contains the core proxy engine, protocol implementations, routing and DNS modules, CLI tools, and multi-platform build scripts, with documentation hosted on a separate site.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go with minimal dependencies, supporting Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, and iOS.
en.hot: With 37,960 stars and 44 added today, sing-box ranks 19th on the Go daily trending list, drawing proxy-tool users with its active protocol support and cross-platform reach.
uses: Everyday users needing circumvention or network proxying
DevOps and developers setting up proxy servers
Tech enthusiasts studying network protocols and traffic forwarding
Mobile users seeking a cross-platform proxy solution

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供单点登录与多因素认证的门户
zh.what: Authelia 是一个开源的身份认证服务器，为 Web 应用提供单点登录（SSO）和多因素认证（MFA）功能。它可作为反向代理的认证层，支持 LDAP、OIDC 等集成，并已通过 OpenID 认证，且为后量子密码学做好准备。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心服务、命令行工具、配置示例、文档站点（authelia.com）以及用于构建和测试的 CI/CD 配置。代码结构清晰，包含认证、授权、会话管理等模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多种 Go 库，支持 LDAP、OIDC、TOTP、U2F 等协议。前端可能涉及少量 JavaScript，用于登录页面。
zh.hot: 本月新增 359 星，总星数达 2.88 万，位列 Go 语言趋势榜第 10。其安全性和对现代认证标准的支持吸引了大量自托管和隐私敏感用户。
uses: 自托管服务（如 Nextcloud、Grafana）的统一登录与二次验证
企业或团队内部应用的单点登录，集成现有 LDAP 或 OIDC
希望为 Web 应用添加安全认证层，但不希望使用商业 SSO 的开发者
对后量子密码学感兴趣，希望提前适配未来安全标准的技术团队

en.tag: Single Sign-On and Multi-Factor Authentication portal for web apps
en.what: Authelia is an open-source authentication server providing Single Sign-On (SSO) and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) for web applications. It acts as an authentication layer for reverse proxies, integrates with LDAP and OIDC, and is OpenID Certified and Post-Quantum Cryptography Ready.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, command-line tools, configuration examples, documentation site (authelia.com), and CI/CD setup for building and testing. The code is well-organized into modules for authentication, authorization, session management, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging various Go libraries. Supports LDAP, OIDC, TOTP, U2F, and other protocols. The frontend may include minimal JavaScript for the login page.
en.hot: With 359 new stars this month and a total of 28.8k stars, it ranks 10th on the Go trending list. Its security focus and support for modern auth standards attract many self-hosters and privacy-conscious users.
uses: Centralized login and 2FA for self-hosted services like Nextcloud and Grafana
SSO for internal enterprise apps, integrating with existing LDAP or OIDC
Developers wanting to add secure auth to web apps without commercial SSO
Tech teams interested in post-quantum cryptography readiness

zh.tag: 用 ESP32-CAM 把老式水电气表数字化的边缘 AI 方案
zh.what: 这是一个基于 ESP32-CAM 的边缘计算项目，用摄像头拍摄传统机械式水表、电表、燃气表的读数，再通过本地运行的神经网络识别数字，把模拟表盘变成可联网的智能设备。整个过程在设备端完成，无需上云，成本低、易部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 固件源码（code/）、TensorFlow Lite 模型与训练工具、Web 配置界面、外壳 3D 打印文件、MkDocs 文档以及烧录工具和发布包。
zh.stack: 主语言为 C++，运行在 ESP32 上，集成 TensorFlow Lite Micro 做本地推理，配 Web 前端界面和 SD 卡存储，依赖 ESP-IDF 工具链。
zh.hot: 8731 颗星且今日新增 45，登上 C++ 日榜第一；它把边缘 AI 落到极其实用的抄表场景，硬件便宜、教程完整，吸引了大量 DIY 和物联网爱好者。
uses: 想把家里老式水表/电表/燃气表接入智能家居的 DIY 玩家
做物联网、边缘计算教学或课程项目的师生
需要低成本远程抄表方案的物业或小型公用事业运营者
对 ESP32 与 TensorFlow Lite 嵌入式 AI 感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: Edge AI on ESP32-CAM to digitize old water, gas and power meters
en.what: This is an edge-computing project built on the ESP32-CAM that photographs traditional mechanical water, power and gas meters and uses an on-device neural network to read the digits, turning analog meters into connected smart devices. Everything runs locally without the cloud, keeping it cheap and easy to deploy.
en.content: The repo ships C++ firmware source (code/), TensorFlow Lite models and training tools, a web configuration interface, 3D-printable casing files, MkDocs documentation, plus flashing tools and release packages.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and running on the ESP32, it integrates TensorFlow Lite Micro for on-device inference, with a web frontend and SD-card storage, built on the ESP-IDF toolchain.
en.hot: With 8,731 stars and 45 added today, it tops the C++ daily trending list; it applies edge AI to the very practical task of meter reading, with cheap hardware and thorough docs that appeal to DIY and IoT enthusiasts.
uses: DIY hobbyists wanting to connect old water, power or gas meters to their smart home
Teachers and students doing IoT or edge-computing coursework
Property managers or small utilities needing low-cost remote meter reading
Developers curious about ESP32 and TensorFlow Lite embedded AI

zh.tag: 基于 Citra 的开源 3DS 模拟器，支持 PC 与移动端。
zh.what: Azahar 是一款免费开源的任天堂 3DS 模拟器，旨在让 3DS 玩家在 PC 和移动设备上以更高分辨率、现代控制器支持和即时存档等功能重温游戏库。它也是自制软件开发者的调试中心，以及 3DS 生态的研究与保存平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，主要用 C++ 编写，并提供了 Windows、macOS 和 Android 的构建版本。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 C++ 为核心，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并使用了 Qt 等图形界面库。
zh.hot: 作为 Citra 的延续，Azahar 继承了其成熟技术并持续更新，获得了 8102 颗星，今日新增 12 星，位列 C++ 日榜第 4 名。
uses: 3DS 游戏玩家 —— 在 PC 或手机上以更高画质和便捷功能游玩 3DS 游戏。
自制软件开发者 —— 利用模拟器进行调试和测试。
游戏保存研究者 —— 用于 3DS 生态的研究与保存。

en.tag: An open-source 3DS emulator based on Citra, supporting PC and mobile.
en.what: Azahar is a free and open-source Nintendo 3DS emulator that lets 3DS owners enjoy their game library on PC and mobile with enhancements like higher resolutions, modern controller support, and save states. It also serves as a debugging hub for homebrew developers and a research and preservation platform for the 3DS ecosystem.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, primarily written in C++, with builds available for Windows, macOS, and Android.
en.stack: The tech stack is centered on C++, with CMake as the build system and libraries like Qt for the graphical interface.
en.hot: As a continuation of Citra, Azahar inherits its mature technology and is actively developed, earning 8,102 stars with 12 new stars today, ranking 4th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: 3DS game players — enjoy 3DS games on PC or mobile with enhanced graphics and convenient features.
Homebrew developers — use the emulator for debugging and testing.
Game preservation researchers — for research and preservation of the 3DS ecosystem.

zh.tag: 自托管游戏串流服务端，配合 Moonlight 使用
zh.what: Sunshine 是一个自托管的游戏串流服务端，兼容 Moonlight 客户端。它允许用户将 PC 上的游戏和应用串流到其他设备，支持低延迟和高画质。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建脚本、文档和图标资源。提供多种安装方式，如 Docker、Flatpak、Windows 安装包等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 FFmpeg、CUDA 等编解码库。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上拥有超过 4 万星标，本月新增 1103 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 22 名。其受欢迎程度源于对 NVIDIA GameStream 的替代需求，以及开源社区对自托管串流方案的青睐。
uses: 游戏玩家：将 PC 游戏串流到局域网内的其他设备，如笔记本、手机或电视。
远程办公或学习：远程访问高性能 PC 上的应用，实现移动办公。
开源爱好者：自建串流服务，摆脱对商业服务的依赖，保障隐私和自由度。

en.tag: Self-hosted game streaming host for Moonlight
en.what: Sunshine is a self-hosted game stream host that works with Moonlight clients. It enables users to stream games and applications from their PC to other devices with low latency and high quality.
en.content: The repository contains full C++ source code, build scripts, documentation, and icon assets. Multiple installation methods are available, including Docker, Flatpak, Windows installers, etc.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, relying on FFmpeg, CUDA, and other codec libraries. Supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.hot: With over 40,000 stars and 1,103 new stars this month, ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list, its popularity stems from the need for a replacement for NVIDIA GameStream and the community's preference for self-hosted streaming solutions.
uses: Gamers: stream PC games to other devices on the local network, such as laptops, phones, or TVs.
Remote work or study: remotely access applications on a high-performance PC for mobile productivity.
Open-source enthusiasts: self-host streaming services to avoid commercial dependencies, ensuring privacy and freedom.

zh.tag: 基于 ggml 的纯 C++ 音频推理引擎，无需 Python
zh.what: audio.cpp 是一个高性能的纯 C++ 音频推理框架，基于 ggml 构建，旨在让本地音频模型变得实用、便携且快速。它支持 TTS、STT、VAD、语音转换、音乐生成等多种任务，并可在 Windows、Linux、macOS 上运行，支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Apple Silicon 和纯 CPU。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 推理引擎源码、GGUF 模型加载与优化、Arena 对比 UI、文档和性能报告，以及 Hugging Face 和 ModelScope 上的 GGUF 模型包。
zh.stack: 基于 ggml 张量库，使用纯 C++ 编写，支持 CUDA、Metal、CPU 等多种后端，通过 GGUF 格式加载量化模型，无 Python 依赖。
zh.hot: 今日新增 89 星，总星数达 2590，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 类别第一。其纯 C++ 无 Python 依赖、高性能（CUDA 下 TTS 比 Python 快 1.8-8 倍）和广泛模型支持吸引了大量关注。
uses: 需要在本地部署音频模型（TTS/STT/语音转换）的 C++ 开发者
希望摆脱 Python 环境依赖、追求高性能推理的工程师
在边缘设备或 CPU 上运行音频 AI 的研究人员
需要对比不同音频模型效果的 AI 应用开发者

en.tag: A pure C++ audio inference engine built on ggml, no Python required
en.what: audio.cpp is a high-performance pure C++ audio inference framework built on top of ggml, designed to make local audio models practical, portable, and fast. It supports TTS, STT, VAD, voice conversion, music generation, and more, running on Windows, Linux, macOS with NVIDIA, AMD, Apple Silicon, and CPU-only support.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ inference engine source, GGUF model loading and optimization, an Arena comparison UI, documentation and performance reports, plus GGUF model packages on Hugging Face and ModelScope.
en.stack: Built on the ggml tensor library in pure C++, with support for CUDA, Metal, CPU and other backends, loading quantized models via GGUF format, with no Python dependency.
en.hot: It gained 89 stars today, reaching 2,590 total, and topped GitHub Trending daily for C++. Its pure C++ no-Python approach, high performance (1.8-8x faster TTS on CUDA vs Python), and broad model support attract significant attention.
uses: C++ developers deploying local audio models (TTS/STT/voice conversion)
Engineers seeking high-performance inference without Python dependencies
Researchers running audio AI on edge devices or CPU-only machines
AI app developers comparing different audio model outputs

zh.tag: 开源离网 LoRa 网状通信系统的官方设备固件
zh.what: 这是 Meshtastic 项目的官方设备固件，一个不依赖互联网或蜂窝网络的开源 LoRa 网状网络系统。它让设备在去中心化网络中实现文本消息、位置共享与遥测数据传输，适合户外探险、应急准备和远程作业。
zh.content: 仓库包含面向多种硬件平台的固件源码与构建脚本，支持 ESP32、nRF52、RP2040/RP2350 以及 Linux 设备，并配有 CI 工作流与构建/刷写文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，基于 PlatformIO 构建，依赖各芯片厂商的 SDK 与 LoRa 射频驱动，并通过 GitHub Actions 做持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为离网通信领域最活跃的开源项目之一，它已积累约 8295 颗星，今日再登 GitHub C++ 日榜第 5，说明社区对无网络依赖通信方案持续关注。
uses: 户外探险者与徒步爱好者，在无信号区域保持联络
应急通信与灾难救援团队，搭建不依赖基站的临时网络
物联网与嵌入式开发者，研究 LoRa 网状网络与固件开发
偏远地区或农场作业人员，用于远程遥测与位置共享

en.tag: Official device firmware for the open-source off-grid LoRa mesh communication system
en.what: This is the official device firmware for Meshtastic, an open-source LoRa mesh networking project that works without internet or cellular infrastructure. It enables text messaging, location sharing, and telemetry over a decentralized mesh, ideal for outdoor adventures, emergency preparedness, and remote operations.
en.content: The repo holds firmware source and build scripts for multiple hardware platforms including ESP32, nRF52, RP2040/RP2350, and Linux devices, along with CI workflows and build/flashing documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and built with PlatformIO, relying on vendor SDKs and LoRa radio drivers, with continuous integration via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: As one of the most active open-source off-grid communication projects, it has gathered about 8,295 stars and ranks 5th on today's GitHub C++ trending list, showing sustained interest in network-independent communication.
uses: Outdoor adventurers and hikers who need to stay in touch without cell signal
Emergency and disaster response teams building temporary networks without base stations
IoT and embedded developers exploring LoRa mesh networking and firmware
Remote or farm operators needing telemetry and location sharing

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 把 ESP32 变成支持数十种协议的开源硬件黑客工具
zh.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate 是一款开源固件，受经典 Bus Pirate 启发，把 ESP32 设备变成多协议开发与分析工具。它支持通过串口终端或网页 CLI 对 I2C、UART、SPI、1-Wire 等数字协议进行嗅探、发送、脚本化和交互，同时还能处理蓝牙、Wi-Fi、Sub-GHz 和 RFID 等无线协议。
zh.content: 仓库包含固件源码、Web 刷写器、Web 工具、硬件指南、配方示例和 Wiki 文档，提供 USB 串口与 WiFi 网页两种交互方式，并内置 LittleFS 文件系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 ESP32 平台，依赖 ESP-IDF 或 Arduino 框架，并集成 Web 服务器、LittleFS 文件系统及多种协议驱动库。
zh.hot: 凭借 5809 颗星和今日新增 9 星登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 7 名，其将廉价 ESP32 变成多功能硬件黑客工具的能力吸引了大量嵌入式与安全爱好者。
uses: 硬件安全研究人员和渗透测试人员，用于协议分析与设备调试
嵌入式开发者，快速验证 I2C、SPI、UART 等外设通信
电子爱好者和创客，学习多种数字与无线协议
CTF 选手和物联网安全学习者，进行固件提取与无线攻击实验

en.tag: Open-source firmware turning ESP32 into a multi-protocol hardware hacking tool
en.what: ESP32 Bit Pirate is open-source firmware inspired by the legendary Bus Pirate that turns an ESP32 device into a multi-protocol development and analysis tool. It supports sniffing, sending, scripting, and interacting with digital protocols (I2C, UART, SPI, 1-Wire, etc.) via serial terminal or web-based CLI, and also handles radio protocols like Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Sub-GHz, and RFID.
en.content: The repo contains firmware source, a web flasher, web tools, hardware guides, recipes, and wiki documentation, offering both USB serial and WiFi web interfaces with a built-in LittleFS file system.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ for the ESP32 platform, built on ESP-IDF or Arduino framework, integrating a web server, LittleFS file system, and various protocol driver libraries.
en.hot: With 5,809 stars and 9 added today, it ranks 7th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, attracting embedded and security enthusiasts by turning a cheap ESP32 into a versatile hardware hacking tool.
uses: Hardware security researchers and penetration testers for protocol analysis and device debugging
Embedded developers quickly validating I2C, SPI, UART peripheral communication
Electronics hobbyists and makers learning various digital and wireless protocols
CTF players and IoT security learners conducting firmware extraction and wireless attack experiments

zh.tag: 任天堂 Switch 定制固件，实现自定义系统与虚拟 NAND
zh.what: Atmosphère 是一个针对任天堂 Switch 的开源定制固件项目，通过替换和修改系统各个组件（如引导加载器、TrustZone、系统模块等）来实现自定义功能。它允许用户运行自制软件、备份和虚拟化 NAND 等。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个组件：Fusée（第一阶段加载器）、Exosphère（自定义 TrustZone）、Thermosphère（emuNAND 支持）、Stratosphère（自定义系统模块）、Troposphère（应用程序级补丁），以及相关文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 libnx、devkitA64 工具链、FatFs、hekate 等开源项目。
zh.hot: 作为 Switch 破解社区的核心项目，Atmosphère 拥有近 2 万星标，今日新增 13 星，位列 C++ 日榜第二，持续受到关注。
uses: Switch 破解玩家：用于运行自制软件和备份游戏
安全研究人员：研究 Switch 系统安全与漏洞
自制软件开发者：基于 Atmosphère 开发自定义模块

en.tag: Custom firmware for Nintendo Switch enabling custom OS and emuNAND
en.what: Atmosphère is an open-source custom firmware for the Nintendo Switch that replaces and modifies various system components (such as bootloader, TrustZone, sysmodules) to enable custom features. It allows users to run homebrew, backup and virtualize NAND, and more.
en.content: The repository contains multiple components: Fusée (first-stage loader), Exosphère (custom TrustZone), Thermosphère (emuNAND support), Stratosphère (custom sysmodules), Troposphère (application-level patches), along with documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on libnx, devkitA64 toolchain, FatFs, hekate, and other open-source projects.
en.hot: As a core project in the Switch hacking community, Atmosphère has nearly 20k stars, with 13 added today, ranking second on the C++ daily trending list, showing sustained interest.
uses: Switch hacking enthusiasts: to run homebrew and backup games
Security researchers: to study Switch system security and vulnerabilities
Homebrew developers: to build custom modules based on Atmosphère

zh.tag: Godot 社区分叉的多平台 2D/3D 开源游戏引擎
zh.what: Redot Engine 是一个功能齐全的跨平台游戏引擎，可通过统一界面开发 2D 和 3D 游戏，并一键导出到桌面、移动端、Web 及主机平台。它是 Godot 在 2024 年 9 月分叉出来的独立项目，采用 MIT 许可，完全免费且由社区驱动。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的引擎源码（C++）、编辑器、导出模板与构建脚本，并提供 Nix 构建配置和官方文档，可直接编译或下载二进制运行。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，构建系统基于 SCons，并支持 Nix 一键构建；依赖包括各平台图形与音频库，可导出到 Linux、macOS、Windows、Android、iOS、Web 和主机。
zh.hot: 作为 Godot 的社区分叉，它凭借 MIT 许可、无版税和独立治理吸引了大量关注，目前已获 6062 颗星，今日新增 101 颗，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 日榜第 9 名。
uses: 独立游戏开发者 —— 用统一界面快速制作 2D/3D 游戏并一键多平台发布
Godot 用户与贡献者 —— 希望参与更社区驱动、独立治理的引擎分支
教育与爱好者 —— 借助开源代码和文档学习游戏引擎架构与 C++ 开发
工作室与团队 —— 需要无版税、可自由修改的跨平台游戏引擎方案

en.tag: A community-driven, multi-platform 2D/3D game engine forked from Godot
en.what: Redot Engine is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for building 2D and 3D games from a unified interface, with one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms. It is an independent, community-driven fork of Godot created in September 2024 under the permissive MIT license.
en.content: The repository contains the full engine source (C++), editor, export templates, and build scripts, plus Nix build configuration and official documentation for compiling or running prebuilt binaries.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ with a SCons-based build system and optional Nix one-command builds; it relies on platform graphics/audio libraries and exports to Linux, macOS, Windows, Android, iOS, web, and consoles.
en.hot: As a community fork of Godot, it draws attention for its MIT license, royalty-free terms, and independent governance, now at 6,062 stars with 101 added today, ranking 9th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list.
uses: Indie game developers — build 2D/3D games in a unified interface and publish to multiple platforms with one click
Godot users and contributors — looking for a more community-driven, independently governed engine fork
Educators and hobbyists — learn game engine architecture and C++ through open source code and docs
Studios and teams — need a royalty-free, freely modifiable cross-platform game engine

zh.tag: Linux 上把 PCVR 无线串流到一体机的全开源方案
zh.what: WiVRn 是一个在 Linux 电脑上运行的 OpenXR 串流服务端，把 VR 游戏画面无线推送到独立式 VR 头显。它支持 Quest 1/2/3/Pro、Pico 4、Vive Focus 3 等大量 Android 头显，并可通过 xrizer 或 OpenComposite 兼容 OpenVR/Steam 内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含 PC 端服务端与仪表盘、头显端客户端（APK/商店应用）、Linux 调试客户端，以及打包脚本、CI 配置和文档图片。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，基于 OpenXR 与 Monado 生态，依赖 Avahi 做局域网服务发现，提供 Flatpak 及 Arch/Fedora/NixOS 等原生包。
zh.hot: 在 Linux 上做无线 PCVR 串流的全开源方案极少，WiVRn 填补了这一空白，已积累 1656 颗星，今日再涨 7 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 10。
uses: Linux 桌面用户，想用 Quest/Pico 等一体机无线串流 PCVR 游戏
偏好开源、不愿使用 ALVR 或官方串流的玩家与开发者
需要在 Linux 上调试 OpenXR 应用的 VR 开发者

en.tag: Fully FOSS wireless PCVR streaming from Linux to standalone headsets
en.what: WiVRn is an OpenXR streaming server that runs on a Linux PC and wirelessly pushes VR games to standalone headsets. It supports a wide range of Android-based headsets such as Quest 1/2/3/Pro, Pico 4 and Vive Focus 3, and can run OpenVR/Steam content via xrizer or OpenComposite.
en.content: The repo contains the PC server and dashboard, the headset client (APK/store app), a Linux debug client, plus packaging scripts, CI configs and documentation assets.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++, built on OpenXR and the Monado ecosystem, using Avahi for LAN service discovery, with Flatpak and native packages for Arch/Fedora/NixOS.
en.hot: Fully open-source wireless PCVR streaming on Linux is rare, and WiVRn fills that gap; it has reached 1,656 stars, gaining 7 more today and ranking 10th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who want to wirelessly stream PCVR games to Quest/Pico standalone headsets
Players and developers who prefer open source over ALVR or official streaming tools
VR developers who need to debug OpenXR applications on Linux

zh.tag: 跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成桥接工具
zh.what: OptiScaler 是一款游戏画质增强工具，允许玩家在已支持 DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS 的游戏中替换超分方案，并管理帧生成功能。它还能通过实验性 OptiFG 在 DX12 游戏中启用帧生成，甚至支持 Nukem 模组将 DLSSG 转为 FSR3 帧生成。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 源代码、编译脚本、安装说明、已知问题列表以及详细的 Wiki 文档，并提供稳定版和 nightly 版下载。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 DirectX 12、Vulkan 等图形 API，并涉及 DLSS、FSR、XeSS 等超分技术。
zh.hot: 凭借跨显卡厂商的通用超分与帧生成能力，解决了玩家在非 Nvidia 显卡上无法使用 DLSS 等痛点，已获得 10726 颗星，今日新增 60 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 13 名。
uses: PC 游戏玩家：希望在非 Nvidia 显卡上使用 DLSS 或启用帧生成功能。
游戏模组爱好者：想要自定义游戏画质设置，替换超分方案。
技术研究者：对超分和帧生成技术跨平台实现感兴趣。
低配置玩家：通过帧生成提升游戏流畅度。

en.tag: Universal upscaling and frame generation bridge across GPU vendors
en.what: OptiScaler is a tool that lets you replace upscalers in games already supporting DLSS2+/FSR2+/XeSS, and manage frame generation. It can enable frame generation in DX12 games via experimental OptiFG, and supports the Nukem mod to convert DLSSG to FSR3 frame generation.
en.content: The repo contains C++ source code, build scripts, installation instructions, a known issues list, and detailed Wiki documentation, with stable and nightly releases available.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on graphics APIs like DirectX 12 and Vulkan, and integrates upscaling technologies such as DLSS, FSR, and XeSS.
en.hot: With its cross-vendor upscaling and frame generation capabilities, it solves the pain point of using DLSS on non-Nvidia GPUs, earning 10,726 stars with 60 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily list for C++.
uses: PC gamers: want to use DLSS or enable frame generation on non-Nvidia GPUs.
Game modding enthusiasts: want to customize graphics settings and replace upscalers.
Tech researchers: interested in cross-platform implementations of upscaling and frame generation.
Low-spec players: improve game smoothness through frame generation.

zh.tag: Windows 平台经典开源宏与自动化脚本工具
zh.what: AutoHotkey 是一款免费开源的 Windows 宏创建与自动化工具，通过自定义脚本语言让用户自动化重复性任务。它特别擅长定义键盘快捷键（热键），也能模拟鼠标键盘、操作窗口和发送按键。
zh.content: 仓库包含 AutoHotkey 解释器与编译器的完整 C++ 源码，提供 Visual Studio 解决方案 AutoHotkeyx.sln 及多种构建配置（Debug、Release、Self-contained 等），并支持在 VS Code 中构建调试 v2 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Microsoft Visual Studio 2022（社区版）构建，也可搭配 VS Code 的 C/C++ 扩展与 VS 2022 Build Tools 使用。
zh.hot: 作为拥有 13k+ stars 的老牌自动化工具，AutoHotkey 长期活跃于 GitHub 热榜；今日新增 5 star 并登上 C++ 日榜第 12 名，说明其经典地位与持续需求。
uses: Windows 用户想自动化重复性键鼠操作、批量处理窗口任务
需要自定义全局热键、快捷输入或文本扩展的办公与效率人群
想用脚本快速实现小工具、自动化流程的开发者与爱好者
希望学习或贡献 C++ 开源项目的 Windows 平台开发者

en.tag: The classic open-source macro-creation and automation scripting utility for Windows
en.what: AutoHotkey is a free, open-source macro-creation and automation utility for Windows that lets users automate repetitive tasks. It is driven by a custom scripting language with special support for defining keyboard shortcuts, known as hotkeys, and can also simulate mouse and keyboard input and manipulate windows.
en.content: The repository holds the full C++ source for the AutoHotkey interpreter and compiler, with a Visual Studio solution (AutoHotkeyx.sln) and multiple build configurations (Debug, Release, Self-contained, etc.), plus VS Code support for building and debugging v2.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, built with Microsoft Visual Studio Community 2022, and also buildable/debuggable in VS Code with the C/C++ extension and VS 2022 Build Tools.
en.hot: As a veteran automation tool with over 13k stars, AutoHotkey remains a long-time GitHub trending presence; it gained 5 stars today and ranked 12th on the daily C++ trending list, reflecting its enduring popularity and demand.
uses: Windows users who want to automate repetitive keyboard/mouse tasks and batch window operations
Office and productivity users needing custom global hotkeys, quick input, or text expansion
Developers and hobbyists who want to build small tools or automate workflows with scripts
Windows developers interested in learning from or contributing to a C++ open-source project

zh.tag: 比特币核心客户端：连接P2P网络，验证区块与交易，内置钱包与GUI。
zh.what: Bitcoin Core 是比特币协议的参考实现，作为全节点连接比特币点对点网络，下载并完全验证区块和交易。它还包含一个钱包和可选的图形用户界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心客户端源代码（C++）、构建脚本、测试套件（单元测试和Python功能测试）、文档和翻译文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Boost、OpenSSL、libevent 等库，构建系统支持 autotools 和 cmake，测试使用 Python。
zh.hot: 作为比特币的官方实现，拥有超过9万星标，是区块链领域最受关注的项目之一，今日新增9星，位列C++日榜第8。
uses: 加密货币爱好者与投资者 —— 运行全节点以支持网络并验证交易。
区块链开发者 —— 研究比特币协议或基于其代码进行开发。
企业级应用 —— 集成比特币支付或构建金融服务。
学术研究人员 —— 分析比特币网络与共识机制。

en.tag: Bitcoin Core: connects to P2P network, validates blocks/transactions, includes wallet and GUI.
en.what: Bitcoin Core is the reference implementation of the Bitcoin protocol, serving as a full node that connects to the Bitcoin P2P network to download and fully validate blocks and transactions. It also includes a wallet and an optional graphical user interface.
en.content: The repository contains the core client source code (C++), build scripts, test suites (unit tests and Python functional tests), documentation, and translation files.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with dependencies on Boost, OpenSSL, libevent, etc. Build system supports autotools and cmake, and tests use Python.
en.hot: As the official implementation of Bitcoin, it has over 90k stars, making it one of the most watched projects in blockchain. It gained 9 stars today, ranking 8th on the C++ daily trending list.
uses: Cryptocurrency enthusiasts and investors — run a full node to support the network and verify transactions.
Blockchain developers — study the Bitcoin protocol or build upon its code.
Enterprise applications — integrate Bitcoin payments or build financial services.
Academic researchers — analyze the Bitcoin network and consensus mechanisms.

zh.tag: 免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，让你在 PC 上重温经典游戏。
zh.what: PCSX2 是一个免费开源的 PlayStation 2 模拟器，通过 MIPS CPU 解释器、重编译器和虚拟机来模拟 PS2 硬件。它允许你在 PC 上以更高分辨率和额外功能游玩 PS2 游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，主要使用 C++ 编写，并包含构建脚本、测试和文档。支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建系统，并利用 Qt 等库实现图形界面。需要 PS2 BIOS 转储文件才能运行。
zh.hot: PCSX2 拥有超过 15,000 个 star，是历史最悠久、兼容性最好的 PS2 模拟器之一，持续更新并支持最新游戏，因此备受关注。
uses: 怀旧玩家 —— 想在 PC 上重温 PS2 经典游戏。
游戏保存爱好者 —— 通过模拟器保存和体验老游戏。
开发者 —— 学习模拟器技术和 C++ 开发。

en.tag: Free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator for playing PS2 games on PC.
en.what: PCSX2 is a free and open-source PlayStation 2 emulator that emulates the PS2's hardware using a combination of MIPS CPU interpreters, recompilers, and a virtual machine. It allows you to play PS2 games on your PC with enhanced features and benefits.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, primarily written in C++, along with build scripts, tests, and documentation. It supports Windows, Linux, and macOS platforms.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++ with CMake build system, and utilizes libraries like Qt for the graphical interface. Requires a PS2 BIOS dump to operate.
en.hot: With over 15,000 stars, PCSX2 is one of the oldest and most compatible PS2 emulators, continuously updated to support the latest games, making it highly popular.
uses: Retro gamers — want to replay classic PS2 games on PC.
Game preservationists — preserve and experience old games via emulation.
Developers — learn about emulator technology and C++ development.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源 PSP 模拟器，C++ 编写，无需 BIOS 即可运行
zh.what: PPSSPP 是一款用 C++ 编写的高性能 PSP 模拟器，支持 Android、Windows、Mac、Linux 和 iOS。它采用 HLE（高层模拟）方式，无需 BIOS 文件即可直接运行 PSP 游戏，默认设置兼顾兼容性与速度。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的模拟器源代码，涵盖 CPU 模拟、GPU 渲染、音频、输入、UI 等模块，并附有构建脚本、开发文档和兼容性列表。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 OpenGL、Vulkan、Direct3D 等多种图形后端，并包含平台特定的原生代码。
zh.hot: 作为一款成熟且持续维护的模拟器，PPSSPP 拥有 14,438 颗星，今日新增 11 星，并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 C++ 分类第 15 名，社区活跃度可见一斑。
uses: 想在手机或电脑上重温 PSP 经典游戏的玩家
对模拟器开发、C++ 高性能编程感兴趣的学习者
希望为开源项目贡献代码或测试的开发者

en.tag: A fast, portable, open-source PSP emulator written in C++, no BIOS required
en.what: PPSSPP is a high-performance PSP emulator written in C++, available on Android, Windows, Mac, Linux, and iOS. It uses HLE (High-Level Emulation) so no BIOS file is required, and its default settings balance good compatibility with speed.
en.content: The repository contains the full emulator source code, covering CPU emulation, GPU rendering, audio, input, and UI modules, along with build scripts, development docs, and a compatibility list.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it uses CMake as its build system, supports multiple graphics backends like OpenGL, Vulkan, and Direct3D, and includes platform-specific native code.
en.hot: As a mature and actively maintained emulator, PPSSPP has 14,438 stars with 11 added today, ranking 15th on GitHub Trending's daily C++ list, reflecting strong community activity.
uses: Gamers who want to relive classic PSP titles on mobile or desktop
Learners interested in emulator development and high-performance C++
Developers looking to contribute code or testing to an open-source project

zh.tag: 用 C++ 写的跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它能让玩家在 PC 上运行 PS4 游戏，目前已可成功运行《血源诅咒》《黑暗之魂：重制版》等作品。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心代码（不含 GUI），另有独立的 QtLauncher 图形界面、游戏兼容性列表、截图文档和 Wiki 快速上手指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，图形界面由独立的 Qt 项目提供，支持 Vulkan 等现代图形 API。
zh.hot: 凭借《血源诅咒》等独占大作的 PC 运行潜力，项目已收获 32844 颗星，今日新增 27 星，位列 GitHub C++ 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 想在 PC 上体验《血源诅咒》等 PS4 独占游戏的玩家
对主机模拟器开发感兴趣、想研究 C++ 底层实现的开发者
需要跨平台（Windows/Linux/macOS/FreeBSD）模拟方案的极客用户

en.tag: A cross-platform PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++
en.what: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD. It lets players run PS4 games on PC, and can already boot titles like Bloodborne and Dark Souls Remastered.
en.content: The repo contains the emulator core (no GUI), plus a separate QtLauncher frontend, a game compatibility list, screenshot docs and a Quickstart wiki.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with CMake for building; the GUI is a separate Qt project, and it leverages modern graphics APIs such as Vulkan.
en.hot: With the promise of running exclusives like Bloodborne on PC, it has gathered 32,844 stars, adding 27 today and ranking 16th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list.
uses: Players who want to experience PS4 exclusives like Bloodborne on PC
Developers interested in console emulation and low-level C++ implementation
Geeks needing a cross-platform (Windows/Linux/macOS/FreeBSD) emulation solution

zh.tag: 开源模块化魔兽世界 3.3.5a 服务端框架
zh.what: AzerothCore 是一个开源游戏服务器应用与框架，用于搭建大型多人在线角色扮演游戏（MMORPG）服务端。它基于《魔兽世界》3.3.5a 版本，力求还原原版游戏体验，代码源自 MaNGOS、TrinityCore 与 SunwellCore 并持续深度开发。

zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 MySQL 数据库、CMake 构建系统，并支持 Docker、Windows、macOS 与 Linux 多平台编译。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源魔兽服务端，凭借 8905 颗星与活跃社区长期占据 C++ 热榜，今日再登日榜第 17 名。
uses: 想自建魔兽世界私服的玩家与服务器管理员
学习 MMORPG 服务端架构与网络同步的开发者
希望基于模块系统扩展玩法的 C++ 工程师

en.tag: Open-source modular WoW 3.3.5a server framework
en.what: AzerothCore is an open-source game server application and framework for hosting MMORPGs. Based on World of Warcraft patch 3.3.5a, it recreates the original gameplay experience, with roots in MaNGOS, TrinityCore and SunwellCore plus extensive ongoing development.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ server core source, database scripts, a module system, Docker and multi-platform build configs, plus supporting tools and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on MySQL, CMake, and supports Docker plus Windows, macOS and Linux builds.
en.hot: As a veteran open-source WoW server, it holds 8,905 stars and an active community, ranking 17th on today's C++ trending list.
uses: Players and admins wanting to host their own WoW private server
Developers studying MMORPG server architecture and networking
C++ engineers extending gameplay via the module system

zh.tag: 《过山车大亨2》的开源重制版，跨平台运行经典乐园经营游戏
zh.what: OpenRCT2 是对经典模拟经营游戏《过山车大亨2》的开源重制，让这款老游戏能在现代操作系统上流畅运行。它在保留原作玩法的基础上，加入了多人联机、更高分辨率、新功能与大量修复。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 游戏引擎源码、构建脚本、资源与本地化文件，以及面向玩家的发布版和开发版下载入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake 构建，并需要原版《过山车大亨2》的游戏资源文件才能运行。
zh.hot: 凭借 16,213 颗星和今日新增 5 星登上 GitHub C++ 日榜第 18 名，经典 IP 的开源重制持续吸引怀旧玩家与贡献者。
uses: 怀念《过山车大亨2》的老玩家，想在现代电脑上重温经典
喜欢模拟经营与乐园建造类游戏的休闲玩家
希望参与开源游戏开发、翻译或美术贡献的开发者

en.tag: An open-source re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 for modern platforms
en.what: OpenRCT2 is an open-source re-implementation of the classic simulation game RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, letting the old title run smoothly on modern operating systems. It keeps the original gameplay while adding multiplayer, higher resolutions, new features, and numerous fixes.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ game engine source, build scripts, assets, and localisation files, plus download links for release and development builds.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake for building, and it requires the original RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 asset files to run.
en.hot: With 16,213 stars and 5 added today, it ranks 18th on GitHub's daily C++ trending list, as this classic-IP remake keeps drawing nostalgic players and contributors.
uses: Nostalgic fans of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2 who want to replay it on modern PCs
Casual players who enjoy simulation and park-building games
Developers interested in contributing code, translations, or art to an open-source game

zh.tag: 跨语言列式内存格式与内存分析工具箱
zh.what: Apache Arrow 定义了一套标准化的列式内存格式，并提供多语言库，让不同系统之间可以零拷贝地高效交换和分析数据。它还包括 IPC 序列化格式、Flight RPC 协议和 ADBC 数据库连接接口，是数据生态的底层基础设施。
zh.content: 仓库包含列式格式规范、C++ 核心库、C GLib 绑定、Gandiva LLVM 表达式编译器，以及 Python、Java、Go、JavaScript、Julia、.NET 等多语言实现（部分已独立仓库）。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 实现，依赖 LLVM（Gandiva）、CMake 构建，并提供 C、Python、Java、Go、Rust、JavaScript 等多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为数据领域的基础设施，Arrow 拥有 17k+ stars，本周新增 16 星，位列 C++ 周榜第 20，持续受到数据工程与 AI 生态关注。
uses: 数据工程师与科学家，用于加速跨系统数据交换与分析
数据库与查询引擎开发者，集成 Arrow Flight 或 ADBC 提升性能
AI/ML 工程师，在特征工程与模型训练中高效处理列式数据
多语言开发者，利用 Arrow 库实现跨语言零拷贝数据共享

en.tag: Universal columnar format and multi-language toolbox for in-memory analytics
en.what: Apache Arrow defines a standardized columnar in-memory format and provides multi-language libraries for zero-copy data interchange and in-memory analytics. It also includes the IPC serialization format, Flight RPC protocol, and ADBC database connectivity, serving as foundational infrastructure for the data ecosystem.
en.content: The repo contains the columnar format specification, the C++ core library, C GLib bindings, the Gandiva LLVM expression compiler, and multi-language implementations for Python, Java, Go, JavaScript, Julia, .NET (some now in separate repos).
en.stack: Core is implemented in C++ with LLVM (Gandiva) and CMake, offering bindings for C, Python, Java, Go, Rust, JavaScript, and more.
en.hot: As data infrastructure, Arrow has 17k+ stars, gaining 16 this week and ranking 20th on the C++ trending weekly list, consistently drawing attention from data engineering and AI ecosystems.
uses: Data engineers and scientists accelerating cross-system data exchange and analytics
Database and query engine developers integrating Arrow Flight or ADBC for performance
AI/ML engineers handling columnar data efficiently in feature engineering and training
Multi-language developers sharing data zero-copy across languages with Arrow libraries

zh.tag: 让编程 Agent 先给答案、别绕弯子的输出规范技能
zh.what: 这是一个给编程助手（coding agent）用的输出风格技能，强制它先给行动、再给解释，用编号步骤代替长篇铺垫。它不改变模型能力，只改变回答的组织方式，让结果像给 ADHD 用户看的一样直接。
zh.content: 仓库核心是 skills/i-have-adhd/SKILL.md 里的 10 条规则，外加 INSTALL.md 安装说明、AGENTS.md 给 agent 的指引，以及多语言 README 和 logo。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主语言，本质是 Markdown 技能文件，通过 Claude 插件市场（claude plugin marketplace）安装，可 fork 后自行改规则。
zh.hot: 它精准戳中「AI 回答又长又绕」的痛点，用极简规则给出可感知的前后对比，今日新增 4650 star、总数 34632，直接冲上 GitHub 日榜第一。
uses: 每天被 AI 长回复淹没、只想快速拿到下一步操作的开发者
用 Claude 等 coding agent 写代码、希望输出更紧凑的团队
想自定义 agent 输出规范、愿意 fork 改 SKILL.md 的进阶用户

en.tag: A skill that stops your coding agent from burying the answer
en.what: It's an output-style skill for coding agents that forces action-first answers with numbered steps instead of long preambles. It doesn't change model capability, only how responses are organized, making them ADHD-friendly and to the point.
en.content: The core is a 10-rule SKILL.md under skills/i-have-adhd/, plus INSTALL.md, an AGENTS.md for agents, multilingual READMEs, and a logo.
en.stack: Python is the listed language, but it's essentially a Markdown skill file installed via the Claude plugin marketplace and forkable for custom rules.
en.hot: It nails the pain of bloated AI answers with a simple rule set and a clear before/after demo, gaining 4,650 stars today to 34,632 total and hitting #1 on GitHub Trending.
uses: Developers drowning in long AI replies who just want the next action
Teams using coding agents like Claude who want tighter, more actionable output
Advanced users who want to fork and customize the SKILL.md rules

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 官方 Codex 插件示例与市场
zh.what: 该仓库是 OpenAI 官方的 Codex 插件集合，包含多种插件示例，每个插件都有清单文件和可选配套组件。它提供了默认市场和 API 密钥用户的独立市场，方便用户发现和安装插件。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个插件目录，如 Figma、Notion、iOS/macOS 构建、Web 应用、Expo 等，每个插件包含清单文件及技能、MCP 配置等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript，插件基于 Codex 平台，依赖 JSON 清单和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 作为 OpenAI 官方仓库，吸引了大量开发者关注，今日新增 20 星，总星数超 5400，位列日榜第 15 名。
uses: 开发者想要扩展 Codex 功能，创建自定义插件。
团队需要集成 Figma、Notion 等工具到 AI 工作流。
学习官方插件结构和最佳实践。

en.tag: Official Codex plugin examples and marketplace
en.what: This repository is OpenAI's official collection of Codex plugin examples, each with a manifest and optional companion surfaces. It provides a default marketplace and a separate one for API key users, making it easy to discover and install plugins.
en.content: The repo contains plugin directories for Figma, Notion, iOS/macOS builds, web apps, Expo, etc., each with manifests and optional skills/MCP configs.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, plugins are built on the Codex platform, relying on JSON manifests and MCP protocol.
en.hot: As an official OpenAI repo, it attracts many developers, gaining 20 stars today and over 5400 total, ranking 15th on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers who want to extend Codex with custom plugins.
Teams needing to integrate tools like Figma and Notion into AI workflows.
Learners studying official plugin structure and best practices.

zh.tag: AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，削减 98% 工具输出
zh.what: Context Mode 是专为 AI 编码代理设计的上下文窗口优化工具。它通过沙箱化工具输出（减少 98% 的 token 占用）、持久化会话记忆，并借助 MCP 和 hooks 在 17 个平台间强制路由，从而解决 AI 编程中的“上下文另一半”问题。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 核心库、MCP 服务器、编辑器/平台扩展（如 VS Code、JetBrains）、CLI 工具、hooks 示例及文档。提供 npm 包、GitHub Marketplace 集成，并附带统计徽章与使用指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，依赖 MCP（Model Context Protocol）与平台 hooks，支持 npm 分发与 GitHub Marketplace 安装。
zh.hot: GitHub 星标超 2 万，今日新增 35，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 6。因解决 AI 编码代理的上下文溢出痛点，且被 Microsoft、Google 等大厂团队采用，并登上 Hacker News 榜首。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程工具的开发者，希望减少上下文浪费、提升长任务稳定性。
团队需要跨平台统一管理 AI 代理的上下文与记忆，适用于多 IDE 或 CI 环境。
对 MCP 生态感兴趣，想通过 hooks 定制工具输出过滤与路由的进阶用户。

en.tag: Context optimization layer for AI coding agents, cutting tool output by 98%
en.what: Context Mode is a context window optimization tool for AI coding agents. It sandboxes tool output (98% token reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, addressing the 'other half' of the context problem in AI coding.
en.content: The repo contains a TypeScript core library, MCP server, editor/platform extensions (VS Code, JetBrains, etc.), CLI tools, hooks examples, and docs. Includes npm package, GitHub Marketplace integration, with stats badges and usage guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, relies on MCP (Model Context Protocol) and platform hooks, distributed via npm and GitHub Marketplace.
en.hot: With 20k+ stars and +35 today, ranking #6 on TypeScript daily trending. It solves context overflow for AI coding agents, adopted by teams at Microsoft, Google, etc., and hit #1 on Hacker News.
uses: Developers using AI coding tools like Claude Code or Cursor who want to reduce context waste and improve long-task stability.
Teams needing unified context and memory management across platforms, suitable for multi-IDE or CI environments.
Advanced users interested in MCP ecosystem, wanting to customize tool output filtering and routing via hooks.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理像最懒的高级工程师一样写最少代码
zh.what: Ponytail 是一个 JavaScript 库/技能包，注入到 AI 代理中，使其倾向于生成极简代码，避免过度工程。它通过内置的“懒人”提示和规则，让代理在实现功能时优先使用浏览器原生能力或现有依赖，从而大幅减少代码量、成本和延迟。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库、CLI 工具、基准测试脚本和文档。核心是注入到代理的提示词和规则集，支持 20 多种代理；基准测试展示了在真实仓库上的代码量减少（平均 54%，最高 94%）。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 JavaScript，通过 npm 分发，兼容多种 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）。依赖较少，核心是提示词工程。
zh.hot: 11 万星且日增近千，因为直击 AI 编程痛点：过度工程。它用幽默的“懒人”形象，承诺减少代码量、成本和延迟，且保持安全，引发开发者共鸣。
uses: AI 编程工具使用者：希望减少 AI 生成的冗余代码，提升代码质量。
团队技术负责人：想降低维护成本，让 AI 代理产出更简洁的代码。
对提示工程感兴趣者：学习如何通过提示词约束 AI 行为。

en.tag: Makes your AI agent write minimal code like a lazy senior dev
en.what: Ponytail is a JavaScript library/skill pack that injects a 'lazy senior dev' mindset into AI agents, pushing them to write minimal code and avoid over-engineering. It uses built-in prompts and rules to make agents prefer native browser features or existing dependencies, cutting code volume, cost, and latency.
en.content: The repo contains the core library, CLI tools, benchmark scripts, and docs. The core is a set of prompts and rules injected into agents, supporting 20+ agents; benchmarks show code reduction (mean 54%, up to 94%) on real repos.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, distributed via npm, compatible with 20+ AI agents (e.g., Claude Code). Minimal dependencies, core is prompt engineering.
en.hot: 111k stars with ~1k daily, because it hits the pain point of AI coding: over-engineering. With a humorous 'lazy dev' persona, it promises less code, lower cost, and faster execution while staying safe, resonating with developers.
uses: AI coding tool users: want to reduce redundant code and improve code quality.
Tech leads: aim to lower maintenance costs and get cleaner code from AI agents.
Prompt engineering enthusiasts: learn how to constrain AI behavior via prompts.

zh.tag: AI 代理技能，一键生成可验证的交互式系统架构图
zh.what: Archify 是一个 AI 代理技能，可将代码库或系统描述转化为精美的交互式系统地图。它支持五种图表类型、四种预设、明暗主题和内置品牌标识，并能生成自包含的 HTML 文件，方便演示和分享。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、文档、示例和生成器代码，支持通过 npx 命令安装到 Raven、Cursor、Claude Code 等代理。提供项目页面、场景指南和画廊，展示不同用例。
zh.stack: 主要基于 HTML，使用 TypeScript 生成确定性校验的 JSON IR，并输出 HTML、PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式。依赖 npx 进行安装，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 18k+ 星标和日增千星的势头，Archify 满足了开发者对可视化架构文档的迫切需求，尤其在 AI 辅助开发场景下，能快速生成可验证的图表，提升代码审查和沟通效率。
uses: 开发者希望在代码审查前快速生成架构对比图，确保变更可验证。
技术写作者或架构师需要为系统设计生成交互式演示文档，便于向团队或客户展示。
AI 代理用户希望将代码库映射为可视化图表，以便更直观地理解系统结构和数据流。

en.tag: Agent skill that turns codebases into beautiful, verifiable interactive architecture diagrams
en.what: Archify is an agent skill that transforms a codebase or system description into a polished, interactive system map. It supports five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and built-in brand marks, producing self-contained HTML files for easy presentation and sharing.
en.content: The repository contains skill definitions, documentation, examples, and generator code, installable via npx into agents like Raven, Cursor, and Claude Code. It includes a project page, scenario guide, and gallery showcasing various use cases.
en.stack: Primarily HTML-based, using TypeScript to generate deterministically checked JSON IR, outputting HTML, PNG, SVG, WebM, and more. Installed via npx, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 18k+ stars and a daily gain of 1k, Archify addresses the urgent need for visual architecture documentation, especially in AI-assisted development, enabling quick generation of verifiable diagrams that boost code review and communication efficiency.
uses: Developers who want to quickly generate architecture comparison diagrams before code review to ensure changes are verifiable.
Technical writers or architects needing interactive presentation documents for system designs to share with teams or clients.
AI agent users who want to map codebases into visual diagrams for better understanding of system structure and data flow.

zh.tag: Codex 技能目录，已弃用，迁移至 OpenAI Plugins
zh.what: 这是一个为 Codex 等 AI 代理提供技能（Skills）的目录仓库，技能是包含指令、脚本和资源的文件夹，代理可发现并使用它们来执行特定任务。该仓库已弃用，当前推荐使用 OpenAI Plugins 仓库。
zh.content: 仓库包含 .system、.curated 和 .experimental 三个技能分类目录，每个技能目录内包含指令文件和可选的 LICENSE.txt。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，但技能本身是跨语言的指令和脚本集合，依赖 Codex 环境。
zh.hot: 尽管已弃用，但作为 OpenAI 官方仓库仍获得 25621 星，说明开发者对 Agent Skills 标准和高星仓库的关注度极高。
uses: Codex 用户：安装和使用官方策划的技能，如 gh-address-comments。
技能开发者：参考技能目录结构，学习如何创建自定义技能。
研究 Agent 技能标准：了解 Agent Skills 开放标准及其应用。

en.tag: Deprecated skills catalog for Codex; moved to OpenAI Plugins
en.what: This is a catalog repository of skills for AI agents like Codex. Skills are folders of instructions, scripts, and resources that agents can discover and use to perform specific tasks. The repository is deprecated; users are directed to the OpenAI Plugins repository.
en.content: The repository contains three skill categories: .system, .curated, and .experimental. Each skill folder includes instruction files and an optional LICENSE.txt.
en.stack: Primarily Python, but skills are cross-language instruction and script collections, depending on the Codex environment.
en.hot: Despite being deprecated, it has 25,621 stars, showing high developer interest in Agent Skills standards and official OpenAI repositories.
uses: Codex users: install and use curated skills like gh-address-comments.
Skill developers: reference the catalog structure to create custom skills.
Researchers of agent skill standards: learn about the Agent Skills open standard.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的 HTML 转视频渲染框架
zh.what: HyperFrames 是一个开源框架，可将 HTML、CSS、媒体和可定位动画转换为确定性的 MP4 视频。它支持本地 CLI 使用，也可作为 AI 编码代理的技能，或作为托管创作流程的渲染核心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的框架代码、CLI 工具、技能包（SKILL.md）、文档、示例和展示页面。核心是让代理通过编写 HTML 来生成视频，并支持可定位动画。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，要求 Node.js >= 22，通过 npm 分发，并集成了 AI 代理技能系统（如 Claude 和 Agents skills）。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.4 万+ Star 和每日新增 220 的热度，它精准切中 AI 代理自动生成视频的需求，将 HTML 编写与视频渲染无缝结合，成为 GitHub Trending 上的明星项目。
uses: AI 代理开发者：希望让代理自动生成视频内容，如产品介绍、教程等。
视频创作者：通过编写 HTML 快速生成可定制、确定性的视频，无需传统编辑软件。
自动化工作流：在 CI/CD 或内容管道中集成视频渲染，实现批量生成。
前端开发者：利用熟悉的 HTML/CSS 技能创建动画和视频效果。

en.tag: Open-source framework turning HTML/CSS into deterministic MP4 videos, built for AI agents
en.what: HyperFrames is an open-source framework that converts HTML, CSS, media, and seekable animations into deterministic MP4 videos. It can be used locally via CLI, as skills for AI coding agents, or as the rendering core behind hosted authoring workflows.
en.content: The repository contains the full framework code, CLI tools, skill packages (SKILL.md), documentation, examples, and showcase pages. The core enables agents to generate videos by writing HTML, with support for seekable animations.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, requires Node.js >= 22, distributed via npm, and integrates AI agent skill systems (e.g., Claude and Agents skills).
en.hot: With over 44k stars and 220 daily additions, it precisely meets the demand for AI-agent-driven video generation, seamlessly combining HTML authoring with video rendering, making it a star on GitHub Trending.
uses: AI agent developers: enable agents to automatically generate video content like product intros or tutorials.
Video creators: quickly produce customizable, deterministic videos by writing HTML, without traditional editing software.
Automation workflows: integrate video rendering into CI/CD or content pipelines for batch generation.
Frontend developers: leverage familiar HTML/CSS skills to create animations and video effects.

zh.tag: 微软出品的文件转 Markdown 工具，为 LLM 喂料而生
zh.what: MarkItDown 是一个轻量级 Python 工具，能把 PDF、Office 文档、图片、音频、HTML、ZIP、YouTube 链接等多种格式统一转换成 Markdown。它重点保留标题、列表、表格、链接等文档结构，输出主要面向 LLM 与文本分析管线，而非高保真的人用排版。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 包形式组织，核心是 markitdown 包及其各类格式转换器，另含 CLI 入口、可选依赖分组（如 [all]）与安全注意事项文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.10+，通过 pip 安装，支持 uv/venv/conda 环境，按需引入 PDF、OCR、语音转写等可选依赖。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方项目，它精准踩中 LLM 数据预处理刚需，已积累约 18.2 万 star，本周再增 4579 并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要把大量异构文档转成 Markdown 再喂给 LLM 的 RAG 与数据工程开发者
想快速把 PDF、Word、PPT 转成纯文本做检索或摘要的研究与内容团队
在命令行或脚本里批量处理 Office 文档、图片 OCR、音频转写的自动化用户

en.tag: Microsoft's file-to-Markdown converter built to feed LLMs
en.what: MarkItDown is a lightweight Python utility that converts PDFs, Office documents, images, audio, HTML, ZIP files, YouTube URLs and more into Markdown. It focuses on preserving document structure like headings, lists, tables and links, targeting LLM and text-analysis pipelines rather than high-fidelity human-facing output.
en.content: The repo is organized as a Python package, with the core markitdown package and per-format converters, plus a CLI entry point, optional dependency groups (e.g. [all]) and security documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.10+, installed via pip, compatible with uv/venv/conda, and pulls in optional dependencies for PDF, OCR and speech transcription as needed.
en.hot: As an official Microsoft project, it hits the sweet spot of LLM data preprocessing, racking up about 182k stars, adding 4,579 this week and ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's weekly chart.
uses: RAG and data engineers who need to turn heterogeneous documents into Markdown for LLMs
Research and content teams wanting to convert PDFs, Word and PPT into plain text for search or summarization
Automation users batch-processing Office docs, image OCR and audio transcription from CLI or scripts

zh.tag: 为编码代理打造的技能框架与软件开发方法论
zh.what: Superpowers 是一套面向编码代理的完整软件开发方法论，建立在可组合的 skills 之上，并配有初始指令确保代理自动调用这些技能。它让代理在动手写代码前先厘清需求、产出规格与实现计划，再以子代理驱动的方式逐项完成任务。
zh.content: 仓库以 Shell 脚本和技能定义文件为主，包含安装与集成说明、基础工作流文档、技能目录（What's Inside）以及哲学与贡献指南等部分。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主要语言，围绕 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等多种编码代理 harness 提供插件式安装与技能触发机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 28.4 万 star、日增 688 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，说明开发者对「让编码代理真正按工程方法论工作」的需求极为强烈。
uses: 希望让编码代理遵循 TDD、YAGNI、DRY 等工程规范的开发团队
使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等代理工具并想提升自主开发可靠性的个人开发者
需要在企业环境中引入代理开发流程与商业支持的技术负责人

en.tag: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology for coding agents
en.what: Superpowers is a complete software development methodology for coding agents, built on composable skills plus initial instructions that make sure the agent actually uses them. Instead of jumping straight into code, the agent teases out a spec, produces an implementation plan, then runs a subagent-driven development loop task by task.
en.content: The repo is mostly Shell scripts and skill definition files, including install/integration docs, the basic workflow, a skills catalog (What's Inside), plus philosophy and contributing sections.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, with plugin-style installation and skill-triggering mechanisms across many coding-agent harnesses such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI.
en.hot: With 284k stars, +688 today and #3 on the GitHub Trending daily chart, it shows huge demand for making coding agents actually follow a real engineering methodology.
uses: Dev teams that want coding agents to follow engineering practices like TDD, YAGNI and DRY
Individual developers using Claude Code, Codex or Cursor who want more reliable autonomous coding
Tech leads looking to adopt agent-driven development workflows with enterprise support

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的市场营销技能库
zh.what: 这是一个为 AI 代理（如 Claude Code）设计的营销技能集合，涵盖转化率优化、文案写作、SEO、分析和增长工程。它帮助技术营销人员和创始人利用 AI 编码代理自动执行营销任务，并遵循 Agent Skills 规范。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个 Markdown 格式的技能文件，每个技能提供特定营销任务的框架和最佳实践。技能之间相互引用，以 product-marketing 为基础，其他技能先读取它来了解产品、受众和定位。

zh.tag: 让 AI 编程助手直接操控 Chrome 的 MCP 服务器

zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript，使用 puppeteer 实现浏览器自动化，依赖 Chrome DevTools 前端进行性能追踪，并集成 Google CrUX API 获取真实用户体验数据。

uses: AI 编程助手（如 Claude、Cursor）需要自动化浏览器操作或调试前端代码的开发者
需要分析网页性能、网络请求和 console 错误的 QA 或性能工程师
希望为自定义 AI 工作流集成浏览器控制能力的 MCP 用户
对 Chrome DevTools 自动化感兴趣，想扩展其能力的开发者

en.tag: MCP server that lets coding agents control and inspect Chrome
en.what: chrome-devtools-mcp is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that lets coding agents (like Claude, Cursor, Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It provides performance insights, advanced debugging, and reliable automation, with a CLI for non-MCP use.
en.content: The repo contains the MCP server implementation, a CLI, docs (tool reference, troubleshooting, design principles), and contributing guidelines. Key features include performance tracing, network analysis, screenshots, and console message inspection.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses puppeteer for browser automation, leverages Chrome DevTools frontend for performance tracing, and integrates Google CrUX API for real-user experience data.

QA or performance engineers needing to analyze page performance, network requests, and console errors
MCP users who want to integrate browser control into custom AI workflows
Developers interested in extending Chrome DevTools automation capabilities

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程助手提供 38 种编辑级图表模板

zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得超过 30.9k 星标，今日新增 437 星。它解决了 AI 生成图表质量差的痛点，提供了设计师认可的高质量模板，并持续更新新图表类型。
uses: 开发者使用 Claude Code 或 Codex 生成架构图、流程图等，避免手动调整样式
内容创作者需要快速制作编辑级图表，用于博客、文档或演示
团队希望统一图表风格，通过读取网站自动匹配品牌视觉

en.tag: 38 editorial diagram types for Claude Code, Codex, and Pi
en.what: A skill pack for AI coding assistants like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, offering 38 editorial-quality diagram types. It generates self-contained HTML+SVG files with no build step or external dependencies, emphasizing a clean design without shadows or Mermaid-style output.

en.stack: Primarily HTML and SVG, with no JavaScript or external image dependencies. Designed to work with AI agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Pi, and compatible with Agent Skills.
en.hot: The repo has gone viral on GitHub with over 30.9k stars and 437 stars today. It addresses the pain point of low-quality AI-generated diagrams by offering designer-approved templates, and it continuously adds new diagram types.
uses: Developers using Claude Code or Codex to generate architecture diagrams, flowcharts, etc., without manual styling
Content creators needing quick editorial-quality diagrams for blogs, docs, or presentations
Teams wanting consistent diagram styling, with automatic brand matching by reading a website

zh.tag: 一键开启沉浸式多智能体课堂

AI 开发者：研究多智能体协作与交互，参考其架构和实现。
学习者：通过沉浸式多智能体对话，获得个性化学习体验。
开源爱好者：部署和定制自己的智能体课堂，参与社区贡献。

en.tag: One-click immersive multi-agent learning classroom
en.what: OpenMAIC is an open-source multi-agent interactive classroom platform that provides an immersive learning experience with one click. It simulates a real classroom where multiple AI agents play different roles (e.g., teacher, students) to conduct interactive teaching.
en.content: The repo includes frontend UI (Next.js/React), backend logic (LangGraph orchestration), agent configurations, deployment templates (Vercel), documentation, and community resources. Supports OpenClaw integration and Lemonade local AI.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, using Next.js 16, React 19, LangGraph 1.1, and supports multiple LLM providers (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic) via API keys.

AI developers: Study multi-agent collaboration and interaction, referencing its architecture and implementation.
Learners: Gain personalized learning experiences through immersive multi-agent dialogues.
Open-source enthusiasts: Deploy and customize their own agent classroom, contributing to the community.

Developers — integrate into agent workflows to automatically optimize AI-generated text output
Academic writers — ensure AI-assisted content in papers or reports reads more naturally

zh.tag: 清除 20+ 种 AI 味套路的写作编辑技能

en.tag: A writing skill that strips 20+ patterns of AI slop
en.what: No AI Slop is a skill you install into ChatGPT, Claude Code, Codex, or other coding agents to detect and remove telltale AI writing patterns like "It's not X. It's Y." It cleans up the slop while trying to preserve your own vocabulary, cadence, and voice.
en.content: The core is skills/no-ai-slop/SKILL.md (editing rules and workflow) plus eval.md (self-check list), alongside .codex-plugin/plugin.json plugin metadata and build_plugin.py for packaging and validation.
en.stack: Python powers the build and validation scripts, while the skill itself ships as Markdown rule files installed via npx skills or a pasted prompt, running inside a host agent.
en.hot: It gained 1,056 stars this week for 7,851 total and hit #20 on GitHub Trending, showing how many writers are fed up with same-sounding AI prose.
uses: Content creators and bloggers polishing drafts to remove obvious AI tone
Writers who edit with ChatGPT or coding agents but want to keep their own voice
Editors and reviewers who need to quickly flag AI-slop patterns in a text
Users who want to satirically generate the cringiest possible AI slop

zh.tag: GitHub 官方的规格驱动开发工具包，让任意 AI 编码代理先写规格再写代码
zh.what: Spec Kit 是 GitHub 开源的一套规格驱动开发（Spec-Driven Development）工具包，主张在动手写代码之前先把「要构建什么」定义清楚。它提供一套开箱即用的流程，也可以接入你自己的流程，并支持与各类 AI 编码代理配合使用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 编写的 Specify CLI 为核心，配套文档站点、扩展与预设（Extensions & Presets）、面向角色的 Bundles 方案，以及各 AI 编码代理的集成说明。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 Specify CLI 分发；依赖 GitHub Releases 与 GitHub Pages 文档，并适配多家 AI 编码代理的集成接口。
zh.hot: 背靠 GitHub 官方、主打与 AI 编码代理协作的规范流程，发布一年即达 1.0.0，累计约 13.6 万 star，今日再涨 1015 并登上日榜第 15 名。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Copilot 等 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望先定规格再生成代码
团队负责人想统一需求、设计与实现之间的协作流程
想用扩展和预设把 Spec Kit 改造成自家研发规范的组织
需要评估新想法或修复缺陷时，用规格流程做结构化拆解的工程师

en.tag: GitHub's spec-driven development toolkit that makes any AI coding agent define specs before writing code
en.what: Spec Kit is GitHub's open source toolkit for Spec-Driven Development, which puts defining what to build before building it. It ships a ready-to-use process (or lets you bring your own) and works with any AI coding agent.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python-based Specify CLI, plus a docs site, extensions and presets, role-based bundles, and integration guides for various AI coding agents.
en.stack: Primarily Python, distributed via the Specify CLI; it relies on GitHub Releases and GitHub Pages docs, and adapts to multiple AI coding agent integrations.
en.hot: Backed by GitHub and pitched as a spec-first workflow for AI coding agents, it hit 1.0.0 in its first year and now sits at ~135.8k stars, gaining 1,015 today for #15 on the daily trending list.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Copilot who want specs before code
Team leads aiming to unify requirements, design, and implementation workflows
Organizations wanting to customize Spec Kit via extensions and presets for their own standards
Engineers who want a structured spec process for assessing ideas or fixing bugs

zh.tag: 面向多任务并行的 AI 代理舰队编排发行版
zh.what: firstmate 让你只与一个「大副」代理对话，由它自动派出并监督多个自主编码代理，各自在独立 git worktree 中并行完成修复、调研、规划与审计任务。它不安装应用，克隆下来的仓库本身就是发行版，任何终端编码代理都能按其中的指令运行。
zh.content: 仓库由 AGENTS.md 指令、内置 firstmate 技能和辅助脚本组成，配合 tmux、Herdr、zellij、cmux、Orca 等可见会话后端，以及 treehouse 管理的临时 worktree。
zh.stack: 以 Shell 为主，依赖 tmux 等终端复用器与 git worktree 机制，支持 macOS 与 Linux，可通过 SSH 扩展到其他主机。
zh.hot: 本周新增 778 星、总数 5747 星并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 23 名，反映出开发者对多代理并行编排这一痛点的强烈需求。
uses: 需要同时推进多个编码任务的独立开发者，用大副统一调度避免多标签页切换
希望让代理并行修复、调研和审计同一仓库的工程团队
想用 SSH 把代理舰队扩展到多台主机的进阶用户
研究多代理编排与代理发行版模式的技术爱好者

en.tag: An agent distro for orchestrating a crew of parallel coding agents
en.what: firstmate lets you talk to a single 'first mate' agent that spawns and supervises a crew of autonomous coding agents, each working in its own git worktree on parallel fixes, investigations, plans, and audits. There is no app to install: the cloned repo itself is the distro, and any terminal coding agent can follow its instructions.
en.content: The repo contains AGENTS.md instructions, bundled firstmate skills, and helper scripts, paired with visible session backends like tmux, Herdr, zellij, cmux, and Orca, plus treehouse-managed disposable worktrees.
en.stack: Primarily Shell, relying on terminal multiplexers like tmux and git worktree mechanics, supporting macOS and Linux with optional SSH extension to other hosts.
en.hot: With 778 new stars this week and 5,747 total, ranking 23rd on GitHub Trending weekly, it reflects strong demand for solving the pain of juggling multiple parallel agents.
uses: Solo developers juggling multiple coding tasks who want one liaison to dispatch and supervise
