zh.stack: 主要语言为 TypeScript；依赖各 AI 编码工具（如 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等）的接口，遵循 AI-DLC 2.0 规范（含白皮书）。
zh.hot: AWS 官方出品，将 AI 代理从单点工具升级为可治理的完整开发生命周期，契合企业级 AI 工程化需求。4.3k stars 且持续增长，登上 TypeScript 趋势榜。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程助手的开发者，希望获得结构化、可审查的开发流程
技术负责人或平台团队，需要统一不同 AI 工具的工作流规范，确保代码质量与合规
对 AI 驱动开发方法论感兴趣的研究者，可参考其 14 代理、33 阶段的编排设计

en.tag: One harness-neutral core, many harnesses: AI agents as verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows
en.what: AI-DLC Workflows turns AI coding agents into verifiable, self-correcting engineering workflows. Based on the AI-DLC methodology, it provides a 14-agent roster (11 domain experts, 2 review-only agents, and an adaptive-workflows composer) working through a 33-stage workflow with human approval at every gate.
en.content: The repository includes a harness-neutral core/ directory defining the methodology, plus thin adapters for Claude Code, Kiro IDE/CLI, Codex CLI, Cursor, opencode, and GitHub Copilot, generating distributions for each harness from a single source.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript; interfaces with various AI coding tools (Claude Code, Codex CLI, etc.), following the AI-DLC 2.0 Specification (including whitepaper).
en.hot: Official AWS project that elevates AI agents from point tools to a governed full development lifecycle, meeting enterprise AI engineering needs. 4.3k stars and growing, trending on TypeScript daily.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Cursor who want a structured, reviewable development process
Tech leads or platform teams needing to unify workflow standards across different AI tools for quality and compliance
Researchers interested in AI-driven development methodologies, referencing its 14-agent, 33-stage orchestration design

zh.tag: 开放代理技能生态的 CLI 工具，让技能即插即用
zh.what: skills 是一个命令行工具，用于安装、使用和管理 AI 编码代理的技能（skills）。它支持 OpenCode、Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等 80 多种代理，通过 npx 即可快速添加或直接运行技能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 TypeScript 源码、CLI 入口、技能解析与安装逻辑，以及文档和示例。核心是 skills 命令行工具，支持从 GitHub、GitLab、本地路径等多种来源添加技能。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 和 Node.js 构建，通过 npx 分发。依赖 Git 进行仓库操作，并集成 GitHub CLI 等认证方式。
zh.hot: 凭借 Vercel 品牌影响力和对多代理生态的广泛支持，该项目迅速获得 30k+ stars。今日新增 125 星，位列 TypeScript 日榜第 10，反映出开发者对标准化代理技能管理的强烈需求。
uses: AI 编码代理用户 —— 快速为 Claude Code、Cursor 等代理添加新技能
技能开发者 —— 发布和分享可复用的代理技能包
团队协作 —— 统一管理项目所需的代理技能，确保环境一致
探索者 —— 无需安装即可试用技能，通过 npx skills use 生成提示

en.tag: The CLI for the open agent skills ecosystem, making skills plug-and-play
en.what: skills is a CLI tool for installing, using, and managing skills for AI coding agents. It supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 80+ other agents, enabling quick addition or direct execution of skills via npx.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, CLI entry points, skill resolution and installation logic, plus documentation and examples. At its core is the skills CLI, supporting skill addition from GitHub, GitLab, local paths, and more.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript and Node.js, distributed via npx. It relies on Git for repository operations and integrates authentication methods like GitHub CLI.
en.hot: With Vercel's brand influence and broad support for multiple agent ecosystems, the project quickly gained 30k+ stars. Adding 125 stars today and ranking 10th on the TypeScript daily chart, it reflects strong developer demand for standardized agent skill management.
uses: AI coding agent users — quickly add new skills to agents like Claude Code and Cursor
Skill developers — publish and share reusable agent skill packages
Team collaboration — uniformly manage project-required agent skills for consistent environments
Explorers — try skills without installation by generating prompts via npx skills use

zh.tag: 微软开源的跨平台代码编辑器，全球开发者主力工具
zh.what: Visual Studio Code 是微软与社区共同开发的开源代码编辑器，覆盖编辑、构建、调试的完整核心流程。它提供强大的代码编辑、导航与理解能力，支持轻量调试和丰富的扩展模型，并按月发布新功能与修复。
zh.content: 仓库即 Code - OSS 源码本体，包含编辑器核心实现、扩展机制与构建脚本，并在 Wiki 中公开路线图、月度迭代计划和 endgame 计划。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主语言，基于 Electron 构建跨平台桌面应用，依赖 Node.js 生态与自研的 Monaco 编辑器内核。
zh.hot: 作为全球使用最广的编辑器之一，它以 19.2 万 star 稳居头部，本周新增 1679 star 并登上 TypeScript 周榜第 11 名，热度来自持续的月度更新与庞大社区。
uses: 日常写代码的开发者，用来编辑、调试和运行各类项目
插件作者，基于其扩展 API 开发语言支持与工具集成
想参与开源贡献的工程师，可提交 bug、功能请求或 PR
团队与教育场景，用作统一、免费且跨平台的开发环境

en.tag: Microsoft's open-source cross-platform code editor, a daily driver for developers worldwide
en.what: Visual Studio Code is an open-source code editor developed by Microsoft together with the community, covering the core edit-build-debug cycle. It offers comprehensive code editing, navigation and understanding, plus lightweight debugging and a rich extensibility model, with monthly feature and bug-fix releases.
en.content: The repo is the Code - OSS source itself, containing the editor core, extension mechanism and build scripts, with roadmaps, monthly iteration plans and endgame plans published in the Wiki.
en.stack: Primarily written in TypeScript and built on Electron for cross-platform desktop apps, relying on the Node.js ecosystem and the in-house Monaco editor core.
en.hot: As one of the most widely used editors, it holds 192k stars and gained 1,679 this week, ranking 11th on the TypeScript weekly trending list thanks to continuous monthly updates and a huge community.
uses: Everyday developers editing, debugging and running projects of all kinds
Extension authors building language support and tooling on its extension API
Engineers wanting to contribute to open source via bugs, feature requests or PRs
Teams and educators needing a unified, free and cross-platform dev environment

zh.tag: 开源 AI 编程代理，终端与桌面双形态
zh.what: OpenCode 是一个开源的 AI 编程代理，可在终端或桌面应用中运行，帮助开发者自动完成编码任务。它通过自然语言交互理解代码上下文，执行代码生成、修改和调试等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含终端 UI、桌面应用（Beta）、控制台等多个包，提供安装脚本和多种包管理器支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，依赖 Node.js 生态，可通过 npm、bun、pnpm、yarn 等安装，也提供 Homebrew、Scoop、Choco 等系统包管理器支持。
zh.hot: 凭借开源、跨平台和易安装的特性，OpenCode 在 GitHub 上已获得超过 20 万星标，本周新增 3133 星，位列 TypeScript 周榜第 7 名。
uses: 开发者 —— 在终端中快速调用 AI 辅助编码，提升日常开发效率。
团队协作 —— 统一使用开源代理工具，便于定制和集成到现有工作流。
开源爱好者 —— 研究 AI 编程代理的实现，参与贡献或二次开发。
跨平台用户 —— 在 macOS、Windows、Linux 上通过包管理器一键安装使用。

en.tag: The open source AI coding agent for terminal and desktop
en.what: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that runs in the terminal or as a desktop app, helping developers automate coding tasks. It understands code context through natural language interaction and performs code generation, modification, and debugging.
en.content: The repository includes multiple packages such as terminal UI, desktop app (Beta), and console, with installation scripts and support for various package managers.
en.stack: Primarily built with TypeScript, relying on the Node.js ecosystem, installable via npm, bun, pnpm, yarn, and also supported by system package managers like Homebrew, Scoop, and Choco.
en.hot: With its open source, cross-platform, and easy installation features, OpenCode has gained over 200k stars on GitHub, adding 3,133 stars this week and ranking 7th on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Developers — quickly invoke AI-assisted coding in the terminal to boost daily development efficiency.
Teams — adopt a unified open source agent tool for easy customization and integration into existing workflows.
Open source enthusiasts — study the implementation of AI coding agents, contribute, or build upon it.
Cross-platform users — install and use via package managers on macOS, Windows, and Linux.

zh.tag: 开源 LLM 应用开发平台，可视化编排 Agent 与 RAG 工作流
zh.what: Dify 是一个开源的 LLM 应用开发平台，让团队通过可视化画布编排 Agentic 工作流、RAG 管道和工具调用。它支持云端、VPC 或自托管部署，帮助团队从原型平滑过渡到生产环境而无需重建技术栈。
zh.content: 仓库包含前端 Web 应用、后端 API 服务、工作流引擎、插件与工具集成、Docker 部署配置以及多语言文档，整体是一个可自托管的全栈平台。
zh.stack: 以 TypeScript 为主，前端基于 React/Next.js，后端使用 Python（Flask/Celery），依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis、向量数据库与 Docker/Kubernetes 部署。
zh.hot: 作为 LLM 应用编排领域的头部开源项目，Dify 已积累超过 15.5 万 star，本周新增 1072 星并登上 TypeScript 周榜第 13 名，热度源于企业级 Agent 与 RAG 落地需求持续高涨。
uses: AI 应用开发者：快速搭建和迭代基于 LLM 的对话、Agent 与 RAG 应用
企业技术团队：需要私有化或 VPC 部署、数据可控的 AI 平台
产品与业务人员：通过可视化编排低成本验证 AI 产品原型
初创公司与独立开发者：用开源方案替代昂贵的闭源 LLM 平台

en.tag: Open-source LLM app platform for visually building agentic workflows and RAG pipelines
en.what: Dify is an open-source LLM application development platform where teams visually orchestrate agentic workflows, RAG pipelines and tool calls. It supports cloud, VPC or self-hosted deployment, letting teams move from prototype to production without rebuilding their stack.
en.content: The repo contains a frontend web app, backend API service, workflow engine, plugin and tool integrations, Docker deployment configs and multilingual docs — a full self-hostable stack.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript with a React/Next.js frontend and a Python (Flask/Celery) backend, depending on PostgreSQL, Redis, vector databases and Docker/Kubernetes deployment.
en.hot: As a leading open-source project in LLM app orchestration, Dify has passed 155K stars, adding 1,072 this week to rank 13th on the TypeScript trending list, driven by surging enterprise demand for agents and RAG.
uses: AI app developers: quickly build and iterate LLM-based chat, agent and RAG apps
Enterprise teams: needing private or VPC-deployed AI platforms with data control
Product and business users: validating AI prototypes cheaply via visual orchestration
Startups and indie developers: replacing costly closed-source LLM platforms with an open-source option

zh.tag: 基于 WebGPU 的 3D 建筑编辑器，支持分享与本地运行。
zh.what: Pascal Editor 是一个使用 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU 构建的 3D 建筑编辑器，允许用户创建和分享建筑项目。它提供了完整的编辑工具、3D 渲染运行时，并支持通过 CLI 在本地运行。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Turborepo monorepo，包含 Next.js 应用、核心包（core）、查看器（viewer）、编辑器（editor）、节点定义（nodes）、CLI 和 MCP 服务器等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 React Three Fiber 和 WebGPU，采用 Turborepo 管理 monorepo，并发布多个 npm 包。
zh.hot: 凭借 WebGPU 带来的高性能 3D 渲染和便捷的本地运行方式，项目在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 22k+ 星标，今日新增 168 星。
uses: 建筑师和设计师：快速创建和分享 3D 建筑概念模型。
开发者：在 React 应用中集成 3D 编辑器或查看器。
教育工作者：用于教学演示或学生项目。

en.tag: A WebGPU-powered 3D architectural editor for creating and sharing projects.
en.what: Pascal Editor is a 3D building editor built with React Three Fiber and WebGPU, enabling users to create and share architectural projects. It offers a full editing toolset, a 3D rendering runtime, and can be run locally via CLI.
en.content: The repository is a Turborepo monorepo containing a Next.js app, core packages (core, viewer, editor, nodes), CLI, and MCP server.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on React Three Fiber and WebGPU, managed as a Turborepo monorepo, and published as multiple npm packages.
en.hot: With high-performance 3D rendering via WebGPU and easy local setup, the project has gained 22k+ stars, including 168 today.
uses: Architects and designers: quickly create and share 3D architectural concepts.
Developers: integrate the 3D editor or viewer into React applications.
Educators: use for teaching demonstrations or student projects.

zh.tag: 开源跨平台影视聚合播放器，多源搜索与在线播放
zh.what: MoonTV 是一个基于 Next.js 14 构建的影视聚合播放器，支持多资源搜索、在线播放、收藏同步、播放记录和云端存储。它提供 PWA 支持，可安装到桌面或移动端，并具备响应式布局和智能去广告功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Next.js 应用源码，包括前端界面、API 路由、播放器集成（ArtPlayer/HLS.js）、存储适配（Kvrocks/Redis）以及 Docker 部署配置。项目还提供 Zeabur 一键部署模板和详细的配置文件示例。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Next.js 14 (App Router)、Tailwind CSS 3、TypeScript 4，播放器使用 ArtPlayer 和 HLS.js，存储支持 Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash，部署依赖 Docker。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 日榜排名第 5，今日新增 197 星，总星数近万，因其功能全面、部署便捷且完全开源，吸引了大量影视爱好者和自托管用户。
uses: 适合喜欢自托管影视服务的用户，可自行部署并收集播放源。
适合开发者学习 Next.js 14 全栈开发、PWA 及流媒体播放器集成。
适合希望拥有跨平台（桌面/移动/Android TV）统一观影体验的个人用户。

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform movie/TV aggregator player with multi-source search and online playback
en.what: MoonTV is a movie/TV aggregator player built with Next.js 14, supporting multi-source search, online playback, favorites sync, watch history, and cloud storage. It offers PWA support for installation on desktop/mobile, responsive layout, and smart ad-blocking.
en.content: The repository contains the full Next.js application source code, including frontend UI, API routes, player integration (ArtPlayer/HLS.js), storage adapters (Kvrocks/Redis), and Docker deployment configs. It also offers a Zeabur one-click deploy template and detailed config file examples.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Next.js 14 (App Router), Tailwind CSS 3, TypeScript 4, players ArtPlayer and HLS.js, storage via Kvrocks/Redis/Upstash, and deployment via Docker.
en.hot: Ranked #5 on GitHub Trending daily, gaining 197 stars today to reach ~9.7k total, this project attracts movie enthusiasts and self-hosters due to its comprehensive features, easy deployment, and full open-source nature.
uses: Ideal for users who prefer self-hosting media services and want to deploy their own aggregator with custom sources.
Great for developers learning Next.js 14 full-stack development, PWA implementation, and streaming player integration.
Perfect for individuals seeking a unified cross-platform viewing experience (desktop, mobile, Android TV) with sync features.

zh.tag: Proxmox 环境的开源 vCenter 替代品，单窗格管理多集群
zh.what: ProxCenter 是面向 Proxmox VE 与 Proxmox Backup Server 的现代化 Web 管理平台，定位为 VMware vCenter 的替代方案。它让用户通过单一界面统一监控、管理和优化多个 Proxmox 集群与备份实例。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 编写的前端 UI，包含模块化仪表盘、多集群管理、跨虚拟化迁移与负载均衡等界面，并提供 Docker Compose 安装脚本与文档、演示站链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，通过 Docker Compose 部署，依赖 PostgreSQL 与持久化卷，安装后监听 3000 端口，并集成 CodeQL、SonarCloud 等安全质量扫描。
zh.hot: VMware 被博通收购后授权成本飙升，大量用户转向 Proxmox，ProxCenter 恰好补上企业级管理界面缺口，本周新增 312 star 冲上 TypeScript 周榜第 18 名。
uses: 从 VMware 迁移到 Proxmox 的企业 IT 运维团队，需要类 vCenter 的统一管理体验
同时运维多个 Proxmox VE 集群与备份服务器的管理员，希望单点监控与操作
需要跨虚拟化迁移与工作负载均衡能力的中大型数据中心运维人员
想自建私有云管理面板、偏好开源方案的中小团队与技术爱好者

en.tag: An open-source vCenter alternative for Proxmox, managing clusters from one pane of glass
en.what: ProxCenter is a modern web management platform for Proxmox VE and Proxmox Backup Server, positioned as an alternative to VMware vCenter. It lets users monitor, manage and optimize multiple Proxmox clusters and backup instances from a single pane of glass.
en.content: The repo holds a TypeScript front-end UI with a modular dashboard, multi-cluster management, cross-hypervisor migration and workload balancing screens, plus Docker Compose install scripts, docs and demo links.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, deployed via Docker Compose with PostgreSQL and persistent volumes, serving on port 3000, with CodeQL and SonarCloud security/quality scanning integrated.
en.hot: With Broadcom's VMware acquisition driving up licensing costs, many users are migrating to Proxmox, and ProxCenter fills the enterprise management UI gap—adding 312 stars this week to rank 18th on the TypeScript weekly trending list.
uses: Enterprise IT ops teams migrating from VMware to Proxmox who need a vCenter-like unified experience
Admins running multiple Proxmox VE clusters and backup servers who want single-pane monitoring and control
Mid-to-large datacenter operators needing cross-hypervisor migration and workload balancing
Small teams and enthusiasts who prefer an open-source, self-hosted private cloud management panel

zh.tag: 为AI代理打造的隐身无头浏览器，绕过反爬检测
zh.what: camofox-browser 是一个基于 Camoufox（Firefox 分支）的防检测浏览器服务器，专为 AI 代理设计。它通过 C++ 级别的指纹伪装绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 供代理使用，可作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代品。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的浏览器服务器实现，提供 REST API、元素引用、会话隔离、Cookie 导入、文件上传、代理支持等功能。附带启动脚本和 npm 包，易于集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 和 Node.js，核心引擎是 Camoufox（Firefox 的 C++ 级补丁），通过 REST API 暴露功能。依赖 npm 生态，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 在 AI 代理需要访问真实网页但常被反爬拦截的背景下，该仓库提供了有效的解决方案，今日新增 117 星，总星数达 9236，登上 JavaScript 趋势榜第六。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要让代理访问受保护网站（如搜索、社交媒体）时，可集成此浏览器绕过检测。
数据采集工程师：用于爬取 Cloudflare 保护的网站，替代易被识别的无头浏览器。
自动化测试人员：作为 Puppeteer/Playwright 的替代，进行需要真实浏览器指纹的测试。
个人 AI 助手项目：如 jo，需要稳定、低内存的浏览器后端。

en.tag: Stealth headless browser for AI agents, bypassing bot detection
en.what: camofox-browser is an anti-detection browser server for AI agents, built on Camoufox (a Firefox fork). It bypasses Cloudflare and bot detection via C++-level fingerprint spoofing, and offers a REST API for agents, serving as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright.
en.content: The repository contains a full browser server implementation with REST API, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, file upload, proxy support, and more. It includes startup scripts and an npm package for easy integration.
en.stack: Built on JavaScript and Node.js, powered by Camoufox (a C++-patched Firefox fork), exposing functionality via REST API. Leverages npm ecosystem and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: With AI agents needing to browse real websites but often blocked by anti-bot measures, this repo offers a working solution, gaining 117 stars today and reaching 9236 total, ranking #6 on the JavaScript trending list.
uses: AI agent developers: integrate this browser to access protected sites (e.g., search, social media) while bypassing detection.
Data scraping engineers: use it to crawl Cloudflare-protected websites, replacing easily fingerprintable headless browsers.
Automation testers: as a drop-in replacement for Puppeteer/Playwright for tests requiring real browser fingerprints.
Personal AI assistant projects: like jo, needing a stable, low-memory browser backend.

zh.tag: 把各类 AI 编程工具接到 40+ 免费/廉价模型上的智能路由与省 token 网关
zh.what: 9Router 是一个本地运行的 AI 路由网关，把 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Cline、Copilot 等编程工具统一接到 40+ 家供应商、100+ 模型上。它通过订阅→廉价→免费的自动降级、多账号轮询和 RTK token 压缩，让开发者尽量不撞限额、少花钱。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 JavaScript 项目，核心是本地路由服务（默认 http://localhost:20128/v1）与 Web 仪表盘，包含 RTK token 压缩、格式转换（OpenAI ↔ Claude）、配额追踪与自动刷新等模块，并提供 npm 包、Docker 镜像与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，以 npm 包和 Docker/ GHCR 镜像分发，对外暴露 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1 接口，依赖各 AI 供应商的 API 与订阅凭证。

en.content: The repository contains the main userscript file (main.user.js), dictionary files (locals.js), a VS Code extension directory (vscode-extension), and multilingual README documents.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, it relies on userscript managers like Tampermonkey and supports major browsers including Chrome, Firefox, and Safari, with an additional VS Code extension.
en.hot: With 32,709 stars and 485 new stars this week, it ranks 16th on GitHub Trending (JavaScript weekly), popular for removing language barriers for Chinese users.
uses: Chinese developers — want to browse GitHub in their native language to lower the barrier.
GitHub beginners — unfamiliar with English UI and need Chinese guidance to get started quickly.
Education or team scenarios — unify interface language for Chinese teaching or team collaboration.
VS Code users — get localization experience within the editor via the extension.

zh.tag: Vercel 出品的全栈 React 框架，支持 SSR 与静态生成
zh.what: Next.js 是构建在 React 之上的全栈 Web 框架，扩展了最新的 React 特性并集成基于 Rust 的 JavaScript 工具链以实现极速构建。它支持服务端渲染、静态站点生成、路由、API 路由等能力，被众多世界级大公司用于生产环境。
zh.content: 仓库包含框架核心源码、编译器与构建工具、示例项目、测试套件以及完整的文档与贡献指南，并维护 good first issues 列表方便新人参与。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/TypeScript 编写，核心构建工具基于 Rust（Turbopack/SWC），通过 npm 包 next 发布，深度依赖 React 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 React 生态最主流的全栈框架，Next.js 已积累 14.2 万+ star，本周仍新增 265 star 并登上 JavaScript 周榜第 19 名，持续受益于 Vercel 的活跃维护与庞大社区。
uses: 前端与全栈开发者构建生产级 React 应用
需要 SSR/SSG 以优化 SEO 与首屏性能的网站
希望用统一框架搭建前后端一体的创业团队
想参与大型开源项目贡献的新手开发者

en.tag: Vercel's full-stack React framework with SSR and static generation
en.what: Next.js is a full-stack web framework built on top of React, extending the latest React features and integrating Rust-based JavaScript tooling for the fastest builds. It supports server-side rendering, static site generation, routing, and API routes, and is used in production by some of the world's largest companies.
en.content: The repo contains the framework core source, compiler and build tooling, examples, test suites, full documentation and contribution guidelines, plus a curated list of good first issues for newcomers.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript/TypeScript, with Rust-based build tooling (Turbopack/SWC), distributed as the npm package next, and deeply tied to the React ecosystem.
en.hot: As the dominant full-stack framework in the React ecosystem, Next.js has accumulated over 142k stars, adding 265 this week to rank 19th on the JavaScript trending weekly list, fueled by active Vercel maintenance and a huge community.
uses: Frontend and full-stack developers building production React apps
Sites needing SSR/SSG for better SEO and first-paint performance
Startup teams wanting one framework for both frontend and backend
New contributors looking to join a large open-source project

zh.tag: 基于 Git 的静态站点生成器内容管理系统
zh.what: Decap CMS 是一个基于 Git 的内容管理系统，为静态站点生成器提供简洁的可视化编辑界面。它让团队无需直接修改代码即可创建和编辑站点内容，所有改动都以提交形式存入 Git 仓库。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个单页应用前端、YAML 配置驱动的内容模型、认证与后端适配层，以及完整的文档与示例站点。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 编写，基于 React 构建，通过 npm 包或 CDN 引入，依赖 Git 仓库与 Netlify 等平台做认证和部署。
zh.hot: 近 1.9 万 star 且本周仍新增 30，作为 Netlify CMS 的继任者，它持续吸引静态站点与 Jamstack 用户。
uses: 使用 Hugo、Jekyll、Astro 等静态站点生成器的开发者
希望让非技术编辑人员直接更新网站内容的团队
偏好 Git 工作流、不想引入数据库的 Jamstack 项目
需要为已有站点快速添加后台管理界面的维护者

en.tag: A Git-based CMS for static site generators
en.what: Decap CMS is a Git-based content management system that gives static site generators a clean visual editing UI. It lets teams create and edit site content without touching code, committing every change straight into the Git repository.
en.content: The repo contains a single-page app frontend, a YAML-config-driven content model, auth and backend adapters, plus full documentation and example sites.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript and built on React, it ships as an npm package or CDN bundle and relies on a Git repo plus platforms like Netlify for auth and deploys.
en.hot: With nearly 19.4k stars and 30 added this week, it keeps drawing static-site and Jamstack users as the successor to Netlify CMS.
uses: Developers using static site generators like Hugo, Jekyll, or Astro
Teams that want non-technical editors to update site content directly
Jamstack projects preferring Git workflows over a database
Maintainers adding an admin UI to an existing static site

zh.tag: 为AI代理压缩命令输出的CLI代理，节省高达90%token
zh.what: RTK是一个高性能的CLI代理，在命令输出进入LLM上下文之前进行过滤和压缩，可减少60-90%的token消耗。它拦截shell命令，将冗长的输出转换为紧凑格式，例如将ls输出转为带文件计数的树形结构，仅保留git diff的关键变更等。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用Rust编写的单一二进制文件，支持100多种命令，如ls、cat、grep、git、cargo test等。还提供安装脚本、文档（包括架构说明）和多语言README。
zh.stack: 纯Rust实现，零依赖，单一二进制文件，开销小于10ms。
zh.hot: 随着AI编程助手普及，token成本成为痛点，RTK能大幅削减成本，且安装简单、性能高，因此迅速走红。
uses: 使用Claude Code、Codex等AI编程助手的开发者，希望减少token消耗和费用。
需要处理大量命令行输出的DevOps工程师，通过压缩日志和状态信息提高效率。
对Rust高性能工具感兴趣的开发者，可学习其架构和实现。

en.tag: CLI proxy that compresses command output for AI agents, cutting token usage by up to 90%
en.what: RTK is a high-performance CLI proxy that filters and compresses command output before it reaches the LLM context, reducing token consumption by 60-90%. It intercepts shell commands and converts verbose output into compact formats, such as turning ls output into a tree with file counts and keeping only essential changes from git diff.
en.content: The repository contains a single Rust binary supporting over 100 commands like ls, cat, grep, git, cargo test, etc. It also includes installation scripts, documentation (including architecture), and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Pure Rust implementation, zero dependencies, single binary, overhead under 10ms.
en.hot: As AI coding assistants become popular, token costs are a pain point. RTK significantly cuts costs, is easy to install, and performs well, hence its rapid rise.
uses: Developers using AI coding assistants like Claude Code or Codex who want to reduce token usage and costs.
DevOps engineers dealing with large command outputs, improving efficiency by compressing logs and status info.
Developers interested in high-performance Rust tools, who can learn from its architecture and implementation.

zh.tag: 一条命令为你的硬件找到最合适的 LLM 模型
zh.what: llmfit 是一个终端工具，能根据你的系统 RAM、CPU 和 GPU 自动检测硬件，并为数百个模型和提供商评分，告诉你哪些模型能在你的机器上流畅运行。它提供交互式 TUI 和经典 CLI 两种模式，支持多 GPU、MoE 架构、动态量化选择、速度估算以及本地运行时提供商（如 Ollama、llama.cpp 等）。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、TUI 和 CLI 实现、基准测试指南（docs/benchmarking.md）、TUI 指南（docs/tui.md），以及用于演示的 demo.gif 和图标资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖终端 UI 库（如 ratatui）和模型推理后端（Ollama、llama.cpp、MLX 等），通过 crates.io 分发。
zh.hot: 星标数达 32k，今日新增近 200，因其解决了本地 LLM 选型的痛点，且新版本支持基准测试并贡献结果，让用户获得真实硬件上的实测数据，迅速走红。
uses: 本地 LLM 爱好者：快速找到适合自己电脑配置的模型，避免下载后跑不动的尴尬。
开发者：在开发环境中评估不同模型的性能，优化推理速度和资源占用。
硬件评测者：通过基准测试功能，分享自己机器上的实测数据，帮助社区完善模型适配信息。

en.tag: One command to find the right LLM for your hardware
en.what: llmfit is a terminal tool that detects your hardware and scores hundreds of models across quality, speed, fit, and context dimensions, telling you which ones will run well on your machine. It features an interactive TUI and classic CLI mode, supporting multi-GPU setups, MoE architectures, dynamic quantization, speed estimation, and local runtime providers like Ollama and llama.cpp.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, TUI and CLI implementations, benchmarking guide (docs/benchmarking.md), TUI guide (docs/tui.md), plus demo.gif and icon assets.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging terminal UI libraries (e.g., ratatui) and model inference backends (Ollama, llama.cpp, MLX, etc.), distributed via crates.io.
en.hot: With 32k stars and ~200 new today, it solves the pain point of choosing the right local LLM, and the new benchmarking feature lets users contribute real measured data, driving its popularity.
uses: Local LLM enthusiasts: quickly find models that fit your hardware, avoiding downloads that won't run.
Developers: evaluate model performance in dev environments to optimize inference speed and resource usage.
Hardware reviewers: use benchmarking to share real measured data and improve community model-fit information.

zh.tag: 一个命令行工具统一管理 Google Workspace 全家桶，内置 AI 代理技能
zh.what: gws 是一个统一的命令行工具，让用户通过终端操作 Google Drive、Gmail、日历、表格、文档、聊天、管理后台等所有 Workspace API。它不依赖静态命令列表，而是在运行时读取 Google Discovery Service 动态生成命令，并内置 40 多个 AI 代理技能，方便人类和 AI 代理使用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、预编译二进制发布、npm 包封装、Nix flake，以及 40 多个 AI 代理技能定义。README 详细说明了安装、认证、快速开始、架构和开发指南。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，通过 npm 分发预编译二进制，依赖 Node.js 18+ 进行安装，需要 Google Cloud 项目获取 OAuth 凭证，并动态调用 Google Discovery Service。
zh.hot: 凭借 30946 颗星和今日新增 66 星登上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 4 名，因为它用一个工具解决了 Google Workspace 多 API 的碎片化问题，并紧跟 AI 代理趋势内置技能，对开发者和 AI 工作流都极具吸引力。
uses: 需要从命令行批量操作 Google Drive、Gmail、日历等服务的开发者和运维人员
构建 AI 代理并希望快速接入 Google Workspace 能力的开发者
希望用脚本自动化 Google Workspace 管理任务的技术团队
学习 Rust CLI 动态命令生成架构的工程师

en.tag: One CLI for all of Google Workspace, with built-in AI agent skills
en.what: gws is a unified CLI that lets you operate all Google Workspace APIs—Drive, Gmail, Calendar, Sheets, Docs, Chat, Admin, and more—from the terminal. Instead of a static command list, it dynamically builds its command surface from Google's Discovery Service at runtime, and ships with 40+ AI agent skills for both humans and AI agents.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, pre-built binary releases, an npm wrapper package, a Nix flake, and 40+ AI agent skill definitions. The README covers installation, authentication, quick start, architecture, and development.
en.stack: Core is written in Rust, distributed as pre-built binaries via npm, requires Node.js 18+ for installation, needs a Google Cloud project for OAuth credentials, and dynamically calls Google's Discovery Service.
en.hot: With 30,946 stars and 66 added today, it ranks #4 on GitHub Trending (Rust) by solving the fragmentation of multiple Google Workspace APIs in one tool and riding the AI agent wave with built-in skills, appealing to both developers and AI workflows.
uses: Developers and operators who need to batch-manage Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar, etc. from the command line
Developers building AI agents who want quick access to Google Workspace capabilities
Technical teams looking to automate Google Workspace admin tasks with scripts
Engineers studying Rust CLI architecture with dynamic command generation

zh.tag: 离线隐私优先的 Rust 语法检查器
zh.what: Harper 是一个完全离线运行的英文语法检查工具，所有检查都在本地完成，不上传任何文本。它主打毫秒级检查速度、极低内存占用，且体积小到可以通过 WebAssembly 在浏览器中运行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 核心检查引擎、harper-ls 语言服务器、harper.js 的 NPM 包，以及 Obsidian、VS Code 等编辑器插件和 WebAssembly 网页版。
zh.stack: 核心用 Rust 编写，提供语言服务器协议（LSP）接口，发布到 Crates.io 与 NPM，并编译为 WebAssembly 供网页使用。
zh.hot: 作为 Grammarly 的隐私友好替代品，它今日新增 149 star、总数达 15216，登上 GitHub Rust 日榜第 4 名，反映出开发者对本地化、快速语法检查的强烈需求。
uses: 注重隐私、不想把文稿上传到云端的写作者
使用 Obsidian、VS Code 等编辑器并希望内置语法检查的开发者
需要轻量、快速语法检查工具的英语写作学习者
希望集成语法检查到自家应用或网页的开发者

en.tag: Offline, privacy-first grammar checker powered by Rust
en.what: Harper is a fully offline English grammar checker that runs entirely on your machine without sending any text to a server. It focuses on millisecond-level linting, a tiny memory footprint, and is small enough to run in the browser via WebAssembly.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust core engine, the harper-ls language server, the harper.js NPM package, plus editor integrations like Obsidian and VS Code and a WebAssembly web build.
en.stack: Written in Rust, it exposes a Language Server Protocol interface, ships on Crates.io and NPM, and compiles to WebAssembly for web use.
en.hot: As a privacy-friendly Grammarly alternative, it gained 149 stars today for a total of 15,216 and hit #4 on GitHub's daily Rust trending list, reflecting strong demand for fast, local grammar checking.
uses: Writers who value privacy and don't want their text uploaded to the cloud
Developers using Obsidian, VS Code, or other editors who want built-in grammar checking
English learners who need a lightweight, fast grammar checking tool
Developers who want to integrate grammar checking into their own apps or websites

zh.tag: 基于 Tauri 的跨平台 Clash Meta 图形客户端
zh.what: Clash Verge Rev 是 Clash Verge 的延续项目，一个基于 Tauri 框架的现代化代理客户端。它内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供统一的图形化代理体验。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 Tauri 后端（src-tauri）与前端界面，附有多语言 README、深浅色预览图、发布页与文档站点。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 Rust + Tauri 2，内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，前端负责界面与主题渲染。
zh.hot: 凭借 14.4 万 star 与本周新增 1698 star 登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 Rust 第 6 名，跨平台代理需求与活跃维护持续吸引关注。
uses: 需要跨平台图形化代理客户端的普通用户
希望管理 Clash 配置、节点与规则的高级玩家
关注 Rust/Tauri 桌面应用开发的开发者

en.tag: A cross-platform Clash Meta GUI client built on Tauri
en.what: Clash Verge Rev is a continuation of Clash Verge, a modern proxy client built on the Tauri framework. It bundles the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core and delivers a unified graphical proxy experience across Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based Tauri backend (src-tauri) plus the frontend UI, along with multilingual READMEs, dark/light previews, release pages and a docs site.
en.stack: Built with Rust and Tauri 2, bundling the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core, with the frontend handling UI and theming.
en.hot: With 144k stars and 1,698 added this week, it ranks 6th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list, driven by cross-platform proxy demand and active maintenance.
uses: Everyday users needing a cross-platform graphical proxy client
Power users managing Clash configs, nodes and rules
Developers interested in Rust/Tauri desktop apps

zh.tag: Windows 桌面环境深度定制工具
zh.what: Seelen UI 是一个 Windows 桌面环境替代品，不是主题包或皮肤，而是对桌面外观和交互的彻底重构。用户可替换任务栏、Dock、应用启动器、窗口管理器、通知中心、虚拟桌面等所有日常元素，并通过 CSS/JSON 主题引擎和插件系统实现个性化。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面环境源代码，包括主题引擎、插件系统、文档、截图和安装包配置。支持 70+ 语言，提供 Microsoft Store 下载和 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，利用 Windows API 和 Web 技术（如 CSS/JSON）进行主题定制。
zh.hot: 凭借 17.7k stars 和今日新增 15 星，Seelen UI 在 Rust 趋势榜排名第 6。其高度可定制性和深度 Windows 集成吸引了追求个性化桌面的用户。
uses: Windows 用户希望完全定制桌面外观和交互，从任务栏到窗口管理器。
开发者或高级用户想要通过 CSS/JSON 主题和插件系统扩展桌面功能。
追求极简或高效工作流的人士，需要可定制的虚拟桌面和窗口布局。

en.tag: Fully customizable desktop environment for Windows 10/11
en.what: Seelen UI is a full desktop environment replacement for Windows, not a theme pack or skin, but a complete rethink of how your desktop looks and works. Every element you interact with daily—taskbar, dock, app launcher, window manager, notification flyouts, virtual desktops—can be replaced, restyled, and extended to match your vision and workflow.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the desktop environment, including theming engine, plugin system, documentation, screenshots, and installer configurations. It supports 70+ languages and provides Microsoft Store download and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, leveraging Windows APIs and web technologies (CSS/JSON) for theming and customization.
en.hot: With 17.7k stars and 15 new stars today, Seelen UI ranks #6 on the Rust trending list. Its high customizability and deep Windows integration attract users seeking personalized desktops.
uses: Windows users who want to fully customize their desktop appearance and interaction, from taskbar to window manager.
Developers or power users who want to extend desktop functionality via CSS/JSON themes and plugin system.
People seeking minimal or efficient workflows with customizable virtual desktops and window layouts.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的高性能 Minecraft 服务器
zh.what: Pumpkin 是一个完全用 Rust 编写的 Minecraft 服务器，旨在提供快速、高效且可定制的游戏体验。它专注于性能与玩家乐趣，同时遵循原版游戏机制。
zh.content: 仓库包含服务器核心代码、配置文件、资源文件以及详细的开发路线图。主要模块包括网络协议、世界管理、实体系统和插件支持。
zh.stack: 技术栈基于 Rust，使用多线程实现高性能，依赖包括 tokio 异步运行时、serde 序列化等。支持 Java 和 Bedrock 版协议。
zh.hot: 凭借 Rust 带来的性能优势和活跃开发，Pumpkin 在 GitHub 上获得 11203 颗星，本周新增 147 星，位列 Rust 周榜第 17 名。
uses: Minecraft 服务器管理员 —— 寻求高性能、低延迟的服务器解决方案
Rust 开发者 —— 对游戏服务器开发或网络编程感兴趣
插件开发者 —— 希望为新兴服务器平台构建扩展
技术爱好者 —— 关注用现代语言重写经典游戏服务端

en.tag: A high-performance Minecraft server rewritten in Rust
en.what: Pumpkin is a Minecraft server built entirely in Rust, offering a fast, efficient, and customizable experience. It prioritizes performance and player enjoyment while adhering to the core mechanics of the game.
en.content: The repository contains the server core code, configuration files, assets, and a detailed development roadmap. Main modules include network protocol, world management, entity system, and plugin support.
en.stack: The tech stack is based on Rust, leveraging multi-threading for high performance, with dependencies like tokio async runtime and serde serialization. It supports both Java and Bedrock edition protocols.
en.hot: With performance benefits from Rust and active development, Pumpkin has gained 11,203 stars on GitHub, with 147 new stars this week, ranking 17th on the Rust weekly trending list.
uses: Minecraft server administrators — seeking high-performance, low-latency server solutions
Rust developers — interested in game server development or network programming
Plugin developers — looking to build extensions for an emerging server platform
Tech enthusiasts — following the rewrite of classic game servers in modern languages

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.

zh.tag: 为 KiCAD 打造的 AI PCB 设计原生插件，通过 MCP 连接 Claude 等大模型

Teams looking to build on Xray or integrate it into their own products

zh.tag: 厂商中立的遥测数据收集、处理与导出管道
zh.what: OpenTelemetry Collector 是一个厂商中立的遥测数据收集器，用于接收、处理和导出 traces、metrics、logs 等数据。它消除了为支持多种开源遥测格式（如 Jaeger、Prometheus）和多种后端而运行维护多个代理/收集器的需要。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Collector 核心代码、配置文档、内部遥测监控指南、安全最佳实践以及贡献指南。主要目录包括 cmd、internal、pkg 等，提供可扩展的组件架构。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OpenTelemetry 协议和库，支持多种数据格式和导出器。
zh.hot: 作为云原生可观测性的事实标准，OpenTelemetry Collector 拥有 7547 颗星，本周新增 51 星，位列 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 17 名，社区活跃且被广泛采用。
uses: 需要统一收集和导出遥测数据的 DevOps 和 SRE 团队
希望避免供应商锁定的云原生应用开发者
构建可观测性平台或服务的工程师
学习 OpenTelemetry 和分布式追踪的学生或研究者

en.tag: Vendor-agnostic telemetry data collection, processing, and export pipeline
en.what: The OpenTelemetry Collector is a vendor-agnostic telemetry data collector for receiving, processing, and exporting traces, metrics, and logs. It eliminates the need to run and maintain multiple agents/collectors to support various open-source telemetry formats (e.g., Jaeger, Prometheus) and multiple backends.
en.content: The repository contains the Collector core code, configuration docs, internal telemetry monitoring guide, security best practices, and contribution guidelines. Key directories include cmd, internal, pkg, etc., offering an extensible component architecture.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it depends on OpenTelemetry protocols and libraries, supporting multiple data formats and exporters.
en.hot: As the de facto standard for cloud-native observability, OpenTelemetry Collector has 7,547 stars, with 51 added this week, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending Go weekly. It has an active community and wide adoption.
uses: DevOps and SRE teams needing unified telemetry collection and export
Cloud-native application developers wanting to avoid vendor lock-in
Engineers building observability platforms or services
Students or researchers learning OpenTelemetry and distributed tracing

zh.tag: Facebook 出品的高性能嵌入式持久化键值存储库
zh.what: RocksDB 是 Facebook 数据库工程团队开发维护的嵌入式持久化键值存储库，基于 Google LevelDB 的早期工作演进而来。它采用 LSM-Tree 设计，可在写放大、读放大和空间放大之间灵活权衡，特别适合在闪存上存储数据。
zh.content: 仓库以 C++ 源码为主体，公共接口位于 include/ 目录，examples/ 提供用法示例，另有完整的 GitHub Wiki 文档、构建脚本与测试套件。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，依赖 CMake/Make 构建，支持多线程 compaction，采用 GPLv2 与 Apache 2.0 双许可证。
zh.hot: 作为 MyRocks、TiKV、CockroachDB 等众多数据库的底层存储引擎，RocksDB 长期保持高关注度，已积累 32075 颗星，本周新增 45 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 6。
uses: 数据库与存储引擎开发者，需要为自研数据库选型底层 KV 存储
后端工程师在闪存/SSD 场景下构建高吞吐持久化服务
需要单库存储数 TB 级数据并调优读写放大的系统架构师

en.tag: Facebook's embeddable persistent key-value store for fast storage
en.what: RocksDB is an embeddable persistent key-value store library developed and maintained by Facebook's Database Engineering Team, building on earlier work on Google's LevelDB. It uses an LSM-Tree design with flexible tradeoffs between write, read, and space amplification, making it especially suited for storing data on flash drives.
en.content: The repo is primarily C++ source code, with the public interface in include/, usage examples in examples/, plus a full GitHub Wiki, build scripts, and test suites.
en.stack: Core is written in C++, built with CMake/Make, supports multi-threaded compaction, and is dual-licensed under GPLv2 and Apache 2.0.
en.hot: As the storage engine behind MyRocks, TiKV, CockroachDB and many others, RocksDB enjoys lasting attention with 32,075 stars, gaining 45 this week to rank 6th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: Database and storage engine developers choosing a low-level KV store for their own database
Backend engineers building high-throughput persistent services on flash/SSD
System architects needing single-database storage of multiple terabytes with tunable read/write amplification

zh.tag: 开源像素画与动画精灵编辑器，跨三大桌面平台
zh.what: Aseprite 是一款用于制作动画精灵（sprite）的像素画编辑器，把图层与帧作为独立概念管理，支持实时预览与洋葱皮等动画辅助功能。它面向像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者，可导入导出精灵表、GIF 与 PNG 序列等多种格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 编写的编辑器核心源码、构建脚本与 CI 配置，以及文档、翻译和脚本扩展相关目录，可自行编译出 Windows、macOS、Linux 版本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并集成 Lua 脚本引擎与 Skia 等图形库，通过 GitHub Actions 做多平台构建。
zh.hot: 作为像素画领域的经典开源工具，它已积累近 3.94 万 star，本周再增 191 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 4，说明像素风游戏与独立开发热度持续。
uses: 像素艺术家与独立游戏开发者制作角色动画和精灵图
游戏美术需要导出精灵表、GIF 或 PNG 序列接入引擎
想用 Lua 脚本和 CLI 自动化批量处理素材的技术美术
在 Windows、macOS 或 Linux 上寻找免费开源像素编辑器的用户

en.tag: Open-source animated sprite editor & pixel art tool for Windows, macOS and Linux
en.what: Aseprite is a pixel art editor for creating animated sprites, treating layers and frames as separate concepts with real-time preview and onion skinning. Aimed at pixel artists and indie game developers, it imports and exports sprite sheets, GIFs and PNG sequences among other formats.
en.content: The repo holds the C++ editor core source, build scripts and CI configs, plus docs, translations and scripting-related directories, letting you compile builds for Windows, macOS and Linux.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ with CMake builds, integrating a Lua scripting engine and graphics libraries such as Skia, with multi-platform builds via GitHub Actions.
en.hot: A classic open-source tool in the pixel art space, it has nearly 39.4k stars and gained 191 more this week, ranking 4th on the C++ weekly trending list, reflecting the ongoing popularity of pixel-art games and indie development.
uses: Pixel artists and indie game developers creating character animations and sprites
Game artists who need to export sprite sheets, GIFs or PNG sequences into engines
Technical artists automating asset pipelines with Lua scripting and the CLI
Users on Windows, macOS or Linux looking for a free open-source pixel editor

zh.tag: 免费开源的跨平台 2D/3D 游戏引擎
zh.what: Godot 是一个功能丰富、跨平台的游戏引擎，让开发者通过统一界面制作 2D 和 3D 游戏。它内置大量常用工具，并支持一键导出到桌面、移动端、Web 及主机平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎完整 C++ 源码、编辑器、模块与平台导出模板，以及构建脚本、文档和官方演示项目。
zh.stack: 核心用 C++ 编写，采用 MIT 许可，依赖 SCons 构建系统，并集成 Vulkan/OpenGL 渲染后端与 GDScript 脚本语言。
zh.hot: 作为最受欢迎的开源游戏引擎之一，Godot 已积累超过 11.7 万 star，今日再增 43 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 7，社区热度持续高涨。
uses: 独立游戏开发者寻找免费、无版税的 2D/3D 引擎
教育机构用于游戏开发与编程教学
希望从 Unity/Unreal 迁移到开源方案的团队
想参与开源引擎贡献的 C++ 开发者

en.tag: Free and open-source cross-platform 2D and 3D game engine
en.what: Godot is a feature-packed, cross-platform game engine for creating 2D and 3D games from a unified interface. It ships with a comprehensive set of common tools and supports one-click export to desktop, mobile, web, and console platforms.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ source of the engine, the editor, modules and platform export templates, plus build scripts, documentation, and official demo projects.
en.stack: Written primarily in C++ under the MIT license, it uses the SCons build system and integrates Vulkan/OpenGL rendering backends with the GDScript language.
en.hot: As one of the most popular open-source game engines, Godot has over 117k stars, gaining 43 more today and ranking 7th on the C++ trending list, showing sustained community momentum.
uses: Indie game developers seeking a free, royalty-free 2D/3D engine
Educational institutions teaching game development and programming
Teams looking to migrate from Unity/Unreal to an open-source solution
C++ developers wanting to contribute to an open-source engine

zh.tag: Google DeepMind 开源的高性能通用物理仿真引擎
zh.what: MuJoCo 全称 Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact，是一个面向机器人、生物力学、图形动画与机器学习研究的通用物理引擎，专注于快速且精确地仿真关节结构与环境的接触交互。它提供 C API、Python 绑定以及 Unity 插件，由 Google DeepMind 维护。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C 语言核心仿真运行时、内置 XML 模型编译器、OpenGL 原生 GUI 交互查看器 simulate，以及 Python 绑定、Unity 插件和多个 Colab 教程笔记本（入门、模型编辑、rollout、LQR）。
zh.stack: 以 C++/C 实现核心引擎，依赖 OpenGL 做可视化，提供 Python 绑定（含 multithreaded rollout 模块）与 Unity 插件，构建走 GitHub Actions + CMake。
zh.hot: 作为强化学习与机器人仿真的事实标准之一，MuJoCo 长期被 Gym/Gymnasium 等生态广泛采用，15k+ star 且本周仍新增 134，稳居 C++ 周榜第 9。
uses: 强化学习研究者：用 MuJoCo 搭建机器人控制与 locomotion 训练环境
机器人/生物力学工程师：做关节结构与接触动力学的高保真仿真
图形与动画开发者：借助 Unity 插件和物理引擎做交互式动画
Python 学习者：通过官方 Colab 教程快速上手建模与 rollout

en.tag: Google DeepMind's high-performance general-purpose physics simulator
en.what: MuJoCo (Multi-Joint dynamics with Contact) is a general-purpose physics engine for robotics, biomechanics, graphics/animation, and machine learning, focused on fast and accurate simulation of articulated structures interacting with their environment. It ships a C API, Python bindings, and a Unity plug-in, and is maintained by Google DeepMind.
en.content: The repo contains the C core simulation runtime, a built-in XML model compiler, the native OpenGL GUI viewer `simulate`, plus Python bindings, a Unity plug-in, and several Colab tutorial notebooks (intro, model editing, rollout, LQR).
en.stack: Core engine written in C++/C, using OpenGL for visualization, with Python bindings (including a multithreaded rollout module) and a Unity plug-in; built via GitHub Actions and CMake.
en.hot: As a de-facto standard for RL and robotics simulation, MuJoCo is widely used across Gym/Gymnasium ecosystems; with 15k+ stars and 134 added this week, it ranks 9th on the C++ weekly trending list.
uses: RL researchers building robot control and locomotion training environments
Robotics/biomechanics engineers needing high-fidelity articulated contact dynamics
Graphics and animation developers using the Unity plug-in for interactive animation
Python learners following the official Colab tutorials for modeling and rollout

zh.tag: 开源列式实时分析数据库，海量数据亚秒级查询
zh.what: ClickHouse 是一个开源的列式数据库管理系统，专为在线分析处理（OLAP）设计，能在海量数据上实时生成分析报表。它以极致的查询速度和写入吞吐著称，支持 SQL 与多种集成方式。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的数据库内核源码（C++）、构建脚本、测试套件与文档入口，并附有安装命令、官方教程、文档、Slack/Telegram 社区及月度发布说明等链接。
zh.stack: 核心以 C++ 编写，采用列式存储与向量化执行引擎，支持 SQL；提供 Linux/macOS/FreeBSD 一键安装脚本，并有云服务 ClickHouse Cloud。
zh.hot: 作为 OLAP 领域标杆项目，已积累 49835 颗星，今日仍新增 31 星并登上 C++ 日榜第 9，说明其在实时分析场景中的长期热度与活跃社区。
uses: 数据分析师与数据工程师，用于构建实时报表与 BI 看板
后端/平台团队，为日志、埋点、指标等海量时序数据提供查询引擎
需要替换传统数仓或加速 OLAP 查询的架构师与 SRE
学习列式存储与高性能数据库实现的开源爱好者与研究者

en.tag: Open-source column-oriented database for real-time analytics at scale
en.what: ClickHouse is an open-source column-oriented database management system built for online analytical processing (OLAP), generating analytical reports in real time over massive datasets. It is known for extreme query speed and write throughput, with SQL support and broad integrations.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ database engine source, build scripts, test suites and docs entry points, plus install commands, official tutorials, documentation, Slack/Telegram community links and monthly release notes.
en.stack: Core is written in C++ with columnar storage and a vectorized execution engine, SQL support, one-line install scripts for Linux/macOS/FreeBSD, and the managed ClickHouse Cloud service.
en.hot: As a benchmark OLAP project it has amassed 49,835 stars, still gaining 31 today and ranking 9th on the C++ daily trending list, reflecting lasting demand and an active community.
uses: Data analysts and engineers building real-time reports and BI dashboards
Backend/platform teams needing a query engine for logs, events and metrics at scale
Architects and SREs replacing legacy warehouses or accelerating OLAP queries
Open-source learners and researchers studying columnar storage and high-performance databases

zh.tag: 以源码为文档、保存数十年软硬件历史的开源模拟框架
zh.what: MAME 是一个多用途模拟框架，目标是保存数十年的软件历史，防止老旧的电子游戏、计算机和计算器被遗忘。它通过记录硬件及其工作原理来实现这一点，源代码本身就是这份文档，而软件能运行则用来验证模拟的准确性。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源码、按硬件平台组织的驱动与设备模拟代码、构建脚本以及文档，并附有 CI 状态、编译说明和社区链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持在类 UNIX 系统（Linux/macOS）上通过 make 构建，macOS 需要 Xcode 与 SDL 2.0，Windows 也有对应构建方式。
zh.hot: 作为拥有约 1.05 万 star 的老牌项目，MAME 本周仍新增 24 star 并登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 12 名，说明复古游戏与数字保存的长期热度不减。
uses: 复古游戏玩家：在现代设备上运行并体验经典街机与主机游戏
数字保存与档案工作者：研究硬件文档与软件历史保存方法
模拟器开发者：学习硬件模拟、驱动编写与跨平台构建
计算机历史爱好者：探索老式计算机、计算器与游戏机的实现细节

en.tag: An open-source emulation framework preserving decades of software and hardware history through source code
en.what: MAME is a multi-purpose emulation framework whose goal is to preserve decades of software history, keeping vintage games, computers and calculators from being lost and forgotten. It documents hardware and how it works, with the source code serving as that documentation, while playability mainly validates the accuracy of the emulation.
en.content: The repo contains the full C++ source, per-platform drivers and device emulation code, build scripts and documentation, along with CI badges, compile instructions and community links.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++, it builds on UNIX-like systems (Linux/macOS) via make, requires Xcode and SDL 2.0 on macOS, and offers a Windows build path as well.
en.hot: With about 10.5k stars, this long-standing project still gained 24 stars this week and ranked 12th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list, showing sustained interest in retro gaming and digital preservation.
uses: Retro gamers: play classic arcade and console titles on modern devices
Digital preservationists and archivists: study hardware documentation and software history preservation
Emulator developers: learn hardware emulation, driver writing and cross-platform builds
Computer history enthusiasts: explore how vintage computers, calculators and consoles worked

zh.tag: ESP32 上的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具套件
zh.what: ESP32 Marauder 是一套运行在 ESP32 微控制器上的 WiFi/蓝牙攻防工具集，支持扫描、嗅探、攻击和防御等多种无线安全测试功能。它既可用于安全研究，也可用于渗透测试和无线网络分析。

硬件爱好者和创客 —— 基于 ESP32 开发自定义无线工具和实验。

红队成员 —— 在授权测试中模拟无线攻击和防御。

en.tag: A suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools for the ESP32
en.what: ESP32 Marauder is a suite of WiFi/Bluetooth offensive and defensive tools that runs on the ESP32 microcontroller, supporting scanning, sniffing, attacking, and defending for wireless security testing. It is used for security research, penetration testing, and wireless network analysis.
en.content: The repository contains firmware source code, pre-built firmware releases, hardware design files, documentation wiki, and build scripts, with main directories like firmware, pictures, and docs.
en.stack: Built with C++ using the ESP-IDF framework, depending on ESP32 hardware and WiFi/Bluetooth stacks, with support for Arduino and PlatformIO builds.
en.hot: With 12,328 stars and 107 new stars this week, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending weekly for C++, gaining attention for its powerful wireless offensive/defensive capabilities and active community.
uses: Security researchers and penetration testers — for wireless network security assessments and vulnerability discovery.
Hardware enthusiasts and makers — to develop custom wireless tools and experiments based on ESP32.
Cybersecurity students and educators — to learn wireless communication principles and offensive/defensive techniques.
Red team members — to simulate wireless attacks and defenses in authorized tests.

zh.tag: 为 Wayland 打造的原生桌面外壳，一体化定制 Linux 桌面
zh.what: Noctalia 是一个原生的 Wayland 桌面外壳，旨在替代由多个独立小工具拼凑而成的桌面环境。它提供统一的栏、部件、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏等功能，并直接构建于 Wayland 和 OpenGL ES 之上，无 Qt 或 GTK 依赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的桌面外壳实现，涵盖多显示器栏、任务栏、工作区、系统托盘、dock、启动器、控制中心、通知、壁纸、锁屏、剪贴板历史、OSD 等组件。项目提供安装文档、用户指南和 ethos 理念说明。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，直接基于 Wayland 协议和 OpenGL ES 进行渲染，无 Qt/GTK 依赖。配置和 IPC 模型为一体化设计，支持脚本扩展部件。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub Trending 上表现强劲，月增 1089 星，总星数破万，反映出用户对一体化、可定制 Wayland 桌面外壳的强烈需求。其无 Qt/GTK 依赖的原生实现和统一设计理念吸引了大量关注。

en.tag: A native Wayland desktop shell for a cohesive, customizable Linux desktop
en.what: Noctalia is a native Wayland desktop shell that replaces the patchwork of separate tools for a cohesive desktop experience. It provides bars, widgets, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, and more, built directly on Wayland and OpenGL ES without Qt or GTK dependencies.
en.content: The repository contains a full desktop shell implementation, including multi-monitor bars, taskbar, workspaces, system tray, dock, launcher, control center, notifications, wallpaper, lock screen, clipboard history, OSDs, and more. en.stack: Written primarily in C++, it renders directly via Wayland and OpenGL ES with no Qt/GTK dependencies. Configuration and IPC are designed cohesively, with support for script-backed widgets.
en.hot: With over 10k stars and a monthly gain of 1089, it's trending strongly, indicating high demand for a cohesive, customizable Wayland shell. Its native implementation without Qt/GTK and unified design philosophy are key attractions.
uses: Wayland desktop users seeking a unified, stable experience instead of scattered tools
Linux enthusiasts and developers who enjoy deep customization of desktop appearance and behavior
Productivity users needing multi-monitor support and rich widgets like weather and clipboard history

zh.tag: 自托管桌面串流主机，按客户端原生分辨率低延迟投屏
zh.what: Apollo 是 Sunshine 的分支项目，作为自托管的桌面串流主机，配合 Artemis(Moonlight Noir) 客户端使用。它支持 AMD、Intel、Nvidia 显卡硬件编码，也支持软件编码，并内置与客户端分辨率/帧率自动匹配的虚拟显示器（含 HDR）。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++ 编写的串流服务端源码，附带 Web UI 用于配置和客户端配对，另有 Wiki 文档介绍权限系统、虚拟显示器与自动暂停/恢复游戏等用法。

使用 AMD/Intel/Nvidia 显卡做硬件编码的串流爱好者
希望按客户端自动切换分辨率与帧率的 Moonlight/Artemis 用户

en.tag: Self-hosted desktop stream host with native client resolution and low latency
en.what: Apollo is a fork of Sunshine that acts as a self-hosted desktop stream host for the Artemis (Moonlight Noir) client. It supports hardware encoding on AMD, Intel, and Nvidia GPUs plus software encoding, and includes a built-in virtual display with HDR that auto-matches the client's resolution and framerate.
en.content: The repo mainly contains the C++ streaming host source code, a web UI for configuration and client pairing, and wiki docs covering the permission system, virtual display, and auto pause/resume games.
en.stack: Primarily C++, built on the Sunshine ecosystem and the SudoVDA virtual display driver, with Windows-only virtual display support for now and Linux planned.
en.hot: As an enhanced Sunshine fork, it solves resolution-matching pain points and adds HDR virtual display; it gained 140 stars this week, reaching ~10.9k total and ranking 14th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: Gamers who want to stream PC games to TV, tablet, or phone at native resolution
Users building a self-hosted cloud gaming server with per-client permission management
Streaming enthusiasts using AMD/Intel/Nvidia GPUs for hardware encoding
Moonlight/Artemis users who want automatic resolution and framerate switching per client

zh.tag: 全球首款免费开源的 PS3 模拟器与调试器
zh.what: RPCS3 是一款用 C++ 编写的 PlayStation 3 模拟器和调试器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它允许用户在 PC 上运行 PS3 游戏，并提供调试功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器的完整源代码、构建脚本、文档（如 BUILDING.md）以及 Wiki 链接。项目还设有 Discord 服务器和论坛，用于讨论和兼容性报告。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++，依赖图形驱动和 Visual C++ 运行库。构建环境配置详见 BUILDING.md。
zh.hot: 作为 PS3 模拟器的先驱，RPCS3 持续吸引关注，本月新增 317 星，总星数达 19651，位列 C++ 趋势榜第 14 名。其活跃的社区和不断改进的兼容性是其热度来源。
uses: 游戏玩家：在 PC 上体验 PS3 独占游戏，无需主机硬件。
开发者：研究 PS3 架构，参与模拟器开发或逆向工程。
测试人员：贡献游戏兼容性报告，帮助改进模拟器。

en.tag: World's first free & open-source PS3 emulator/debugger
en.what: RPCS3 is a PlayStation 3 emulator and debugger written in C++, supporting Windows, Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD. It allows users to run PS3 games on PC and provides debugging capabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the emulator, build scripts, documentation (e.g., BUILDING.md), and links to the Wiki. The project also has a Discord server and forums for discussion and compatibility reports.
en.stack: Primarily C++, relies on graphics drivers and Visual C++ redistributables. Build environment setup is detailed in BUILDING.md.
en.hot: As a pioneer PS3 emulator, RPCS3 continues to attract attention, gaining 317 stars this month to reach 19,651 total, ranking 14th on the C++ trending list. Its active community and improving compatibility drive its popularity.
uses: Gamers: Experience PS3 exclusive titles on PC without console hardware.
Developers: Study PS3 architecture, contribute to emulator development or reverse engineering.
Testers: Submit game compatibility reports to help improve the emulator.

zh.tag: 跨平台 C++ 框架，专注音频插件与桌面/移动应用开发
zh.what: JUCE 是一个开源的跨平台 C++ 应用框架，用于构建桌面和移动应用，尤其擅长音频插件与插件宿主。它支持 VST、VST3、AU、AUv3、LV2 和 AAX 等主流音频插件格式。
zh.content: 仓库包含 JUCE 核心模块源码、Projucer 项目生成工具、CMake 构建支持、示例代码和文档。
zh.stack: 基于 C++17（启用 Windows MIDI 服务时需 C++20），依赖 CMake 3.22+ 或 Projucer，支持 Xcode、Visual Studio、Android Studio 和 Linux Makefile。
zh.hot: 作为音频开发领域的标杆框架，JUCE 拥有近 9 千星标，本周新增 25 星，持续吸引音频开发者关注。
uses: 音频插件开发者，用于创建 VST、AU、AAX 等格式的插件
桌面/移动应用开发者，需要跨平台 GUI 和音频处理能力
音频软件公司，用于构建商业音频产品和工具
学习音频编程的学生和爱好者，通过示例和文档快速上手

en.tag: Cross-platform C++ framework for audio plug-ins and desktop/mobile apps
en.what: JUCE is an open-source cross-platform C++ application framework for building desktop and mobile apps, with a strong focus on audio plug-ins and plug-in hosts. It supports major audio plug-in formats including VST, VST3, AU, AUv3, LV2, and AAX.
en.content: The repository contains JUCE core module source code, the Projucer project generation tool, CMake build support, examples, and documentation.
en.stack: Based on C++17 (C++20 when Windows MIDI Services enabled), requires CMake 3.22+ or Projucer, supports Xcode, Visual Studio, Android Studio, and Linux Makefiles.
en.hot: As a benchmark framework in audio development, JUCE has nearly 9k stars and gained 25 stars this week, continuously attracting audio developers.
uses: Audio plug-in developers creating VST, AU, AAX, etc.
Desktop/mobile app developers needing cross-platform GUI and audio processing
Audio software companies building commercial audio products and tools
Students and hobbyists learning audio programming via examples and docs

zh.tag: 隐私优先的 Chromium 浏览器，无广告无噪音
zh.what: Helium 是一款基于 Chromium 的网页浏览器，强调隐私保护和无偏见广告拦截。它去除了 Google 相关服务，提供简洁、快速的上网体验，目前处于测试阶段。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器核心代码、补丁集（来自 ungoogled-chromium 等）以及品牌资源。平台打包和工具链分别存放在独立的仓库中。
zh.stack: 基于 Chromium 和 ungoogled-chromium，使用 C++ 开发，集成 uBlock Origin 的修改版用于广告拦截。
zh.hot: 隐私浏览器需求旺盛，Helium 以无偏见广告拦截和简洁设计吸引用户，star 数已超 2 万，今日新增 111，登上 C++ 趋势榜。
uses: 注重隐私、希望摆脱 Google 追踪的普通用户
开发者可参与贡献，基于 Chromium 的浏览器定制开发
寻求无广告干扰、简洁快速浏览体验的用户

en.tag: Privacy-first Chromium browser with unbiased ad-blocking, no bloat
en.what: Helium is a Chromium-based web browser focused on privacy and unbiased ad-blocking. It removes Google services, offering a clean, fast browsing experience, currently in beta.
en.content: The repo contains the browser core, patchset (from ungoogled-chromium etc.), and branding assets. Platform packaging and tooling are in separate repos.
en.stack: Built on Chromium and ungoogled-chromium, developed in C++, integrates a modified uBlock Origin for ad-blocking.
en.hot: High demand for privacy browsers, Helium attracts users with unbiased ad-blocking and clean design, stars exceed 20k with 111 added today, trending in C++.
uses: Privacy-conscious users who want to avoid Google tracking
Developers interested in contributing to Chromium-based browser customization
Users seeking an ad-free, clean, and fast browsing experience

zh.tag: Google 开源的 C++ 基础库，扩展标准库的生产级工具集
zh.what: Abseil 是 Google 开源的 C++ 公共库集合，兼容 C++17，旨在补充标准库。它源自 Google 内部生产代码，经过大规模测试，提供标准库缺失或需要替代的组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含多个库组件，如 base（基础初始化）、algorithm（算法扩展）、cleanup（作用域退出回调）、container、debugging、flags、hash、memory、meta、numeric、random、status、strings、synchronization、time 等。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17，官方构建系统为 Bazel 和 CMake，支持多种编译器和平台，遵循 Google 基础 C++ 支持政策。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 内部广泛使用的 C++ 基础库，Abseil 在 C++ 社区中具有高影响力和可靠性，拥有 18136 颗星，本周新增 17 颗，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 18 名。
uses: C++ 开发者需要标准库之外的实用工具和组件
大型项目寻求经过生产验证的基础库以提高代码质量
使用 Bazel 或 CMake 构建系统的团队
希望学习 Google 内部 C++ 最佳实践的工程师

en.tag: Google's open-source C++ common libraries augmenting the standard library
en.what: Abseil is an open-source collection of C++ library code (C++17 compliant) designed to augment the C++ standard library. Extracted from Google's production codebase, it provides extensively tested components that fill gaps or offer alternatives to the standard library.
en.content: The repository contains multiple library components such as base (initialization), algorithm (algorithm extensions), cleanup (scope-exit callbacks), container, debugging, flags, hash, memory, meta, numeric, random, status, strings, synchronization, time, and more.
en.stack: Primarily C++17, with Bazel and CMake as official build systems, supporting multiple compilers and platforms under Google's Foundational C++ Support Policy.
en.hot: As a widely used foundational C++ library inside Google, Abseil has high impact and reliability in the C++ community, with 18,136 stars and 17 added this week, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending weekly for C++.
uses: C++ developers needing utility components beyond the standard library
Large projects seeking production-tested foundational libraries for code quality
Teams using Bazel or CMake build systems
Engineers wanting to learn Google's internal C++ best practices

zh.tag: 把 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 翻译成 Vulkan，让 Linux/Wine 跑起 3D 游戏
zh.what: DXVK 是一个基于 Vulkan 的 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 转译层，让原本依赖 Windows 图形 API 的 3D 应用能在 Linux 上通过 Wine 运行。它把 D3D 调用转换为 Vulkan 调用，从而绕开老旧的 wined3d，大幅提升游戏兼容性与性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 d3d8、d3d9、d3d10core、d3d11 和 dxgi 等 DLL 的源码，以及构建脚本、HUD 工具和面向 Wine 前缀的安装说明。发布页提供 x32/x64 预编译 DLL 包，可直接复制进 Wine 前缀使用。
zh.stack: 主要用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan 图形 API 和 Wine 的 DLL 加载机制，需要较新的显卡驱动。构建系统使用 Meson/Ninja，并支持 MinGW 交叉编译。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的基石项目，几乎所有 Steam Play/Proton、Lutris、Bottles 都默认集成它，因此长期保持高关注度。目前约 1.8 万 star，本周新增 64，仍稳居 GitHub C++ 周榜第 19 名。
uses: Linux 玩家：通过 Proton/Lutris/Bottles 运行 Windows 3D 游戏
Wine 开发者与打包者：为 Wine 前缀集成 D3D 转译层
图形/驱动工程师：研究 D3D 到 Vulkan 的转译实现
Steam Deck 用户：依赖 DXVK 获得流畅的游戏体验

en.tag: A Vulkan-based translation layer bringing Direct3D 8/9/10/11 games to Linux/Wine
en.what: DXVK is a Vulkan-based translation layer for Direct3D 8/9/10/11 that lets Windows-only 3D applications run on Linux through Wine. It converts D3D calls into Vulkan, bypassing the older wined3d path and greatly improving game compatibility and performance.
en.content: The repo contains source for the d3d8, d3d9, d3d10core, d3d11 and dxgi DLLs, plus build scripts, the HUD tooling and Wine-prefix install instructions. Release pages ship prebuilt x32/x64 DLL packages that can be copied straight into a Wine prefix.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++, it depends on the Vulkan graphics API and Wine's DLL loading mechanism, and requires reasonably recent GPU drivers. The build uses Meson/Ninja and supports MinGW cross-compilation.
en.hot: DXVK is a cornerstone of the Linux gaming ecosystem, bundled by default in nearly all Steam Play/Proton, Lutris and Bottles setups, which keeps it in the spotlight. It sits at roughly 18k stars with 64 added this week, still ranking 19th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: Linux gamers running Windows 3D titles via Proton/Lutris/Bottles
Wine developers and packagers integrating a D3D translation layer into prefixes
Graphics/driver engineers studying D3D-to-Vulkan translation internals
Steam Deck users relying on DXVK for smooth gameplay

zh.tag: 开源软件 KVM：一套键鼠无缝控制多台电脑
zh.what: Deskflow 是一款免费开源的键盘鼠标共享工具，让你用一台电脑的键鼠或触控板去控制旁边的其他电脑，在它们之间无缝切换工作。它相当于不带视频功能的软件 KVM，默认启用 TLS 加密，并支持 Wayland 与剪贴板共享。
zh.content: 仓库是完整的跨平台桌面应用源码，包含核心共享逻辑、各平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）构建与打包配置，并提供稳定版、持续构建版以及 Flathub 与 Homebrew 等分发渠道。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主语言，面向 Windows、macOS 与 Linux 多平台构建，依赖系统图形与输入层（含 Wayland 支持），并内置 TLS 加密通信。
zh.hot: 作为 Synergy 的开源继任者，它解决了多机办公的刚需，累计已获约 2.87 万 star，本周再增 201，稳居 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 11 名。
uses: 同时使用笔记本与台式机的开发者，用一套键鼠跨屏操作
多系统办公用户（Windows/macOS/Linux 混用）需要无缝切换
想替代硬件 KVM 或 Synergy 的团队与个人，追求开源免费方案
注重隐私安全、希望默认加密并共享剪贴板的用户

en.tag: Open-source software KVM: share one keyboard and mouse across computers
en.what: Deskflow is a free and open source keyboard and mouse sharing app that lets you control nearby computers with one computer's keyboard, mouse, or trackpad and work seamlessly between them. It works like a software KVM without the video, with TLS encryption on by default, plus Wayland and clipboard sharing support.
en.content: The repo holds the full cross-platform desktop app source, including the core sharing logic, per-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux) build and packaging configs, and distribution channels such as stable, continuous builds, Flathub, and Homebrew.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and built for Windows, macOS, and Linux, it relies on platform graphics/input layers (including Wayland) and uses TLS-encrypted communication.
en.hot: As the open-source successor to Synergy, it scratches a real multi-machine workflow itch, with roughly 28.7k stars total and 201 added this week, ranking 11th on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list.
uses: Developers juggling a laptop and desktop who want one keyboard and mouse across screens
Multi-OS office users (Windows/macOS/Linux mix) needing seamless switching
Teams and individuals replacing hardware KVMs or Synergy with a free open-source option
Privacy-conscious users who want encryption by default plus clipboard sharing

zh.tag: DHH 打造的精致现代 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Omarchy 是一个由 DHH（Ruby on Rails 创始人）打造的 Linux 发行版，注重美观、现代和明确的观点。它提供了一套完整的桌面环境，包括终端、编辑器、AI 工具等，并配有详尽的用户手册。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 manual/ 目录，内含 51 篇 Markdown 格式的手册章节，涵盖入门、导航、应用、配置等主题。此外还有安装脚本和配置文件，用于构建和定制系统。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Shell 脚本进行系统配置和安装，依赖 Linux 生态中的各种开源工具（如 Neovim、终端模拟器等）。手册使用 Markdown 编写，并托管在 learn.omacom.io。
zh.hot: 凭借 DHH 的知名度和对美观、现代体验的强调，Omarchy 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 6475 星，总星数达 34824，登上趋势榜第三。
uses: 喜欢 DHH 风格、追求开箱即用且美观的 Linux 桌面用户
希望从 Mac/Windows 迁移到 Linux 并希望有完整指南的用户
对 Linux 发行版定制和配置感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A beautiful, modern & opinionated Linux distro by DHH
en.what: Omarchy is a Linux distribution created by DHH (creator of Ruby on Rails), focusing on beauty, modernity, and strong opinions. It provides a complete desktop environment including terminal, editor, AI tools, and comes with an extensive user manual.
en.content: The repository contains a manual/ directory with 51 Markdown chapters covering topics like getting started, navigation, applications, and configuration. It also includes installation scripts and configuration files for building and customizing the system.
en.stack: Primarily uses Shell scripts for system configuration and installation, relying on various open-source tools from the Linux ecosystem (e.g., Neovim, terminal emulators). The manual is written in Markdown and hosted on learn.omacom.io.
en.hot: Thanks to DHH's fame and the emphasis on beautiful, modern experience, Omarchy quickly gained popularity on GitHub, adding 6,475 stars this week to reach 34,824 total, ranking #3 on the trending list.
uses: Linux desktop users who appreciate DHH's style and want a beautiful, out-of-the-box experience
Users migrating from Mac/Windows to Linux who want a comprehensive guide
Developers interested in customizing and configuring a Linux distribution

zh.tag: Claude 社区插件市场，只读镜像，每日同步
zh.what: 这是 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的社区插件市场仓库，包含可安装的插件列表。它由 Anthropic 内部审核流程同步，所有插件都经过安全扫描和批准。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 marketplace.json 文件，列出了所有社区插件及其元数据。此外还有 README 说明如何使用和提交插件。
zh.stack: 主要语言是 Python，但仓库本身是静态 JSON 数据，由自动化流程同步。
zh.hot: 今日新增 190 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，因为 Claude 插件生态正在快速增长，开发者需要官方认可的插件来源。
uses: Claude Code 用户：通过命令行快速安装社区插件，扩展功能。
插件开发者：提交插件到官方市场，获得分发和曝光。
企业团队：在受控环境中使用经过安全审核的插件。

en.tag: Read-only mirror of Claude community plugin marketplace, synced nightly
en.what: This is the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code, containing a list of installable plugins. It is synced from Anthropic's internal review pipeline, and all plugins have passed security scanning and approval.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a marketplace.json file listing all community plugins with their metadata, plus a README explaining how to use and submit plugins.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, but the repo itself is static JSON data synced by automated processes.
en.hot: Gained 190 stars today and hit the trending list, as the Claude plugin ecosystem is rapidly growing and developers need an official source for plugins.
uses: Claude Code users: quickly install community plugins via CLI to extend functionality.
Plugin developers: submit plugins to the official marketplace for distribution and visibility.
Enterprise teams: use security-reviewed plugins in controlled environments.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 写的本地优先罗技 Options+ 替代品
zh.what: OpenLogi 是一个开源的罗技外设配置工具，通过 HID++ 协议直接与设备通信，支持按键重映射、DPI 调节和 SmartShift 等功能。它无需罗技账号，不收集遥测数据，所有配置以本地 TOML 文件保存，强调隐私和本地优先。
zh.content: 仓库包含三个组件：OpenLogi GUI（GPUI 桌面应用，提供交互式鼠标图示、按键动作选择器、DPI 预设、SmartShift、RGB 键盘灯效、按应用配置文件等）、OpenLogi agent（后台服务，负责输入钩子和设备 I/O）以及相关的文档和配置示例。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，GUI 基于 GPUI（Zed 编辑器所用的框架），通过 HID++ 协议与罗技设备通信，支持 Logi Bolt、Unifying 接收器、蓝牙直连和 USB 连接。
zh.hot: 作为罗技官方 Options+ 的开源替代品，它解决了用户对官方软件臃肿、遥测和账号要求的痛点，在 Rust 社区和追求隐私的用户中迅速走红，GitHub 星标已超 8600，今日新增 115。
uses: 罗技外设用户：希望摆脱官方 Options+ 的臃肿和遥测，获得本地优先的配置体验
Rust 开发者：对 GPUI 桌面应用开发或 HID++ 协议实现感兴趣的开发者
隐私倡导者：拒绝账号绑定和数据收集，偏好开源软件的用户

en.tag: A native, local-first Logitech Options+ alternative in Rust
en.what: OpenLogi is an open-source Logitech peripheral configuration tool that communicates directly with devices via HID++, supporting button remapping, DPI adjustment, and SmartShift. It requires no Logitech account, collects no telemetry, and stores all configuration in local TOML files, emphasizing privacy and local-first principles.
en.content: The repository contains three components: OpenLogi GUI (a GPUI desktop app with interactive mouse diagram, per-button action picker, DPI presets, SmartShift, RGB keyboard lighting, per-application profiles), OpenLogi agent (background service owning input hook and device I/O), plus documentation and config examples.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, the GUI is built with GPUI (the framework used by Zed editor), communicates with Logitech devices via HID++ protocol, supporting Logi Bolt, Unifying receivers, Bluetooth-direct, and USB connections.
en.hot: As an open-source alternative to Logitech's official Options+, it addresses user pain points with bloat, telemetry, and account requirements, quickly gaining popularity in the Rust community and among privacy-conscious users, with over 8.6k stars and 115 added today.
uses: Logitech peripheral users who want a local-first config experience without bloat and telemetry
Rust developers interested in GPUI desktop app development or HID++ protocol implementation
Privacy advocates who reject account requirements and data collection, preferring open-source software

zh.tag: Cursor 官方插件规范与插件集合
zh.what: 这是 Cursor 官方维护的插件规范与插件仓库，定义了 agent 插件如何以独立目录加 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单的形式组织。仓库同时收录了一批面向开发者工具、框架和 SaaS 产品的官方插件，覆盖代码审查、任务编排、学习记忆等场景。
zh.content: 仓库根目录下每个插件是一个独立目录，各自带有 .cursor-plugin/plugin.json 清单，README 用表格列出插件名、作者、分类与描述。已收录 teaching、continual-learning、cursor-team-kit、thermos、create-plugin、ralph-loop、orchestrate、pstack、advisor、grok-voice 等十余个插件。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，插件以清单文件加目录结构的形式分发，部分插件依赖 Cursor SDK 与 CLI 能力。整体是围绕 Cursor agent 生态的插件化扩展方案。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4683 star，总 star 达 7254，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 3 名。Cursor 官方亲自下场定义插件规范，加上 agent 工具链正处风口，让开发者迅速涌入关注。
uses: Cursor 深度用户：想用官方插件扩展 agent 的代码审查、编排与学习能力
插件开发者：需要遵循官方规范脚手架并发布自己的 agent 插件
团队工程负责人：关注 CI、代码评审与本地自动化的内部工作流插件

en.stack: The primary language is TypeScript, and plugins are distributed as manifest files plus directory structures, with some relying on the Cursor SDK and CLI capabilities. Overall it is a plugin-based extension scheme around the Cursor agent ecosystem.

zh.tag: AI 代理的自进化上下文数据库，统一记忆、知识与技能
zh.what: OpenViking 是一个为 AI 代理设计的开源上下文数据库，将记忆、资源和技能统一为一个虚拟文件系统（viking:// 协议），代理可以通过 ls、tree、find 等命令浏览自己的上下文，而不是查询黑盒向量存储。内容被处理为三层（L0 摘要、L1 概览、L2 细节），并按需加载，每次检索都会留下可观察和调试的轨迹。
zh.content: 仓库包含 OpenViking 的核心实现，包括虚拟文件系统、三层内容处理管道、检索轨迹记录，以及 OpenViking Studio 在线演示环境。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，可能依赖向量数据库、文件系统抽象和 AI 代理框架，具体技术栈未在摘要中详述。
zh.hot: OpenViking 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，已获得 28,893 颗星，今日新增 239 颗，位列 Python 趋势榜第 9 名。其创新的上下文管理方式（将记忆、知识和技能统一为文件系统）吸引了大量关注，解决了 AI 代理上下文管理的痛点。
uses: AI 代理开发者：需要高效管理代理上下文、记忆和技能的场景。
RAG 应用构建者：希望用文件系统方式替代传统向量检索的团队。

en.tag: Self-evolving context database for AI agents, unifying memory, knowledge RAG, and skills
en.what: OpenViking is an open-source context database for AI agents, unifying memories, resources, and skills into one virtual filesystem under the viking:// protocol, so agents can browse their context with ls, tree, and find instead of querying a black-box vector store. Content is processed into three tiers (L0 abstract, L1 overview, L2 details) and loaded on demand, with every retrieval leaving a traceable trajectory for debugging.
en.content: The repository contains the core implementation of OpenViking, including the virtual filesystem, three-tier content processing pipeline, retrieval trajectory logging, and the OpenViking Studio live demo environment.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, likely leveraging vector databases, filesystem abstractions, and AI agent frameworks, though the exact stack is not detailed in the summary.

Its innovative approach to context management—unifying memory, knowledge, and skills into a filesystem—has attracted significant attention, addressing a key pain point in AI agent context handling.
uses: AI agent developers: scenarios requiring efficient management of agent context, memory, and skills.
RAG application builders: teams looking to replace traditional vector retrieval with a filesystem approach.
Research and education: for exploring new paradigms in agent context management.
