zh.tag: 苹果芯片本地大模型推理加速器，速度约翻倍
zh.what: MTPLX 是一个在 Apple Silicon 上本地运行大语言模型的原生 Mac 应用与命令行工具。它利用 Qwen 3.5/3.6/3.8 等模型内置的 MTP（多 token 预测）头做投机解码，无需额外的草稿模型，就能在保持相同输出分布的前提下把推理速度提升约 1.6~2.24 倍。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 实现的推理引擎、CLI 入口、Mac 应用（DMG 分发）、模型量化配置（4-bit/8-bit 动态量化）以及基准测试与文档。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 MLX 框架与 Apple Metal，支持 macOS 14+ 和 M1 及以上芯片；可通过 Homebrew 或 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1116 星，总星数达 2280，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 13 名。它切中了苹果芯片用户本地跑大模型的性能痛点，且无需额外草稿模型、不牺牲输出质量，实用性很强。
uses: 苹果芯片 Mac 用户，想在本地快速运行 Qwen 等大模型
开发者需要离线、低延迟的代码补全或对话推理
研究者测试投机解码与 MTP 加速效果
对隐私敏感、不愿把数据发到云端的用户

en.tag: Native MTP speculative decoding for local LLMs on Apple Silicon, ~2x faster
en.what: MTPLX is a native Mac app and CLI for running local LLMs on Apple Silicon. It uses the built-in MTP (multi-token prediction) heads of models like Qwen 3.5/3.6/3.8 for speculative decoding with no external drafter, delivering roughly 1.6x-2.24x faster inference while preserving the exact output distribution.
en.content: The repo contains a Python inference engine, a CLI entry point, a native Mac app (distributed as a DMG), model quantization configs (4-bit/8-bit dynamic quant), plus benchmarks and documentation.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.11+, MLX and Apple Metal, targeting macOS 14+ on M1 or newer; installable via Homebrew or pip.
en.hot: It gained 1,116 stars this month (2,280 total), ranking #13 on GitHub Trending monthly. It addresses the performance pain of running local LLMs on Apple Silicon without an extra draft model or quality loss, making it highly practical.
uses: Apple Silicon Mac users who want to run Qwen and other LLMs locally with high speed
Developers needing offline, low-latency code completion or chat inference
Researchers benchmarking speculative decoding and MTP acceleration
Privacy-conscious users who prefer not to send data to the cloud

zh.tag: Google 时序预测基础模型，支持多变量与协变量
zh.what: TimesFM 是 Google Research 开发的预训练时序基础模型，用于时间序列预测。它采用 decoder-only 架构，在大量时序数据上预训练，能够进行零样本预测。最新 3.0 版本支持原生多变量预测和协变量，并在多个基准上排名第一。
zh.content: 仓库包含模型源码、预训练权重（Hugging Face）、示例和文档。代码结构分版本管理，最新 3.0 在根目录，旧版本归档在 v1 子目录。
zh.stack: 基于 PyTorch 实现，依赖 Hugging Face Transformers 等。提供 pip 包安装，支持 Python。
zh.hot: 近期发布 3.0 版本，带来多变量预测和协变量支持，在三大基准上排名第一，引发社区关注。今日新增 1618 star，总星标超 3 万。
uses: 时间序列预测研究者：用于零样本预测和模型对比实验
数据科学家：快速进行多变量预测，无需大量训练数据
企业应用开发者：集成到 BigQuery ML 或 Vertex AI 进行规模化预测

en.tag: Google's pretrained time-series foundation model for forecasting, with multivariate & covariate support
en.what: TimesFM is a pretrained time-series foundation model by Google Research for time-series forecasting. It uses a decoder-only architecture pretrained on diverse time-series data, enabling zero-shot forecasting. The latest 3.0 version natively supports multivariate forecasting and covariates, ranking #1 on multiple benchmarks.
en.content: The repo contains model source code, pretrained weights (on Hugging Face), examples, and docs. Code is organized by version; latest 3.0 is at root, older versions archived under v1.
en.stack: Implemented in PyTorch, leveraging Hugging Face Transformers. Installable via pip, Python-based.
en.hot: The recent 3.0 release with native multivariate forecasting and covariates, achieving #1 on three major benchmarks, has sparked interest. Gained 1,618 stars today, total over 30k.
uses: Time-series researchers: for zero-shot forecasting and model benchmarking
Data scientists: for quick multivariate forecasting without extensive training data
Enterprise developers: integrating with BigQuery ML or Vertex AI for scalable forecasting

zh.tag: 一键生成高清短视频的AI自动化工具
zh.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo 是一个一站式 AI 短视频生成工具，用户只需提供主题或关键词，它就能自动完成脚本撰写、素材匹配、字幕生成、背景音乐合成，最终输出高清短视频。它支持 WebUI 和 API 两种交互方式，适合快速批量制作视频内容。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 项目源码，提供 WebUI 图形界面和 API 服务，内置视频生成工作流，支持多种素材源和 AI 模型接入，并附带详细的文档和示例。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.11+，依赖 AI 大模型（如 Kimi K3）进行文案生成，使用自动化工作流处理素材下载、字幕生成和视频合成，支持跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux）。
zh.hot: 凭借 12 万+ Star 和月增近 2 万的热度，它精准切中短视频创作者对高效内容生产的需求，将复杂的视频制作流程简化为一次点击，极大降低了创作门槛。
uses: 短视频创作者：快速将热点话题或关键词转化为成片，提升内容产出效率。
自媒体运营者：批量生成不同主题的视频，用于多平台分发和测试。
营销人员：制作产品宣传或广告短视频，无需专业视频编辑技能。
开发者：通过 API 集成到自己的应用或流程中，实现自动化视频生成。

en.tag: One-click AI tool to auto-generate HD short videos
en.what: MoneyPrinterTurbo is an all-in-one AI short video generator. Users only need to provide a topic or keyword, and it automatically handles script writing, footage matching, subtitle generation, background music synthesis, and outputs HD short videos. It offers both WebUI and API interfaces, enabling rapid batch video production.
en.content: The repository contains complete Python source code, offering a WebUI and API service with a built-in video generation workflow. It supports multiple footage sources and AI model integrations, along with detailed documentation and examples.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.11+, leveraging AI LLMs (e.g., Kimi K3) for script generation, and using automated workflows for footage downloading, subtitle creation, and video composition. Cross-platform support for Windows/macOS/Linux.
en.hot: With over 120K stars and nearly 20K monthly additions, it addresses the high demand for efficient short-video creation, simplifying complex production into one click and drastically lowering the barrier for creators.
uses: Short-video creators: Quickly turn trending topics or keywords into finished videos to boost productivity.
Social media managers: Batch-generate videos on various themes for multi-platform distribution and testing.
Marketers: Create promotional or ad videos without professional editing skills.
Developers: Integrate the API into custom applications or workflows for automated video generation.

zh.tag: macOS 菜单栏原生 LLM 推理服务器，支持连续批处理与 SSD 缓存
zh.what: oMLX 是一个专为 Apple Silicon 优化的 LLM 推理服务器，提供连续批处理和分层 KV 缓存，将热数据保存在内存、冷数据存储在 SSD，并支持跨请求复用缓存。用户可通过 macOS 菜单栏直接管理模型、切换上下文长度，并监控性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 macOS 应用（.dmg 安装包）、Homebrew 安装支持、CLI 工具（~/.omlx/bin/omlx）以及可选的 MCP 支持。还提供多语言 README（中/英/韩/日）和基准测试页面。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.11-3.13，针对 Apple Silicon 优化，可能包含自定义内核（如 GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3）。支持 Homebrew 安装，可选安装 MCP 依赖。
zh.hot: 针对 Mac 用户痛点：在便利性和控制力之间取得平衡，通过菜单栏管理 LLM 服务器，并利用 SSD 缓存实现长上下文复用，适合本地 AI 开发。Star 数近 1.9 万，今日新增 78，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 8 名。
uses: Mac 用户希望在本地运行 LLM，并通过菜单栏轻松管理模型和上下文
开发者使用 Claude Code 等工具进行真实编码，需要跨请求缓存以提升效率
需要灵活控制内存和 SSD 缓存、自动切换模型的高级用户
通过 Homebrew 或 CLI 集成到自动化工作流（如 Apple Shortcuts）

en.tag: Native macOS menu bar LLM inference server with continuous batching & SSD caching
en.what: oMLX is an LLM inference server optimized for Apple Silicon, featuring continuous batching and tiered KV caching that persists hot data in memory and cold data on SSD, enabling cache reuse across requests. Users can manage models, switch context lengths, and monitor performance directly from the macOS menu bar.
en.content: The repository includes a full macOS app (.dmg installer), Homebrew installation support, a CLI shim (~/.omlx/bin/omlx), and optional MCP support. It also provides multilingual READMEs (EN/ZH/KO/JA) and a benchmarks page.
en.stack: Primarily Python 3.11-3.13, optimized for Apple Silicon, possibly with custom kernels (e.g., GLM-5.2 / MiniMax M3). Supports Homebrew installation, with optional MCP dependencies.
en.hot: Addresses Mac users' pain point: balancing convenience and control by managing LLM servers from the menu bar, with SSD caching for long-context reuse, ideal for local AI development. With ~19k stars and +78 today, it ranks #8 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Mac users who want to run LLMs locally and manage models/context from the menu bar
Developers using tools like Claude Code for real coding, needing cross-request caching for efficiency
Power users who need flexible control over memory/SSD caching and auto-swapping models
Those integrating with automation workflows via Homebrew or CLI (e.g., Apple Shortcuts)

zh.tag: 2小时从零训练64M超小语言模型，全流程开源教程
zh.what: MiniMind 是一个从零开始训练超小语言模型（64M参数）的开源项目，仅需3块钱成本和2小时即可在单张消费级GPU上完成训练。项目覆盖从数据清洗、预训练到SFT、RLHF、Agentic RL等完整链路，并扩展了视觉、多模态等变体。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的训练代码、模型结构定义、数据预处理脚本、训练教程和多个模型变体（如MiniMind-V、MiniMind-O）。所有核心算法均用PyTorch原生实现，不依赖高层封装库。
zh.stack: 基于Python和PyTorch，从零实现Transformer、MoE、LoRA、DPO、PPO等算法，不依赖transformers/trl等库。
zh.hot: 以极低成本（3元/2小时）训练LLM的颠覆性理念，加上全流程开源和教程性质，吸引了大量希望深入理解LLM的开发者。56k星标和日增近500星，说明其精准切中了个人开发者复现大模型的需求。
uses: LLM初学者：通过从零实现和训练，深入理解大模型内部机制，而非仅使用现成库。
个人开发者/研究者：在消费级GPU上快速实验预训练、微调、RLHF等全流程。
教育场景：作为高校或培训机构的AI课程实战项目，低成本复现前沿技术。
对模型压缩和高效训练感兴趣者：探索64M小模型的性能边界和扩展方向。

en.tag: Train a 64M LLM from scratch in 2h with full pipeline, open-source tutorial
en.what: MiniMind is an open-source project to train a tiny 64M-parameter LLM from scratch, costing only $0.4 and 2 hours on a single consumer GPU. It covers the full pipeline from data cleaning, pretraining to SFT, RLHF, Agentic RL, and extends to vision and multimodal variants.
en.content: The repo contains full training code, model architecture definitions, data preprocessing scripts, tutorials, and several model variants (e.g., MiniMind-V, MiniMind-O). All core algorithms are implemented natively in PyTorch without high-level wrappers.
en.stack: Built with Python and PyTorch, implementing Transformer, MoE, LoRA, DPO, PPO from scratch, without relying on libraries like transformers/trl.
en.hot: The disruptive idea of training an LLM for just $0.4 and 2 hours, combined with full open-source pipeline and tutorial nature, attracts developers eager to understand LLMs deeply. With 56k stars and ~500 daily additions, it hits the need for personal reproduction of LLMs.
uses: LLM beginners: gain deep understanding of LLM internals by implementing and training from scratch, not just using off-the-shelf libraries.
Individual developers/researchers: quickly experiment with pretraining, fine-tuning, RLHF on consumer GPUs.
Educational settings: as a hands-on project for AI courses, reproducing cutting-edge techniques at low cost.
Those interested in model compression and efficient training: explore the performance limits of 64M small models.

zh.tag: 把任意 AI 代理变成科学家的技能库，覆盖生物、化学、医学等 163 个技能
zh.what: 这是一个开源的科学 Agent 技能库，提供 163 个即用型技能和 100+ 科学数据库，覆盖生物学、化学、医学和药物发现。它兼容 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等主流 AI 代理，并遵循开放的 Agent Skills 标准，让任何 AI 代理都能执行科学任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含技能定义、测试用例、文档和示例，以及一个可选的本地 AI 协同科学家工具 K-Dense BYOK。技能以标准格式组织，便于集成和扩展。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python，依赖 Agent Skills 标准，支持多种 AI 代理平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3.47 万星标和 17.5 万科学家用户，它填补了 AI 代理在科学领域应用的空白，成为最受欢迎的科学技能库。
uses: 科研人员：快速让 AI 代理执行文献分析、实验设计等任务。
开发者：为 AI 代理集成科学技能，构建垂直领域应用。
教育者：在教学中使用 AI 辅助科学探索，提升学生参与度。

en.tag: Turn any AI agent into an AI Scientist with 163 validated skills and 100+ scientific databases.
en.what: An open-source library of scientific Agent Skills, offering 163 ready-to-use skills and 100+ scientific databases across biology, chemistry, medicine, and drug discovery. It works with Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and other AI agents, following the open Agent Skills standard, enabling any agent to perform scientific tasks.
en.content: The repo contains skill definitions, tests, documentation, examples, and an optional local AI co-scientist tool K-Dense BYOK. Skills are organized in a standard format for easy integration and extension.
en.stack: Primarily Python-based, relying on the Agent Skills standard, compatible with multiple AI agent platforms.
en.hot: With 34.7k stars and 175k+ scientist users, it fills a gap in AI agent applications for science, becoming the most popular scientific skills library.
uses: Researchers: quickly enable AI agents to perform literature analysis, experiment design, etc.
Developers: integrate scientific skills into AI agents to build domain-specific applications.
Educators: use AI-assisted scientific exploration in teaching to boost student engagement.

zh.tag: 全自动去除语言模型审查的优化工具
zh.what: Heretic 是一个无需昂贵后训练即可移除 Transformer 语言模型审查（安全对齐）的工具。它结合方向消融（abliteration）与基于 TPE 的参数优化器，自动寻找高质量消融参数，同时最小化拒绝次数和与原始模型的 KL 散度，从而保留模型智能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Python 实现、命令行界面、自动优化流程、支持多种模型架构（稠密、MoE、混合如 Qwen3.5），并提供示例配置和基准测试结果。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch、Transformers、Optuna（TPE 优化器）等，实现方向消融和参数优化。
zh.hot: 2.87 万星标，日增 150，登上日榜第 6。它让非专家也能一键去除模型审查，且效果媲美人工调优，引发广泛关注。
uses: AI 研究人员和开发者，希望快速去除模型审查而不损失性能。
对模型安全对齐机制感兴趣，想探索方向消融技术的实践者。
需要定制模型行为、去除内容限制的普通用户，无需深入理解内部原理。

en.tag: Fully automatic censorship removal for language models via TPE-based optimization
en.what: Heretic is a tool that removes censorship (safety alignment) from transformer-based language models without expensive post-training. It combines directional ablation (abliteration) with a TPE-based parameter optimizer to automatically find high-quality parameters that minimize refusals and KL divergence from the original model, preserving intelligence.
en.content: The repository contains a full Python implementation, CLI, automatic optimization pipeline, support for dense, MoE, and hybrid models (e.g., Qwen3.5), along with example configs and benchmark results.
en.stack: Built with Python, leveraging PyTorch, Transformers, and Optuna for TPE-based optimization, implementing directional ablation.
en.hot: With 28.7k stars and +150 daily, ranking #6 on the daily trend, it enables non-experts to decensor models with one command, rivaling manual abliteration, sparking wide interest.
uses: AI researchers and developers seeking to remove model censorship quickly without performance loss.
Practitioners interested in safety alignment mechanisms and directional ablation techniques.
General users who need to customize model behavior or remove content restrictions without deep technical knowledge.

zh.tag: 全栈 AI 红队平台，守护 AI 生态安全
zh.what: AI-Infra-Guard 是一个全栈 AI 红队平台，用于扫描和评估 AI 生态系统的安全性。它支持 Agent 扫描、技能扫描、MCP 扫描、AI 基础设施扫描以及 LLM 越狱评估，帮助发现潜在漏洞。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台代码，包括扫描器、评估模块、文档和 Docker 镜像。提供多语言 README（中文、日文、西班牙文等），并集成了 ClawHub 和 OpenClaw 等工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 开发，支持 Docker 部署，并可能涉及 LLM 评估框架和云原生技术。
zh.hot: 随着 AI 安全日益重要，该平台提供了全面的红队测试方案，本月新增近 1800 星，登上 GitHub 趋势榜，反映了社区对 AI 安全工具的高需求。
uses: 安全研究人员：用于评估 AI 系统的安全性，发现潜在漏洞。
AI 开发者：在开发过程中集成安全测试，确保 AI 应用合规。
企业安全团队：部署平台以监控和保护 AI 基础设施。

en.tag: Full-stack AI Red Teaming platform securing AI ecosystems
en.what: AI-Infra-Guard is a full-stack AI red teaming platform that scans and evaluates the security of AI ecosystems. It supports agent scanning, skills scanning, MCP scanning, AI infrastructure scanning, and LLM jailbreak evaluation to uncover potential vulnerabilities.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform code, including scanners, evaluation modules, documentation, and Docker images. It offers multi-language READMEs (Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, etc.) and integrates with tools like ClawHub and OpenClaw.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Python, supports Docker deployment, and may involve LLM evaluation frameworks and cloud-native technologies.
en.hot: As AI security becomes increasingly critical, this platform offers comprehensive red teaming solutions. With nearly 1,800 stars added this month and trending on GitHub, it reflects the community's high demand for AI security tools.
uses: Security researchers: to evaluate the security of AI systems and uncover vulnerabilities.
AI developers: to integrate security testing during development and ensure compliance.
Enterprise security teams: to deploy the platform for monitoring and protecting AI infrastructure.

zh.tag: A股自动选股系统，收盘后扫描形态并推送飞书
zh.what: Sequoia-X 是一个面向 A 股市场的量化选股系统，基于 Python 工程化标准重构。它每日收盘后自动运行多种技术形态策略，筛选出符合条件的股票，并通过飞书推送结果。系统支持日常增量更新和全量历史数据回填。
zh.content: 仓库包含主入口 main.py、核心配置与日志模块、数据引擎（基于 baostock 和 SQLite）、多个策略实现（如海龟突破、均线放量等），以及飞书通知模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 3.10+，依赖 baostock 获取行情数据，SQLite 存储，使用 Pydantic-settings 管理配置，支持 uv 或 pip 安装。
zh.hot: 今日新增 512 星，总星数 6489，登上 GitHub Python 日榜第 8。因其为 A 股散户提供免费、自动化的选股工具，且设计清晰、易部署，受到关注。
uses: A股个人投资者：每日自动获取技术形态选股结果，节省复盘时间。
量化爱好者：可参考其策略实现与数据架构，进行二次开发或学习。
需要自动化推送的团队：可集成飞书机器人，实现定时任务通知。

en.tag: Automated A-share stock screening with pattern scanning and Feishu push after market close
en.what: Sequoia-X is a quantitative stock screening system for the A-share market, rebuilt with modern Python engineering standards. It automatically runs multiple technical pattern strategies after market close, filters stocks meeting criteria, and pushes results via Feishu. It supports daily incremental updates and full historical data backfill.
en.content: The repository includes the main entry point main.py, core config and logging modules, a data engine (based on baostock and SQLite), multiple strategy implementations (e.g., TurtleTrade, MaVolume), and a Feishu notification module.
en.stack: Built with Python 3.10+, uses baostock for market data, SQLite for storage, Pydantic-settings for config, and supports installation via uv or pip.
en.hot: Gained 512 stars today, total 6489, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending for Python. It attracts attention for offering a free, automated stock screening tool for A-share retail investors, with clean design and easy deployment.
uses: A-share retail investors: automatically get technical pattern screening results daily, saving review time.
Quant enthusiasts: can reference its strategy implementations and data architecture for further development or learning.
Teams needing automated notifications: can integrate Feishu bot for scheduled task alerts.

zh.tag: 为 AI 代理打造的开源 Palantir，图原生上下文与可问责基础设施
zh.what: Semantica 是一个图原生的基础设施，用于构建上下文感知且可问责的 AI 系统。它支持企业数据接入、上下文图与知识图谱构建，并提供图分析与因果推理，内置完整的决策溯源，确保可解释、可追踪和可信赖。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 Python 库、CLI 工具、文档与示例，支持 RDF 和 LPG 多语言图存储，遵循 W3C 标准，提供本体管理与决策智能模块。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.8+，依赖图数据库（如 RDF 三元组存储和属性图数据库），集成知识图谱与因果推理库，遵循 W3C 标准，提供开放 API 与 PyPI 分发。
zh.hot: 本月新增超 1 万 star，位居趋势榜第二，因其定位为“AI 代理的开源 Palantir”，切中高监管领域对可解释、可溯源 AI 的迫切需求，同时强调开放、治理与零厂商锁定。
uses: 企业 AI 团队：需要为代理系统提供可靠上下文与决策溯源，满足合规审计要求。
知识图谱开发者：希望利用 RDF/LPG 标准构建可互操作的知识模型，并进行图分析与推理。
高监管行业（金融、医疗、政务）：要求 AI 决策可解释、可追踪，降低风险并提升信任。
AI 基础设施研究者：探索图原生架构与因果推理在 AI 系统中的应用，构建可问责的智能体。

en.tag: Open-source Palantir for AI agents: graph-native context & accountable AI infrastructure
en.what: Semantica is a graph-native infrastructure for building context-aware and accountable AI systems. It ingests enterprise data, extracts what matters, builds context and knowledge graphs, and runs graph analytics and causal reasoning with full decision provenance baked in, making AI explainable, traceable, and trustworthy by design.
en.content: The repository contains the core Python library, CLI tools, documentation, and examples, supporting polyglot graph storage with RDF and LPG, W3C standards, ontology management, and decision intelligence modules.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.8+, leveraging graph databases (RDF triple stores and property graphs), integrating knowledge graph and causal reasoning libraries, following W3C standards, with open APIs and PyPI distribution.
en.hot: With over 10k stars added this month and ranking #2 on the trending list, it's hot because it positions as the 'open-source Palantir for AI agents', addressing the urgent need for explainable and traceable AI in regulated domains, while emphasizing openness, governance, and zero vendor lock-in.
uses: Enterprise AI teams needing reliable context and decision provenance for agent systems to meet compliance and audit requirements.
Knowledge graph developers looking to build interoperable knowledge models using RDF/LPG standards with graph analytics and reasoning.
Regulated industries (finance, healthcare, government) requiring explainable and traceable AI decisions to reduce risk and build trust.
AI infrastructure researchers exploring graph-native architectures and causal reasoning for accountable intelligent agents.

zh.tag: 把一个人的经验与判断蒸馏成可复用 Agent 技能
zh.what: Distilly 是一个「人格建模层」：把聊天记录、文档、访谈、公开资料等素材，蒸馏成可移植、有来源依据的 Person Profile。它不声称克隆真人，而是提炼可观察的经验、决策模式、表达方式与工作方法，再打包成 Agent Skill 供各类 Agent 或 Bot 安装调用。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现，核心是名为 distilly 的创建者 Skill，需安装在 distilly 目录下；另含 docs 文档、多语言 README（中/西/德/日/俄/葡/韩）与社交预览图等资源。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.9+，遵循 AgentSkills 标准，采用 MIT 许可证，并提供 Discord 社区支持。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3754 star、总数达 24685，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Python 第 16 名；「同事离职带走全部经验」的痛点加上从 Colleague Skill 更名的故事，让它迅速出圈。
uses: 想留住离职同事、毕业导师或转岗队友经验与工作方法的团队
希望为特定人物（家人、老友、偶像、公众人物）构建对话式 Agent 的开发者
需要把访谈、文档、聊天记录等非结构化素材转成可复用 Agent 技能的研究者或产品经理
想把自己的判断与表达方式蒸馏成个人 Agent 的个人用户

en.tag: Distill a person's experience and judgment into reusable Agent Skills
en.what: Distilly is a person-modeling layer for agents: it turns messages, documents, interviews and public sources into a portable, source-grounded Person Profile. Rather than claiming to clone a real person, it captures observable experience, decision patterns, voice and ways of working, then packages each profile as an Agent Skill that compatible agents or bots can install and invoke.
en.content: The repo is a Python project whose core is a creator Skill named `distilly`, meant to be installed in a `distilly` directory, alongside docs, multi-language READMEs (ZH/ES/DE/JA/RU/PT/KO) and social preview assets.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.9+, follows the AgentSkills standard, is MIT-licensed, and offers a Discord community.
en.hot: It gained 3,754 stars this month for a total of 24,685, ranking 16th on GitHub Trending's monthly Python list; the pain point of a departing colleague taking all their know-how, plus its rename from Colleague Skill, drove rapid traction.
uses: Teams wanting to preserve the know-how of departing colleagues, graduating mentors or transferred teammates
Developers building conversational agents around specific people such as family, old friends, idols or public figures
Researchers or PMs turning interviews, documents and chat logs into reusable Agent Skills
Individuals who want to distill their own judgment and voice into a personal agent

zh.tag: 截图秒变前端代码的AI工具
zh.what: 这是一个利用AI将截图、设计稿、Figma设计甚至屏幕录制转换为干净、可运行的前端代码（如HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue）的工具。用户只需上传图片或录制视频，即可获得对应的功能原型或代码实现。
zh.content: 仓库包含React/Vite前端和FastAPI后端，支持多种技术栈（HTML+Tailwind、React+Tailwind、Vue+Tailwind等），并集成多个AI模型（如Gemini、GPT、Claude）用于代码生成和图像处理。
zh.stack: 主要使用Python（FastAPI）作为后端，前端采用React/Vite，依赖OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini等AI模型API，以及Replicate用于图像生成和编辑。
zh.hot: 凭借75.5K星标和今日新增326星，该工具因其直观的“截图转代码”功能而广受欢迎，大幅降低了前端开发门槛，尤其适合快速原型制作。
uses: 前端开发者快速将设计稿或截图转化为可用的HTML/CSS/React代码
产品经理或设计师验证UI概念，无需手动编写代码
教育场景中教学前端开发，通过示例直观展示代码生成

en.tag: Turn screenshots into clean frontend code with AI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI to convert screenshots, mockups, Figma designs, and even screen recordings into clean, functional frontend code (e.g., HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). Users upload an image or recording and get a working prototype or code implementation.
en.content: The repo includes a React/Vite frontend and a FastAPI backend, supporting multiple stacks (HTML+Tailwind, React+Tailwind, Vue+Tailwind, etc.) and integrating several AI models (e.g., Gemini, GPT, Claude) for code generation and image processing.
en.stack: Primarily Python (FastAPI) backend with React/Vite frontend, relying on AI model APIs from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, and Replicate for image generation/editing.
en.hot: With 75.5K stars and +326 today, this tool is popular for its intuitive 'screenshot-to-code' capability, significantly lowering the barrier for frontend development, especially for rapid prototyping.
uses: Frontend developers quickly convert design mockups or screenshots into usable HTML/CSS/React code
Product managers or designers validate UI concepts without manually writing code
Educational settings for teaching frontend development by visually demonstrating code generation

zh.tag: NVIDIA 出品的 LLM 智能路由层，按需把每次调用分发给最划算的模型
zh.what: Switchyard 为 LLM 应用提供模型路由能力，在保持 OpenAI 与 Anthropic 原生 API 兼容的前提下，把每次请求分发到不同模型或供应商。它支持灵活选型、基准测试以及成本/性能优化，目标是让智能体在不改代码的情况下用上更便宜的模型。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 库 nemo-switchyard、Rust 版 switchyard-libsy 与 switchyard-llm-client，以及独立代理 switchyard-server；还提供 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 插件示例和 routes.toml 配置样例。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，同时提供 Rust 实现；依赖 LiteLLM、NeMo Relay 等网关生态，可通过 pip 或 cargo 安装，并兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic SDK 客户端。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2628 颗星、总数 2837，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 10 名；在 LLM 成本压力下，NVIDIA 背书且能无缝接入现有网关的省钱路由方案极具吸引力。
uses: 正在为 LLM 调用成本发愁、希望按任务难度自动降级的 AI 应用团队
已使用 LiteLLM 或 NeMo Relay 网关、想加入智能路由的工程团队
需要在多个模型/供应商之间做基准测试与选型对比的研究人员
想在不改代码的前提下让 Claude Code、Codex CLI 等智能体走更便宜模型的开发者

en.tag: NVIDIA's LLM routing layer that sends each call to the cheapest capable model
en.what: Switchyard routes LLM traffic across models and providers while preserving native OpenAI and Anthropic API compatibility. It enables flexible model selection, benchmarking, and cost/performance optimization, aiming to serve each call with the cheapest model that can still do the job.
en.content: It ships the Python package nemo-switchyard, the Rust crates switchyard-libsy and switchyard-llm-client, and a standalone switchyard-server proxy, plus LiteLLM and NeMo Relay plugin examples with routes.toml configs.
en.stack: Primarily Python with Rust components; it integrates with LiteLLM and NeMo Relay gateways, installs via pip or cargo, and stays compatible with OpenAI/Anthropic SDK clients.
en.hot: It gained 2,628 stars this month (2,837 total), ranking 10th on GitHub Trending monthly; with LLM cost pressure high, an NVIDIA-backed drop-in router that plugs into existing gateways is compelling.
uses: AI application teams looking to cut LLM costs by auto-downgrading per task difficulty
Engineering teams already running LiteLLM or NeMo Relay gateways who want smart routing
Researchers benchmarking and comparing models/providers for selection
Developers wanting Claude Code, Codex CLI, or other agents to use cheaper models without code changes

zh.tag: 开源零加价 LLM 网关，统一路由 BYOK 与 1000+ 模型
zh.what: Experiential 是一个面向 Agent 工作流的开源网关与路由器，用一套 OpenAI 兼容 API 统一接入托管、BYOK 和本地模型。它还能基于你的真实流量学习，推荐更优模型、压缩成本，并训练出你专属的路由器或模型。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Python 实现的网关服务，含首次运行设置向导、身份与预算控制、用量仪表盘，以及面向 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex 等编码 Agent 的 SETUP.md 接入提示。
zh.stack: 以 Python 为主，提供 OpenAI 兼容与 Anthropic Messages 接口，支持 OpenAI、Anthropic、Gemini、Azure、Bedrock、Fireworks、OpenRouter 等多家供应商密钥。
zh.hot: 本月新增 4288 星、总数 4647，几乎全部热度来自最近一个月，说明「零加价 + 自带密钥 + 可训练专属模型」的定位精准击中了团队对 LLM 成本与治理的痛点。
uses: 需要统一管理多家 LLM 供应商密钥与预算的工程团队
想用自有流量训练专属路由或模型的 AI 平台团队
希望把 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码 Agent 指向自建网关的开发者
关注 LLM 成本优化与用量可观测性的技术负责人

en.tag: Open-source zero-markup LLM gateway routing BYOK and 1000+ models
en.what: Experiential is an open-source gateway and router for agent workflows that unifies hosted, BYOK, and local models behind one OpenAI-compatible API. It also learns from your production traffic to cut costs, recommend better models, and train a specialized router or model you own.
en.content: The repo centers on a Python gateway service with a first-run setup wizard, identity and budget controls, a usage dashboard, and SETUP.md prompts for wiring in coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex.
en.stack: Primarily Python, exposing OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic Messages APIs, with support for provider keys from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Azure, Bedrock, Fireworks, and OpenRouter.
en.hot: It gained 4,288 of its 4,647 stars this month, meaning nearly all traction is recent — its zero-markup, BYOK, train-your-own-model pitch clearly hits teams' LLM cost and governance pain points.
uses: Engineering teams needing unified key and budget management across LLM providers
AI platform teams wanting to train custom routers or models from their own traffic
Developers pointing coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor at a self-hosted gateway
Tech leads focused on LLM cost optimization and usage observability

zh.tag: 14MB 端侧模型，手机/穿戴/家居/机器人皆可跑
zh.what: Needle 2 是一个 45M 参数的开放模型，专为工具调用、设备使用和结构化提取设计。整个模型打包成单个 14MB 的二进制文件，运行完整会话仅需约 28MB 内存。它基于 Simple Attention Network 架构，并采用 Cactus Quants 压缩至 CQ2 位，内置推理引擎。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 包，提供推理、LoRA 微调和导出功能。模型权重已嵌入引擎，无需额外文件，推理时无网络请求。还包含工具检索、置信度门控和 256-token 滑动窗口等特性。
zh.stack: 基于 Python，依赖 PyTorch 等，使用 Simple Attention Network 架构，Hadamard MLP、GQA 注意力、engram 键值记忆。推理引擎从 Hugging Face 获取并缓存。
zh.hot: 在 GitHub 日榜上新增 248 星，总星数 3730，因其极小的体积（14MB）和高效的端侧性能而备受关注，在基准测试中与更大的模型（如 FunctionGemma 270M）互有胜负，但体积小 5 到 70 倍。
uses: 端侧 AI 开发者：在手机、可穿戴设备等资源受限环境中部署工具调用模型。
智能家居与机器人：为设备提供本地智能，无需云端依赖。
LoRA 微调研究者：在小型模型上进行高效微调实验。

en.tag: 14MB on-device model for phones, wearables, smart home, and robots
en.what: Needle 2 is an open 45M-parameter model for tool calling, device use, and structured extraction. The entire model is a single 14MB binary that runs a full session in about 28MB of RAM. It is built on the Simple Attention Network architecture, compressed to CQ2-bit with Cactus Quants, and baked into its own engine.
en.content: The repository contains the Python package for inference, LoRA fine-tuning, and export. Weights are baked into the engine, no separate model files needed, and inference does no network calls. Features include tool retrieval, confidence gating, and a 256-token sliding window.
en.stack: Python-based, with dependencies like PyTorch. Uses Simple Attention Network architecture with Hadamard MLP, GQA attention, and engram key-value memory. The inference engine is fetched from Hugging Face and cached.
en.hot: Gained 248 stars today, total 3730, trending on GitHub. It's hot due to its tiny size (14MB) and efficient on-device performance, trading wins with larger models like FunctionGemma 270M while being 5-70x smaller.
uses: On-device AI developers: deploying tool-calling models in resource-constrained environments like phones and wearables.
Smart home and robotics: providing local intelligence for devices without cloud dependency.
LoRA fine-tuning researchers: experimenting with efficient fine-tuning on small models.

zh.tag: 开源 SEO 分析平台，支持 AI Agent 与 MCP 工具链集成
zh.what: OpenSEO 是 Semrush 和 Ahrefs 的开源替代品，提供关键词研究、排名追踪、竞品洞察、外链审计与站点诊断等核心 SEO 工作流。它采用按量付费模式，用户只需接入自己的 DataForSEO API 密钥即可使用，无需订阅。同时，它内置 MCP 服务器和可复用的 Agent Skills，让 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等 AI 代理直接调用 SEO 数据完成自动化任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的前后端应用代码与现代化 UI，支持 Docker 和 Cloudflare 自托管，内置 MCP 服务器以及预设的 Agent Skills（如 keyword-research、competitor-analysis、link-prospecting）。文档涵盖 API 密钥配置、Google Search Console 接入、SEO 成本参考及本地开发指南。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，前端采用现代 UI 框架，后端依赖 DataForSEO API 获取 SEO 数据，并通过 MCP 协议与外部 AI Agent 通信；支持 Docker 容器化部署与 Cloudflare 边缘托管。
zh.hot: 在 SEO 工具普遍昂贵且功能臃肿的背景下，它以开源、按量付费、可自托管的定位迅速获得关注；4,405 Stars 中本月新增 2,187 颗，登上 GitHub TypeScript 月榜第 17 名，其对 MCP 与 AI Agent 的原生集成进一步放大了开发者与增长团队的兴趣。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 无需订阅高价 SaaS，用自有 API 密钥低成本完成 SEO 监控与关键词研究。
AI 工程师 / Agent 开发者 —— 通过 MCP 将实时 SEO 数据接入 Claude Code、OpenClaw 等智能体，实现自动化内容策略。
增长与营销团队 —— 利用预设 Agent Skills 快速完成竞品分析、外链挖掘和排名追踪。
隐私敏感企业 —— 支持 Docker/Cloudflare 自托管，完全掌控数据与成本。

en.tag: Open-source SEO suite with AI agent & MCP integration for self-hosting
en.what: OpenSEO is an open-source alternative to Semrush and Ahrefs, offering keyword research, rank tracking, competitor insights, backlink audits, and site audits. It uses a pay-as-you-go model with your own DataForSEO API key instead of expensive subscriptions. It also exposes an MCP server and reusable Agent Skills so AI agents like Claude Code and OpenClaw can interact directly with SEO data.
en.content: The repository contains a full-stack application with a modern UI, supporting Docker and Cloudflare self-hosting, along with a built-in MCP server and pre-built Agent Skills (e.g., keyword-research, competitor-analysis, link-prospecting). Documentation covers API key setup, Google Search Console integration, SEO cost references, and local development guides.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, it features a modern frontend UI, relies on the DataForSEO API for search data, and communicates with external AI agents via the MCP protocol. It supports Docker containerization and Cloudflare edge hosting.
en.hot: It gained rapid traction as a free, pay-as-you-go, self-hostable alternative to expensive and bloated SEO suites; with 4,405 stars and 2,187 added this month alone—ranking 17th on GitHub's monthly TypeScript trending list—its native MCP and AI Agent support has further driven interest from developers and growth teams.
uses: Indie developers and small teams —— Avoid expensive subscriptions by using your own API key for low-cost SEO monitoring and keyword research.
AI engineers and agent builders —— Feed real-time SEO data into Claude Code, OpenClaw, or other agents via MCP for automated content strategy.
Growth and marketing teams —— Use pre-built Agent Skills to quickly run competitor analysis, link prospecting, and rank tracking.
Privacy-conscious organizations —— Self-host via Docker or Cloudflare to maintain full control over data and costs.

zh.tag: 自托管个人图书馆与阅读平台
zh.what: BookOrbit 是一个自托管的图书馆和阅读平台，支持电子书、PDF、有声书和漫画。它提供网页阅读器、Kobo 和 KOReader 支持，并同步阅读进度、高亮和状态。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的服务端和前端代码，提供仪表盘、书架管理、阅读统计、成就系统、OPDS 和 Send-to-Kindle 等功能，并支持多用户和 OIDC/SSO 认证。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于现代 Web 技术栈构建，支持 Docker 部署，并集成多种第三方服务（如 Crowdin 翻译、Codecov 覆盖率）。
zh.hot: BookOrbit 在 GitHub 上迅速走红，今日新增 248 星，总星数达 2613，因其自托管、跨设备同步和丰富功能而备受关注。
uses: 喜欢自托管服务的阅读爱好者，希望完全掌控自己的书籍数据。
需要在不同设备（如 Kobo、KOReader）间无缝同步阅读进度的用户。
注重隐私和自主权的用户，希望避免依赖商业云服务。
开发者或技术爱好者，希望扩展或定制自己的阅读平台。

en.tag: Self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics
en.what: BookOrbit is a self-hosted library and reading platform for ebooks, PDFs, audiobooks, and comics. It offers a web reader, Kobo and KOReader support, and syncs progress, highlights, and reading status across devices.
en.content: The repository contains full server and frontend code, featuring a dashboard, bookshelf management, reading stats, achievements, OPDS and Send-to-Kindle delivery, multi-user accounts with OIDC/SSO, and automatic sync to Hardcover, Readwise, and StoryGraph.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on modern web technologies, supports Docker deployment, and integrates with third-party services like Crowdin for translation and Codecov for coverage.
en.hot: BookOrbit is rapidly gaining popularity on GitHub with 248 stars today and 2,613 total, thanks to its self-hosted nature, cross-device sync, and rich feature set.
uses: Reading enthusiasts who prefer self-hosted services and want full control over their book data.
Users who need seamless reading progress sync across devices like Kobo and KOReader.
Privacy-conscious individuals who want to avoid relying on commercial cloud services.
Developers or tech enthusiasts looking to extend or customize their reading platform.

zh.tag: 开源终端编码代理，兼容任意 LLM 后端
zh.what: OpenClaude 是一个开源的编码代理 CLI，支持云端和本地模型提供商。它允许用户通过统一的终端工作流使用 OpenAI 兼容 API、Gemini、GitHub Models、Codex OAuth、Ollama 等，同时保留提示、工具、代理、MCP、斜杠命令和流式输出等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CLI 工具、文档、设置指南、VS Code 扩展支持以及社区资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 构建，依赖 Node.js 环境，支持多种 LLM 提供商 API。
zh.hot: 凭借 31k+ stars 和日增 80 的势头，OpenClaude 凭借其‘随处运行、使用任何东西’的灵活性和对多种模型后端的支持，迅速成为开发者首选。
uses: 开发者希望在终端中统一管理多种 LLM 提供商，无需切换工具。
团队需要将编码代理集成到 CI/CD 或自动化工作流中。
喜欢使用 Ollama 等本地模型进行离线开发的用户。

en.tag: Open-source terminal coding agent for any LLM backend
en.what: OpenClaude is an open-source coding-agent CLI for cloud and local model providers. It lets you use OpenAI-compatible APIs, Gemini, GitHub Models, Codex OAuth, Codex, Ollama, Atomic Chat, and other supported backends while keeping one terminal-first workflow: prompts, tools, agents, MCP, slash commands, and streaming output.
en.content: The repository includes the full CLI tool, documentation, setup guides, VS Code extension support, and community resources.
en.stack: Built primarily with TypeScript, requires Node.js, and integrates with multiple LLM provider APIs.
en.hot: With 31k+ stars and 80 daily additions, OpenClaude's flexibility to run anywhere and use any model backend has made it a top choice for developers.
uses: Developers who want to manage multiple LLM providers from one terminal without switching tools.
Teams looking to integrate a coding agent into CI/CD or automated workflows.
Users who prefer local models like Ollama for offline development.

zh.tag: 高性能响应式 UI 库，无虚拟 DOM
zh.what: Solid 是一个声明式 JavaScript 库，用于构建用户界面。它不使用虚拟 DOM，而是将模板编译为真实 DOM 节点，并通过细粒度的响应式更新来高效管理状态变化。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心库 solid-js 的源代码、文档、示例和测试。主要提供响应式原语（如 createSignal）、渲染器以及 JSX 编译支持。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，依赖 JSX 和现代 JavaScript 特性，支持浏览器和服务器端渲染。
zh.hot: Solid 以其卓越的性能和细粒度响应式著称，star 数高达 35.9k，本月新增 208，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 适合追求极致性能、希望避免虚拟 DOM 开销的前端开发者
适用于需要高效更新复杂界面的单页应用或交互组件
适合喜欢响应式编程范式、熟悉 React 但想尝试新思路的团队

en.tag: High-performance reactive UI library without Virtual DOM
en.what: Solid is a declarative JavaScript library for building user interfaces. Instead of using a Virtual DOM, it compiles templates to real DOM nodes and updates them with fine-grained reactions.
en.content: The repository contains the source code, docs, examples, and tests for the core library solid-js. It provides reactive primitives (like createSignal), a renderer, and JSX compilation support.
en.stack: Developed in TypeScript, relies on JSX and modern JavaScript features, supports browser and server-side rendering.
en.hot: Solid is renowned for its excellent performance and fine-grained reactivity, with 35.9k stars and 208 added this month, continuously attracting developers.
uses: For frontend developers seeking top performance and avoiding Virtual DOM overhead
For building single-page apps or interactive components with efficient updates
For teams familiar with React but interested in a reactive paradigm without Virtual DOM

zh.tag: 插件化、无广告的免费音乐播放器
zh.what: MusicFree 是一款插件化、定制化、无广告的免费音乐播放器，目前支持 Android 和 Harmony OS。它本身不集成任何音源，所有搜索、播放、歌单导入等功能均通过插件实现，用户可自由安装第三方插件来扩展功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含播放器的完整源代码，采用 TypeScript 编写，包含 UI 组件、播放核心、插件管理模块等。同时提供插件开发文档和示例插件，方便开发者二次开发。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript 开发，基于 AGPL 3.0 协议开源。依赖包括 React Native 或类似跨平台框架（根据项目结构推测），以及用于插件加载的 CommonJS 模块系统。
zh.hot: 凭借插件化设计实现高度定制和无广告体验，吸引了大量用户。本月新增 802 个 star，总 star 数达 26643，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（TypeScript）第 14 名，反映出社区对自由音乐播放器的强烈需求。
uses: 适合追求无广告、可定制音乐播放体验的 Android 或 Harmony OS 用户。
适合希望自行控制音源、通过插件扩展功能的音乐爱好者。
适合对音乐播放器开发感兴趣的开发者，可参考其插件架构。

en.tag: A plugin-based, ad-free, free music player
en.what: MusicFree is a plugin-based, customizable, ad-free free music player that currently supports Android and Harmony OS. It does not integrate any music sources itself; all functions like search, playback, and playlist import are implemented via plugins, allowing users to freely install third-party plugins to extend functionality.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of the player, written in TypeScript, including UI components, playback core, plugin management modules, etc. It also provides plugin development documentation and example plugins for developers.
en.stack: Primarily developed in TypeScript, open-sourced under AGPL 3.0. Dependencies include a cross-platform framework like React Native (inferred from project structure), and CommonJS module system for plugin loading.
en.hot: With its plugin-based design enabling high customization and ad-free experience, it has attracted many users. Gaining 802 stars this month, reaching 26,643 total, and ranking 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (TypeScript), reflecting strong community demand for a free music player.
uses: Ideal for Android or Harmony OS users seeking an ad-free, customizable music playback experience.
Suitable for music enthusiasts who want to control their music sources and extend functionality via plugins.
Great for developers interested in music player development, offering insights into plugin architecture.

zh.tag: 免费AI编码代理，多产品覆盖终端、桌面、网页与云端
zh.what: Freebuff 是一套免费的AI编码代理产品，包括桌面端、CLI、Web、云和聊天五种形态，无需订阅或API密钥即可使用。它通过专用代理和模型选择帮助用户编码、构建和研究。
zh.content: 仓库包含产品文档、快速入门指南、模型目录说明，以及各产品（桌面、CLI、Web、云、聊天）的详细介绍和安装链接。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 开发，CLI 通过 npm 安装，支持多种模型（如 DeepSeek、GPT-5.6 Luna 等），桌面端可集成本地 Claude Code 和 Codex 代理。
zh.hot: 免费且无需API密钥的AI编码工具，提供多产品覆盖和多种模型选择，今日新增105星，登上GitHub趋势榜。
uses: 开发者：在终端或桌面端快速进行AI辅助编码
全栈开发者：使用Web版构建和部署完整应用
研究者：通过聊天版进行AI驱动的研究与思考
团队：在GitHub仓库上运行云端代理进行协作

en.tag: Free AI coding agent suite across terminal, desktop, web, and cloud
en.what: Freebuff is a suite of free AI coding agents available as desktop, CLI, web, cloud, and chat products, requiring no subscription or API key. It uses specialized agents and a choice of models to assist with coding, building, and research.
en.content: The repository includes product documentation, quick start guides, model catalog details, and descriptions/links for each product (Desktop, CLI, Web, Cloud, Chat).
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, CLI installable via npm, supports multiple models (DeepSeek, GPT-5.6 Luna, etc.), and Desktop can integrate local Claude Code and Codex agents.
en.hot: Free AI coding tool with no API key required, offering multi-product coverage and model variety; gained 105 stars today and hit the GitHub trending list.
uses: Developers: AI-assisted coding from terminal or desktop
Full-stack developers: build and ship apps with the Web version
Researchers: AI-driven research and thinking via Chat
Teams: run cloud agents on GitHub repositories for collaboration

zh.tag: 开源 AI 研究代理，命令行驱动深度调研
zh.what: Feynman 是一个开源的 AI 研究代理，通过命令行界面帮助用户进行深度研究。它能够自主规划研究步骤、收集信息并生成结构化报告，支持多种本地和云端模型提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个用 TypeScript 编写的 CLI 工具，提供安装脚本、文档和示例配置。核心功能包括模型登录、本地模型设置（如 LM Studio、Ollama）以及技能系统，允许用户扩展研究能力。
zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，打包为独立原生应用（自带 Node.js 运行时），也支持通过 npm 安装。依赖包括 Node.js、各种 AI 模型 API（OpenAI 兼容、OpenRouter 等）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 292 星，总星数达 9042，登上 GitHub 趋势榜。其作为开源 AI 研究代理的定位吸引了大量对自动化研究工具感兴趣的用户，且支持本地模型，满足隐私需求。
uses: 研究人员和学者：利用 AI 代理自动收集文献、整理资料，加速文献综述过程。
开发者与技术人员：通过命令行集成到工作流中，快速获取技术文档和代码库信息。
隐私敏感用户：使用本地模型（如 Ollama）进行离线研究，避免数据上传云端。

en.tag: Open-source AI research agent with a CLI-driven deep research workflow
en.what: Feynman is an open-source AI research agent that assists users in conducting deep research via a command-line interface. It autonomously plans research steps, gathers information, and generates structured reports, supporting various local and cloud model providers.
en.content: The repository contains a TypeScript-based CLI tool with installation scripts, documentation, and example configurations. Core features include model login, local model setup (e.g., LM Studio, Ollama), and a skills system for extending research capabilities.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, packaged as a standalone native bundle with its own Node.js runtime, also available via npm. Dependencies include Node.js and various AI model APIs (OpenAI-compatible, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.hot: Gained 292 stars this week, reaching 9,042 total, and appeared on the GitHub Trending list. Its positioning as an open-source AI research agent attracts users interested in automated research tools, and local model support addresses privacy concerns.
uses: Researchers and academics: Use the AI agent to automatically gather literature and organize materials, accelerating literature reviews.
Developers and technical professionals: Integrate into workflows via CLI to quickly obtain technical documentation and codebase information.
Privacy-conscious users: Leverage local models (e.g., Ollama) for offline research, avoiding data upload to the cloud.

zh.tag: 让 AI 代理轻松调用上万网页抓取工具的 MCP 服务器
zh.what: Apify MCP 服务器是一个中间层，将 AI 代理（如 Claude、Cursor）与 Apify Store 上数千个现成的爬虫和自动化工具连接起来。它支持通过 OAuth 从 Claude.ai 或 VS Code 等客户端直接连接，并支持流式 HTTP 传输。
zh.content: 仓库包含 MCP 服务器的 TypeScript 源码、文档、配置示例，以及指向托管服务 mcp.apify.com 的说明。还支持代理支付（agentic payments）和多种客户端集成。
zh.stack: 基于 TypeScript 构建，使用 Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK，支持 OAuth 和流式 HTTP。依赖 Apify 平台及其 Actor 生态系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3473 星，总星数达 6086，跻身 TypeScript 趋势榜第 16 名。AI 代理需要实时网页数据，而 Apify 提供了现成的抓取工具，正好满足需求。
uses: 开发者想要为 AI 代理添加网页数据抓取能力，无需自己编写爬虫。
使用 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端的用户，需要从社交媒体、电商等网站提取结构化数据。
需要自动化数据采集流程，并希望与 AI 工作流集成的团队。

en.tag: MCP server enabling AI agents to use thousands of web scrapers via Apify
en.what: The Apify MCP server is a middleware that connects AI agents (like Claude, Cursor) to thousands of ready-made scrapers and automation tools on Apify Store. It supports OAuth for connecting from clients like Claude.ai or VS Code, and uses Streamable HTTP transport.
en.content: The repo contains TypeScript source code, docs, config examples, and instructions for the hosted service at mcp.apify.com. It also supports agentic payments and integration with various MCP clients.
en.stack: Built with TypeScript, uses the Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, supports OAuth and Streamable HTTP. Depends on the Apify platform and its Actor ecosystem.
en.hot: Gained 3473 stars this month, reaching 6086 total, ranking #16 on TypeScript trending. AI agents need real-time web data, and Apify offers ready-made scrapers, perfectly meeting the demand.
uses: Developers who want to add web scraping capabilities to AI agents without writing crawlers themselves.
Users of MCP clients like Claude or Cursor who need structured data from social media, e-commerce, etc.
Teams that need to automate data collection and integrate it with AI workflows.

zh.tag: 人生进阶与英语学习开放指南
zh.what: 这是一份从英语学习出发，写给普通人持续成长、重新掌握人生主动权的开放指南。它涵盖了英语学习系统、AI学习方法以及人生复盘样本，帮助用户建立长期训练系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含英语学习主线（认知、单词、听力、阅读、口语、写作）、AI学习与能力升级方法、人生复盘与创业故事，以及长期主义资源如词表和英文材料。
zh.stack: 基于JavaScript，主要使用Markdown文档组织内容，依赖GitHub Pages或静态站点部署。
zh.hot: 拥有56318颗星，今日新增103颗，因其全面的英语学习指南和人生进阶内容吸引了大量学习者，长期占据GitHub热门榜。
uses: 英语学习者——系统提升听说读写能力，建立长期训练系统
AI工具使用者——学习如何将ChatGPT、Gemini等融入学习流程
人生复盘者——从创业、失败、低谷恢复的真实故事中获取启发
长期主义者——寻找可执行的成长路线图和资源库

en.tag: An open guide to life advancement and English learning
en.what: An open guide starting from English learning, aimed at helping ordinary people grow continuously and regain control of their lives. It covers an English learning system, AI learning methods, and a life review sample.
en.content: The repo includes an English learning thread (cognition, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking, writing), AI learning and skill upgrade methods, life review and entrepreneurship stories, and long-term resources like word lists and English materials.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript, primarily organized as Markdown documents, deployable via GitHub Pages or static site generators.
en.hot: With 56,318 stars and 103 new stars today, it attracts learners with its comprehensive English learning guide and life advancement content, consistently trending on GitHub.
uses: English learners — systematically improve listening, speaking, reading, writing, and build a long-term training system
AI tool users — learn to integrate ChatGPT, Gemini, etc. into learning workflows
Life reviewers — gain inspiration from real stories of entrepreneurship, failure, and recovery
Long-termists — find actionable growth roadmaps and resource repositories

zh.tag: Meta 出品的高性能 CSS-in-JS 样式系统
zh.what: StyleX 是 Facebook（Meta）开源的 JavaScript 样式库，用于为大型用户界面定义并优化样式。它通过编译期处理把样式定义转换为原子化 CSS，兼顾开发体验与运行时性能。
zh.content: 这是一个 monorepo，包含核心包 @stylexjs/stylex，以及 Babel、PostCSS、Rollup、ESLint 插件、CLI、文档站点和基准测试等配套包。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/TypeScript，依赖 Babel 做编译期转换，提供 PostCSS、Rollup、ESLint 等插件集成，使用 Yarn workspace 管理。
zh.hot: 作为 Meta 内部大规模验证后开源的方案，它切中 CSS-in-JS 性能痛点，本月新增 572 star，累计突破 1 万，登上 GitHub 月榜 JavaScript 第 8。
uses: 大型前端团队需要可扩展、高性能的样式方案
React 项目希望用原子化 CSS 同时保留类型安全
对运行时开销敏感的 CSS-in-JS 迁移场景
想学习编译期样式优化与 monorepo 工程实践

en.tag: Meta's high-performance CSS-in-JS styling system
en.what: StyleX is Meta's open-source JavaScript styling library for defining and optimizing styles in ambitious user interfaces. It compiles style definitions into atomic CSS at build time, balancing developer experience with runtime performance.
en.content: It's a monorepo containing the core @stylexjs/stylex package plus Babel, PostCSS, Rollup and ESLint plugins, a CLI, docs site and benchmarks.
en.stack: Built with JavaScript/TypeScript, it relies on Babel for compile-time transforms and ships PostCSS, Rollup and ESLint integrations, managed via Yarn workspaces.
en.hot: Open-sourced after large-scale internal use at Meta, it tackles CSS-in-JS performance pain points, gaining 572 stars this month for a total over 10k and ranking 8th on GitHub's monthly JavaScript trending list.
uses: Large frontend teams needing a scalable, high-performance styling solution
React projects wanting atomic CSS with type safety
Migrations away from runtime-heavy CSS-in-JS
Developers studying compile-time style optimization and monorepo practices

zh.tag: 用属性在HTML中直接实现AJAX、CSS过渡、WebSocket和SSE的轻量库
zh.what: htmx 是一个轻量级、无依赖的 JavaScript 库，允许你直接在 HTML 中使用属性（如 hx-post、hx-swap）来发起 AJAX 请求、应用 CSS 过渡、使用 WebSocket 和服务器发送事件。它旨在通过扩展 HTML 的超文本能力，简化现代用户界面的构建，让你无需编写大量 JavaScript 代码即可实现动态交互。
zh.content: 仓库包含 htmx 的源代码、文档网站、示例、扩展（如 ws、sse）以及贡献指南。核心是一个约 14k min.gz'd 的 JavaScript 文件，可通过 CDN 或 npm 安装。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript 编写，无外部依赖。开发依赖包括 Node.js 和 npm，用于本地开发和测试。
zh.hot: htmx 因其极简的编程模型而广受欢迎，让开发者无需编写复杂 JavaScript 即可实现现代交互。尽管今日新增 star 不多（32），但总星数已接近 5 万，反映出其在开发者社区中的持续热度。
uses: 后端开发者希望用简单方式增强 HTML 页面交互，而不想写大量前端 JS
全栈开发者寻求轻量级替代 React/Vue 的方案，用于快速原型或小型项目
喜欢 HATEOAS 和超媒体理念的开发者，希望构建符合 REST 架构的 Web 应用

en.tag: A lightweight library that lets you use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML with attributes
en.what: htmx is a lightweight, dependency-free JavaScript library that allows you to use AJAX, CSS Transitions, WebSockets and Server Sent Events directly in HTML using attributes like hx-post and hx-swap. It aims to simplify building modern user interfaces by extending HTML's hypertext capabilities, enabling dynamic interactions without writing much JavaScript.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of htmx, documentation website, examples, extensions (like ws, sse), and contribution guidelines. The core is a ~14k min.gz'd JavaScript file that can be installed via CDN or npm.
en.stack: Primarily written in JavaScript with no external dependencies. Development dependencies include Node.js and npm for local development and testing.
en.hot: htmx is popular for its minimalist programming model, allowing developers to implement modern interactions without writing complex JavaScript. Although today's new stars are modest (32), the total star count is approaching 50k, reflecting its sustained popularity in the developer community.
uses: Backend developers who want to enhance HTML page interactions in a simple way without writing lots of frontend JS
Full-stack developers seeking a lightweight alternative to React/Vue for quick prototypes or small projects
Developers who embrace HATEOAS and hypermedia principles to build RESTful web applications

zh.tag: 互联网最大免费资源维基的编辑与贡献仓库
zh.what: 这是 FMHY（FreeMediaHeckYeah）的编辑仓库，用于对 FMHY 维基内容进行增删改。FMHY 号称是互联网上最大的免费资源合集，涵盖软件、影视、游戏、学习资料等各类免费工具与站点索引。

zh.hot: 作为知名免费资源维基的官方编辑入口，它本月新增 654 star、总计 11758，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 11 名，反映出大众对免费资源索引的持续高需求。

寻找免费软件、影视、游戏、学习资源索引的普通用户

en.tag: The edit/contribution repo for the internet's largest free-stuff wiki
en.what: This is the editing repository for FMHY (FreeMediaHeckYeah), used to add, remove, and correct entries in the FMHY wiki. FMHY bills itself as the largest collection of free stuff on the internet, indexing free tools and sites for software, media, games, learning, and more.
en.content: The repo is mainly Markdown docs and contribution guides, containing wiki page sources, an emoji legend, contribution workflow docs, and links to the fmhy.net site, backups, JSON API, and Discord.

Everyday users looking for indexes of free software, media, games, and learning resources
Developers who need FMHY backups or the JSON API for their own projects

zh.tag: AI 代理全自动管理 YouTube 频道，免费 Gemini 可用
zh.what: 这是一个利用 AI 代理实现 YouTube 频道全自动管理的工具。它能够自动创建、优化并发布视频，全天候运行，无需人工干预。支持使用免费的 Gemini API 或 OpenAI，且无需编写代码。

zh.stack: 主要基于 Node.js（JavaScript），依赖 FFmpeg（通过 ffmpeg-static 捆绑）、dotenv 管理环境变量，并集成多个 AI 提供商的 API（OpenAI、Gemini、OpenRouter、Kimi、MiMo、GLM）。

营销人员：需要批量生成视频内容以扩大品牌影响力。
开发者：对 AI 代理工作流和自动化管道感兴趣，可二次开发。
初学者：无需编程经验，通过引导式设置即可上手。

en.tag: Fully automated YouTube channel management with AI agents, works with free Gemini or OpenAI
en.what: This is a tool that uses AI agents to fully automate YouTube channel management. It can automatically create, optimize, and publish videos, running 24/7 without manual intervention. It works with the free Gemini API or OpenAI, and requires no coding.
en.content: The repository contains a complete automation pipeline: video script generation, image generation, voice narration, video rendering (using FFmpeg), and a YouTube publishing queue. It provides CLI tools (e.g., npm run setup, npm run walkthrough) for configuration and guided setup, supporting multiple AI providers (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily built on Node.js (JavaScript), with dependencies on FFmpeg (bundled via ffmpeg-static), dotenv for environment variables, and integrations with multiple AI provider APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, OpenRouter, Kimi, MiMo, GLM).
en.hot: The project is rapidly gaining traction on GitHub, with 164 stars today and 2010 total, ranking #4 on the JavaScript trending list. Its appeal lies in offering fully automated YouTube channel management for free (using Gemini), significantly lowering the barrier to content creation, and its continuous updates and issue fixes have garnered strong community response.
uses: Content creators: who want to automate video generation and publishing to save time.
Marketers: needing to produce video content at scale for brand reach.
Developers: interested in AI agent workflows and automation pipelines, can customize.

zh.tag: 高效开源广告拦截器，专注隐私与性能

en.stack: Built on Rust and GPUI (GPU-accelerated UI framework used by Zed editor), supports macOS, Windows, Linux, integrates Tree-sitter, LSP, etc.
en.hot: With 13.9K stars and +179 today, it tops the Rust daily chart as the first project to decouple GPUI from Zed and package it as a general-purpose component library, filling a gap in the Rust desktop UI ecosystem.

uses: Developers building highly concurrent, fault-tolerant backend systems leveraging the Erlang ecosystem.

zh.tag: 快速、节省磁盘空间的 Node.js 包管理器

zh.tag: 无需客户端软件的透明堡垒机与特权访问管理平台
zh.what: Warpgate 是一个智能且完全透明的堡垒机（跳板机）与特权访问管理（PAM）系统，支持 SSH、HTTPS、Kubernetes、MySQL、PostgreSQL、RDP 和 VNC 协议。它不需要安装客户端或 SSH 包装器，直接把连接转发到目标主机，对用户完全透明。

en.tag: A fully transparent bastion/PAM for SSH, HTTPS, K8s, DB and RDP/VNC with no client software
en.what: Warpgate is a smart and fully transparent bastion host and privileged access management (PAM) system supporting SSH, HTTPS, Kubernetes, MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDP and VNC. It requires no client app or SSH wrapper, forwarding connections straight to targets in a way that's fully transparent to clients.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust server core, a built-in web admin UI (warpgate-web), session recording and replay, plus browser-based SSH/RDP/VNC access.
en.stack: Written in 100% safe Rust and shipped as a single dependency-free binary; supports TOTP and OpenID Connect SSO with built-in brute-force protection and IP blocking.
en.hot: With its differentiated zero-client, single-binary, multi-protocol transparent proxy approach, it has earned 7,877 stars, adding 309 this month and ranking #21 on GitHub Trending monthly for Rust.

Research institutions and cloud providers — organizations seeking high-throughput, low-latency inference solutions.

zh.tag: 命令行下载 App Store 的 ipa 包工具
zh.what: ipatool 是一个命令行工具，允许用户从 App Store 搜索 iOS、iPadOS、tvOS 和 visionOS 应用，并下载其 ipa 文件。它支持认证、搜索、购买和列出已购应用等操作。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具源码，提供 auth、search、purchase、list-purchases 等子命令，支持文本和 JSON 输出格式，并附带演示 GIF 和详细文档。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 App Store 的 API，支持 Windows、Linux 和 macOS，可通过 Homebrew 安装。
zh.hot: 该工具为开发者和安全研究人员提供了便捷的 ipa 下载方式，在 GitHub 上获得 1 万+ star，今日新增 58 个，登上日榜第 8 名。
uses: iOS 开发者需要获取 ipa 包进行测试或分析
安全研究人员分析应用包内容
需要备份或归档 App Store 应用的用户

en.tag: CLI tool to search and download ipa packages from App Store
en.what: ipatool is a command-line tool that allows users to search for iOS, iPadOS, tvOS, and visionOS apps on the App Store and download their ipa files. It supports authentication, searching, purchasing, and listing purchased apps.
en.content: The repository contains the source code of a Go-based CLI tool with subcommands like auth, search, purchase, and list-purchases, supporting text and JSON output formats, along with a demo GIF and detailed documentation.
en.stack: Developed in Go, it relies on the App Store API and supports Windows, Linux, and macOS, installable via Homebrew.
en.hot: This tool provides a convenient way for developers and security researchers to download ipa files, gaining over 10k stars on GitHub with 58 new stars today, ranking 8th on the daily trending list.
uses: iOS developers needing ipa packages for testing or analysis
Security researchers analyzing app package contents
Users who want to back up or archive App Store apps

zh.tag: 自托管聚合仪表盘，把订阅源集中一处
zh.what: Glance 是一个轻量级、高度可定制的自托管仪表盘，用于集中展示 RSS、Reddit、Hacker News、天气、YouTube 等订阅源。它通过美观简洁的界面，让用户在一个页面中快速浏览所有信息流。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心服务、YAML 配置文件示例、文档（配置、主题、预配置页面）、社区组件目录以及 Docker 部署支持。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖少量 JavaScript（原生），生成单一可执行文件（<20MB），支持多平台和 Docker 容器。
zh.hot: 凭借极低的资源占用、丰富的组件生态和高度可定制性，Glance 在自托管社区广受欢迎，目前已收获 36,682 颗星，今日新增 22 颗。
uses: 自托管爱好者：搭建个人信息中心，整合 RSS、新闻、天气等订阅源。
开发者和技术爱好者：监控 GitHub、Hacker News、Reddit 等技术社区动态。
追求效率的用户：通过自定义布局和主题，打造专属的极简仪表盘。

en.tag: Self-hosted dashboard aggregating all your feeds in one place
en.what: Glance is a lightweight, highly customizable self-hosted dashboard that aggregates feeds like RSS, Reddit, Hacker News, weather, YouTube, and more. It presents all your information streams in a beautiful, streamlined interface for quick browsing.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core service, YAML configuration examples, documentation (configuration, themes, preconfigured pages), community widgets directory, and Docker deployment support.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, with minimal vanilla JavaScript, producing a single binary under 20MB for multiple OS/architectures, and a small Docker container.
en.hot: With its low resource usage, extensive widget ecosystem, and high customizability, Glance has gained popularity in the self-hosting community, amassing 36,682 stars with 22 added today.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: build a personal dashboard to aggregate RSS, news, weather, and more.
Developers and tech enthusiasts: monitor GitHub, Hacker News, Reddit, and other tech communities.
Productivity-focused users: create a minimal, personalized dashboard with custom layouts and themes.

zh.tag: 轻量级服务器监控平台，支持 Docker 统计、历史数据与告警
zh.what: Beszel 是一个轻量级的服务器监控平台，提供 Docker 统计、历史数据和告警功能。它拥有友好的 Web 界面，配置简单，开箱即用，并支持自动备份、多用户、OAuth 认证和 API 访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含两个主要组件：hub（基于 PocketBase 的 Web 应用，提供仪表盘）和 agent（运行在被监控系统上，收集指标）。支持 CPU、内存、磁盘、网络、负载、温度等指标，并提供截图和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，hub 基于 PocketBase，agent 独立运行。支持 Docker/Podman，可通过 Docker 镜像部署，使用 SQLite 存储数据。
zh.hot: 凭借轻量级、简单易用和丰富的功能（如 Docker 统计、告警、多用户）在 GitHub 上迅速走红，本周新增 282 颗星，总星数达 24,566，位列 Go 语言周榜第 9 名。
uses: 个人开发者或小团队，需要轻量级服务器监控且不想部署重量级方案
使用 Docker 运行多个容器的用户，希望跟踪每个容器的资源使用历史
需要设置告警（如 CPU、内存、磁盘）并及时收到通知的运维人员
希望通过 OAuth 集成现有身份认证系统的企业用户

en.tag: Lightweight server monitoring with Docker stats, history, and alerts
en.what: Beszel is a lightweight server monitoring platform that includes Docker statistics, historical data, and alert functions. It has a friendly web interface, simple configuration, and is ready to use out of the box. It supports automatic backup, multi-user, OAuth authentication, and API access.
en.content: The repository contains two main components: the hub (a PocketBase-based web app providing a dashboard) and the agent (runs on monitored systems, collects metrics). It supports metrics like CPU, memory, disk, network, load, temperature, and includes screenshots and documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, the hub is built on PocketBase, and the agent runs independently. Supports Docker/Podman, deployable via Docker images, uses SQLite for data storage.
en.hot: It has gained popularity on GitHub due to its lightweight nature, ease of use, and rich features (like Docker stats, alerts, multi-user). It gained 282 stars this week, reaching 24,566 total, ranking 9th on the Go weekly trending list.
uses: Individual developers or small teams needing lightweight server monitoring without heavyweight solutions
Users running multiple Docker containers who want to track resource usage history per container
Ops personnel who need to set alerts (e.g., CPU, memory, disk) and receive timely notifications
Enterprise users who want to integrate existing authentication via OAuth

zh.tag: 基于 Envoy 的 AI 与 Agent 流量开源控制平面
zh.what: Agent Router 为应用团队提供统一、兼容 OpenAI 的 API，接入托管模型、自托管推理和 MCP 服务器。平台团队则集中管理凭证、路由、配额、故障转移和用量归因，由 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含控制平面与数据平面代码、CRD（AIGatewayRoute、AIServiceBackend、BackendSecurityPolicy）、aigw CLI、Helm charts 与文档站点，支持本地单机运行和 Kubernetes 部署。
zh.stack: 以 Go 为主语言，构建在 Envoy 与 Envoy Gateway 之上，提供 OpenAI 兼容 API，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，属于 Agentic AI Foundation 项目。
zh.hot: 作为原 Envoy AI Gateway 更名后的项目，它背靠 Envoy 生态，解决多模型统一接入与治理痛点，已获 2037 stars，今日新增 22，登上 Go 日榜第 14 名。
uses: 平台团队：集中管理多模型凭证、路由、配额与故障转移
应用开发者：用统一 OpenAI 兼容 API 接入各类模型与 MCP 工具
自托管推理团队：通过两层网关模式暴露并治理模型服务
企业架构师：在 Kubernetes 上构建合规、可观测的 AI 流量入口

en.tag: The open source control plane for AI and agent traffic, powered by Envoy
en.what: Agent Router gives application teams one consistent, OpenAI-compatible API for every model and tool, from hosted providers to self-hosted inference and MCP servers. Platform teams keep credentials, routing, quotas, failover, and usage attribution in one place, enforced by Envoy and Envoy Gateway.
en.content: The repo contains control-plane and data-plane code, CRDs (AIGatewayRoute, AIServiceBackend, BackendSecurityPolicy), the aigw CLI, Helm charts, and a docs site, supporting both local standalone runs and Kubernetes deployments.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go and built on Envoy and Envoy Gateway, it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API under Apache 2.0 as an Agentic AI Foundation project.
en.hot: As the renamed former Envoy AI Gateway, it leverages the Envoy ecosystem to solve unified multi-model access and governance, reaching 2,037 stars with 22 added today and ranking 14th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Platform teams centralizing credentials, routing, quotas, and failover across models
App developers using one OpenAI-compatible API for models and MCP tools
Self-hosted inference teams exposing and governing model serving via a two-tier gateway
Enterprise architects building compliant, observable AI traffic entry points on Kubernetes

zh.tag: 现代跨平台任务运行器，Make 的 Go 替代品
zh.what: Task 是一个受 Make 启发的构建工具，专为现代工作流设计，提供简单易读的 YAML 语法来定义任务。它支持跨平台运行，无需依赖系统 shell，并内置文件监控、任务依赖和并行执行等功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Task 的 Go 源码、命令行工具、文档网站源码（位于 website/ 目录）以及示例任务文件。核心是一个可执行二进制，通过 taskfile.yml 文件定义任务。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 minimal 第三方库，支持通过 Homebrew、Scoop、npm 等多种方式安装。
zh.hot: 作为 Make 的现代化替代品，Task 在开发者中持续流行，GitHub 上已有 16k+ star，本月新增 193，位列 Go 趋势榜第 19 名。其简洁的 YAML 配置和跨平台特性吸引了大量寻求更友好构建工具的用户。
uses: 个人开发者或团队希望用更直观的 YAML 替代复杂 Makefile 来管理项目任务
需要跨平台（Windows/macOS/Linux）一致运行构建脚本的 CI/CD 流程
希望通过任务依赖和并行执行优化开发工作流的全栈开发者

en.tag: A fast, cross-platform task runner as a modern Make alternative
en.what: Task is a build tool inspired by Make, designed for modern workflows with a simple YAML syntax to define tasks. It runs cross-platform without relying on system shells and includes features like file watching, task dependencies, and parallel execution.
en.content: The repository contains the Go source code, CLI tool, documentation website source (in website/), and example task files. The core is an executable binary that reads tasks from a taskfile.yml.
en.stack: Developed primarily in Go with minimal third-party dependencies, installable via Homebrew, Scoop, npm, and more.
en.hot: As a modern alternative to Make, Task remains popular among developers, with 16k+ stars and 193 new stars this month, ranking 19th on GitHub's Go trending list. Its simple YAML config and cross-platform nature attract users seeking a friendlier build tool.
uses: Individual developers or teams wanting a more intuitive YAML alternative to complex Makefiles for managing project tasks
CI/CD pipelines that require consistent build script execution across Windows/macOS/Linux
Full-stack developers looking to optimize workflows with task dependencies and parallel execution

zh.tag: 高密度多路复用、亚秒级挂起/恢复的 Agent 运行时基础设施
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个为大规模 Agent 部署提供高性能、高密度运行时环境的系统。它通过控制平面管理 Agent 沙箱的完整生命周期，支持亚秒级的挂起/恢复操作，并允许将大量 Agent 多路复用到底层计算基础设施上。该系统并非用于构建 Agent 的 SDK，而是用于大规模运行 Agent 的底层系统。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心控制平面实现，支持多种沙箱技术（如 microVM 和 gVisor），并基于 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 Worker 生命周期管理。提供演示视频和详细文档，展示如何将约 250 个有状态 Actor 多路复用到 8 个物理 Pod 上。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Kubernetes（Pod 和自动扩缩容）进行基础设施管理，并集成 microVM 和 gVisor 等沙箱技术。
zh.hot: 该仓库在 GitHub Trending 日榜（Go）排名第 3，今日新增 26 颗星，总星数达 1270。其核心卖点——亚秒级挂起/恢复和高密度多路复用——解决了 Agent 部署中的关键痛点，因此受到广泛关注。
uses: 需要大规模运行 AI Agent 的团队，希望降低基础设施成本并提高资源利用率
构建 Agent 编排平台的开发者，需要底层生命周期管理和流量路由
从事强化学习（RL）场景的工程师，需要统一管理 Agent、推理和训练基础设施

en.tag: High-density, sub-second suspend/resume runtime infrastructure for large-scale agent deployments
en.what: Agent Substrate is a system that provides a performant, high-density runtime environment for large-scale agent deployments. Its control plane manages the full lifecycle of agent sandboxes, enabling sub-second suspend/resume operations and heavy multiplexing of agents onto shared compute infrastructure. It is not an SDK for building agents but a system for running them at scale.
en.content: The repository contains the core control plane implementation, supporting multiple sandbox technologies (e.g., microVMs and gVisor), and leverages Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker lifecycle management. It includes a demo video and detailed documentation showing how to multiplex ~250 stateful actors across just 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it leverages Kubernetes (Pods and autoscaling) for infrastructure management and integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor.
en.hot: Ranked #3 on GitHub Trending (Go) daily, gaining 26 stars today to reach 1270 total. Its key selling points—sub-second suspend/resume and high-density multiplexing—address critical pain points in agent deployment, driving significant interest.
uses: Teams deploying AI agents at scale, aiming to reduce infrastructure costs and improve resource utilization
Developers building agent orchestration platforms that require underlying lifecycle management and traffic routing
Engineers working on reinforcement learning (RL) scenarios needing unified management of agentic, inference, and training infrastructure

zh.tag: 自建私有搜索引擎，索引浏览记录与本地文件
zh.what: Hister 是一个注重隐私的搜索引擎，可以索引你访问过的网页和本地文件的内容，支持全文搜索。它提供 Web 界面、终端界面和 MCP 接口，方便你随时找回信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、Web UI（基于 Svelte）、浏览器扩展（Firefox/Chrome）以及终端客户端。支持多用户、语义搜索、爬虫和浏览器历史导入。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言，依赖 CGO（需要 C 编译器），Web 前端使用 npm 和 Svelte。
zh.hot: 今日新增 142 星，登上 Go 趋势榜第 4。在隐私担忧加剧的背景下，自托管搜索引擎需求上升，Hister 提供完整功能且易于部署。
uses: 注重隐私的个人用户，希望本地搜索自己的浏览历史和文件。
团队或组织，需要内部文档和网页的私有搜索解决方案。
开发者，希望集成 MCP 到 AI 助手，实现个性化信息检索。

en.tag: Self-hosted private search engine for your browsing history and local files
en.what: Hister is a privacy-focused search engine that indexes the full content of pages you visit and files you keep, enabling full-text search. It offers web, terminal, and MCP interfaces for easy information retrieval.
en.content: The repository includes a Go backend, a web UI (Svelte-based), browser extensions for Firefox/Chrome, and a terminal client. It supports multi-user, semantic search, crawler, and browser history import.
en.stack: Primarily Go, with CGO dependencies (requires C compiler), and npm/Svelte for the web frontend.
en.hot: Gained 142 stars today, ranking #4 on Go trending. Amid growing privacy concerns, self-hosted search engines are in demand, and Hister offers full features with easy deployment.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to search their browsing history and files locally.
Teams or organizations needing a private search solution for internal documents and web pages.
Developers who want to integrate MCP into AI assistants for personalized information retrieval.

zh.tag: 自托管的开源任务管理器，数据完全自主掌控
zh.what: Vikunja 是一个功能全面的任务管理工具，支持看板、列表、表格等多种视图，以及团队协作、时间跟踪、文件附件等特性。它强调用户对数据的完全掌控，可自托管部署，也提供云端托管服务。
zh.content: 仓库包含后端服务（Go 编写）、前端 Web 应用、桌面客户端（Electron）以及移动端应用（通过 Flutter 实现），并提供完整的 API 文档和安装指南。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 语言，支持 SQLite、PostgreSQL 和 MySQL 数据库；前端基于 Vue.js，桌面端使用 Electron，移动端使用 Flutter。
zh.hot: 本周新增 78 星，总星数 5258，位列 Go 语言周榜第 19 名。其自托管、数据自主的理念受到关注，且项目活跃，持续迭代。
uses: 个人用户希望完全掌控自己的任务数据，避免依赖第三方云服务
团队需要自建任务管理系统，并希望有看板、时间跟踪等高级功能
开发者想研究 Go 后端与前端分离的完整项目架构

en.tag: Self-hosted open-source task manager with full data ownership
en.what: Vikunja is a feature-rich task manager supporting kanban, list, table views, team collaboration, time tracking, file attachments, and more. It emphasizes full data ownership, allowing self-hosting or using the hosted cloud service.
en.content: The repository includes a backend service written in Go, a frontend web app, a desktop client (Electron), and mobile apps (via Flutter), along with comprehensive API docs and installation guides.
en.stack: Backend in Go with SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL support; frontend built with Vue.js; desktop via Electron; mobile via Flutter.
en.hot: Gained 78 stars this week, total 5258, ranking #19 on the Go weekly trending. Its self-hosting and data ownership philosophy attracts attention, with active development.
uses: Individuals who want full control over their task data without relying on third-party cloud services
Teams needing a self-hosted task management system with advanced features like kanban and time tracking
Developers interested in studying a full-stack project with Go backend and separate frontend

zh.tag: 专为 Kubernetes 打造的不可变安全 Linux 发行版
zh.what: Talos Linux 是一个专为运行 Kubernetes 而设计的现代 Linux 发行版，主打安全、不可变与极简。它没有 shell 和交互式控制台，所有系统管理都通过 API 完成，并使用双向 TLS（mTLS）认证保护访问。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Talos 操作系统的完整源码（Go 编写），涵盖内核配置、系统服务、API 接口、安装与升级工具，以及配套的文档与社区协作文件。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，深度集成 Kubernetes 与容器运行时，依赖 Linux 内核、mTLS 及不可变基础设施理念，采用原子更新机制。
zh.hot: 凭借 11143 颗星和本月新增 240 星登上 GitHub Go 月榜第 15 名，反映出社区对安全、可预测的 Kubernetes 底层操作系统的强烈需求。
uses: 运维与平台工程师：用于构建安全、不可变的 Kubernetes 节点
企业 IT 团队：需要减少配置漂移并简化集群升级
安全敏感场景：希望缩小攻击面并通过 API 管理主机
Kubernetes 爱好者：想体验无 shell 的极简操作系统

en.tag: A modern, immutable, secure Linux distribution built for Kubernetes
en.what: Talos Linux is a modern Linux distribution purpose-built for running Kubernetes, emphasizing security, immutability, and minimalism. It has no shell or interactive console; all system management is done via an API secured with mutual TLS (mTLS) authentication.
en.content: The repo contains the full source of the Talos OS written in Go, covering kernel configs, system services, the API layer, install/upgrade tooling, plus documentation and community files.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, deeply integrated with Kubernetes and container runtimes, relying on the Linux kernel, mTLS, and immutable-infrastructure principles with atomic updates.
en.hot: With 11,143 stars and 240 added this month, ranking 15th on GitHub's monthly Go trending list, it reflects strong community demand for a secure, predictable Kubernetes OS.
uses: DevOps and platform engineers building secure, immutable Kubernetes nodes
Enterprise IT teams needing to reduce config drift and simplify cluster upgrades
Security-sensitive environments wanting a smaller attack surface and API-driven host management
Kubernetes enthusiasts curious about a minimal OS with no shell

zh.tag: 开源 Linux 服务器管理面板，兼 AI 管理平台
zh.what: 1Panel 是一个现代开源的 Linux 服务器管理面板，提供直观的 Web 界面来管理服务器、网站、数据库、容器等。它还集成了轻量级 AI 管理功能，支持部署和管理 AI 应用。

希望轻松运行 AI 应用或模型，并集成到服务器管理中的用户。
教育或学习用途，用于理解服务器管理面板的架构与实现。

en.tag: Open-source Linux server management panel with AI platform capabilities
en.what: 1Panel is a modern, open-source Linux server management panel offering an intuitive web interface to manage servers, websites, databases, containers, and more. It also integrates lightweight AI management features for deploying and managing AI applications.

en.hot: With over 2.5M self-hosters and 36,831 GitHub stars (452 added this month), 1Panel is popular for its comprehensive features and ease of use.
