System administrators needing to deploy and manage Docker containers, websites, and databases.
Users who want to easily run AI applications or models integrated into server management.
Educational or learning purposes to understand the architecture of a server management panel.

zh.tag: 跨平台开源备份工具，支持增量、端到端加密与去重
zh.what: Kopia 是一款快速、安全的开源备份/恢复工具，可对重要文件与目录创建加密快照，并保存到本地、网络存储或云端。它不做整机镜像，而是让你自由选择要备份的数据，同时提供 CLI 与 GUI 两种界面。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的核心备份引擎、CLI 与 GUI 客户端、Docker 镜像构建、文档站点以及完整的测试与 CI 配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 Go 生态的存储与加密库，支持 Docker 部署，并通过 GitHub Actions 进行构建与测试。
zh.hot: 凭借 14082 颗星与本月新增 273 星登上 Go 月榜第 20 名，其端到端加密、去重与跨平台特性正好切中自托管备份需求。
uses: 需要为个人电脑或服务器做加密增量备份的自托管用户
希望用 CLI 或 GUI 管理云端/网络存储快照的运维人员
关注数据去重、压缩与端到端加密的隐私敏感型用户
想集成备份能力到自有系统的 Go 开发者

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source backup tool with incremental, E2E-encrypted, deduplicated snapshots
en.what: Kopia is a fast, secure open-source backup/restore tool that creates encrypted snapshots of the files and directories you care about and stores them locally, on network storage, or in the cloud. Instead of imaging your whole machine, it lets you pick what to protect, and ships with both CLI and GUI.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based backup engine, CLI and GUI clients, Docker image builds, documentation site, and full test/CI configuration.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, it relies on Go storage and crypto libraries, supports Docker deployment, and uses GitHub Actions for build and testing.
en.hot: With 14,082 stars and 273 added this month, it ranks 20th on the monthly Go trending list, as its E2E encryption, deduplication, and cross-platform support hit the self-hosted backup need.
uses: Self-hosters who need encrypted incremental backups for PCs or servers
Ops engineers managing cloud or NAS snapshots via CLI or GUI
Privacy-conscious users who value deduplication, compression, and E2E encryption
Go developers looking to integrate backup capabilities into their own systems

zh.tag: Git 仓库密钥扫描与泄露检测工具
zh.what: Gitleaks 是一个用于检测 Git 仓库、文件或标准输入中是否存在密码、API 密钥、令牌等敏感信息的工具。它通过正则表达式和熵分析来识别潜在的泄露，并输出详细的报告，包括文件、行号、提交等信息。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的命令行工具，支持通过 Homebrew、Docker、Go 或二进制安装，并可集成到 pre-commit 钩子或 GitHub Action 中。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖正则表达式库和熵计算，支持多种平台和容器化部署。
zh.hot: 本周新增 215 星，总星数达 28786，位列 GitHub 周榜（Go）第一。其功能完善且维护者宣布转向新项目，引发关注。
uses: 开发者在 CI/CD 流程中自动扫描代码泄露
安全团队审计历史提交中的敏感信息
个人开发者本地检查仓库泄露风险

en.tag: Scan git repos for secrets, passwords, API keys, and tokens
en.what: Gitleaks is a tool for detecting secrets like passwords, API keys, and tokens in git repos, files, and stdin. It uses regex and entropy analysis to identify potential leaks and outputs detailed reports including file, line, commit, and more.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based CLI tool, installable via Homebrew, Docker, Go, or binaries, and can be integrated into pre-commit hooks or GitHub Actions.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, leveraging regex and entropy calculation, with support for multiple platforms and containerized deployment.
en.hot: Gained 215 stars this week, total 28,786, ranking #1 on GitHub Trending (Go). Its feature-complete status and maintainer's shift to a new project drew attention.
uses: Developers scanning for leaks in CI/CD pipelines
Security teams auditing historical commits for sensitive data
Individual developers checking repos locally for exposure

zh.tag: 把多家 AI 订阅额度统一转成 API 的中转网关
zh.what: Sub2API 是一个开源 AI API 网关平台，把 Claude、OpenAI、Gemini、Grok 等订阅账号统一接入成标准 API 接口。它支持多人拼车共享订阅额度，让原生客户端工具无缝调用，从而更高效地分摊使用成本。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 后端服务、Vue 管理面板，以及 Docker 部署配置和 logo、赞助商等资源文件，并附中英日多语言 README。
zh.stack: 后端使用 Go 1.27，前端为 Vue 3.4+，数据层依赖 PostgreSQL 15+ 与 Redis 7+，并提供 Docker 一键部署。
zh.hot: 凭借 4.1 万 star、日增 136 并登上 GitHub Go 日榜第 4，它切中了订阅额度共享与统一接入的真实痛点，因此持续走热。
uses: 想用一份订阅额度供多人或团队共享的开发者
需要把多家模型统一成 OpenAI 兼容接口的自建网关用户
希望用 Claude Code、Codex 等原生工具低成本接入的工程师
研究 AI API 中转与配额分发架构的技术学习者

en.tag: An open-source gateway that turns multi-vendor AI subscriptions into unified APIs
en.what: Sub2API is an open-source AI API gateway that unifies Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and Grok subscription accounts behind standard API endpoints. It supports shared/carpool quota distribution so native client tools work seamlessly while splitting costs more efficiently.
en.content: The repo ships a Go backend service, a Vue admin panel, Docker deployment configs, plus logo and sponsor assets, with READMEs in Chinese, English and Japanese.
en.stack: Backend is Go 1.27, frontend is Vue 3.4+, with PostgreSQL 15+ and Redis 7+ for data, and Docker-ready deployment.
en.hot: With 41k stars, +136 today and a #4 spot on the GitHub Go daily trending list, it hits the real pain of shared subscription quota and unified access.
uses: Developers who want to share one subscription quota across a team
Self-hosters needing a unified OpenAI-compatible gateway for multiple models
Engineers using Claude Code, Codex and similar tools at lower cost
Learners studying AI API relay and quota-distribution architecture

zh.tag: 用 Markdown 定义 AI 代理，编译成 GitHub Actions 工作流
zh.what: gh-aw 是 GitHub 官方推出的 CLI 扩展，让开发者用带 YAML frontmatter 的 Markdown 定义 AI 驱动的仓库自动化，再编译成标准 GitHub Actions 工作流执行。它面向需要推理与判断的任务，如 issue 分诊、PR 审查、CI 失败排查、文档维护等，与既有 CI/CD 互补而非替代。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 Go 编写的 gh CLI 扩展，包含编译命令 `gh aw compile`、安装与打包脚本，以及 create/install/package 等代理快速上手文档和参考规范。
zh.stack: 使用 Go 开发，作为 GitHub CLI 扩展分发；依赖 GitHub Actions 运行，内置支持 GitHub Copilot、Claude Code、OpenAI Codex、Google Gemini 和 Pi 等 AI 引擎。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 官方项目，它把 AI 代理与成熟的 Actions 生态结合，默认只读沙箱与 safe-outputs 写入机制回应了安全顾虑，月增 243 star、总计 5133 star 并登上 Go 月榜第 18 名。
uses: 维护大型仓库、希望用 AI 自动处理 issue 分诊与 PR 审查的团队
需要在 CI 失败时自动调查根因、生成报告的 DevOps 工程师
想用 Markdown 而非脚本编排 AI 代理的开发者
关注 AI 自动化安全边界、需要受控写入机制的平台团队

en.tag: Define AI agents in Markdown, compiled into GitHub Actions workflows
en.what: gh-aw is GitHub's CLI extension that lets developers define AI-powered repository automation in Markdown with YAML frontmatter, then compile it into standard GitHub Actions workflows. It targets reasoning-heavy tasks like issue triage, PR review, CI failure investigation, and docs maintenance, complementing rather than replacing existing CI/CD.
en.content: The repo is a Go-based gh CLI extension containing the `gh aw compile` command, install and packaging scripts, plus create/install/package quick-start docs and a reference spec for agents.
en.stack: Built in Go and distributed as a GitHub CLI extension; it runs on GitHub Actions and supports AI engines including GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Google Gemini, and Pi.
en.hot: As an official GitHub project, it bridges AI agents with the mature Actions ecosystem, and its read-only sandbox plus safe-outputs write model addresses security concerns, earning 243 stars this month and 5,133 total on the Go monthly trending list.
uses: Teams maintaining large repos who want AI to automate issue triage and PR review
DevOps engineers who need automated CI failure investigation and reporting
Developers who prefer authoring AI agents in Markdown instead of scripts
Platform teams focused on safe, permission-scoped AI automation

zh.tag: 面向智能体系统的超低延迟模型路由，改个端点即可降本 40-70%
zh.what: weave-os/router 是一个面向智能体（agentic）系统的模型路由器，能在 50 毫秒内把每条提示词分发到最合适的模型上。它通过替换 API 端点的方式接入，无需改动业务代码，即可在成本与效果之间自动权衡，宣称可降低 40% 至 70% 的开销。
zh.content: 仓库以 Go 语言实现，主体是一个可独立部署的路由服务，包含路由决策逻辑、模型适配层与配置示例，README 以品牌视觉和架构图为主，代码结构围绕服务端与接入端点展开。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，依赖以标准库和轻量 HTTP/路由组件为主，通过兼容 OpenAI 风格的接口对接多家模型供应商，部署形态为独立服务或网关。
zh.hot: 本月新增 3351 颗星、总量 4274，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 19 名；在 LLM 成本焦虑和智能体大规模落地的双重背景下，一个「改端点就省钱」的路由层正好切中痛点。
uses: 正在构建多智能体或 LLM 应用的工程团队，希望在不改代码的前提下压低推理成本
需要按任务难度自动选择模型、兼顾质量与预算的 AI 平台与基础设施负责人
对推理延迟敏感、要求路由决策在 50ms 内完成的实时对话与 Agent 场景
想快速对比多家模型供应商效果与性价比的研究者和独立开发者

en.tag: Ultra-low-latency model router for agentic systems; cut costs 40-70% with just an endpoint change
en.what: weave-os/router is a model router for agentic systems that dispatches every prompt to the most suitable model in under 50ms. It plugs in by simply changing an endpoint, requiring no business-code changes, and claims to cut costs by 40-70% by automatically balancing cost and quality.
en.content: The repo is written in Go and centers on a standalone deployable routing service, including routing-decision logic, a model adapter layer, and configuration examples; the README leans on brand visuals and architecture diagrams, with code organized around the server and its endpoint.
en.stack: Primarily Go, relying mostly on the standard library and lightweight HTTP/routing components; it connects to multiple model providers through OpenAI-compatible APIs and deploys as a standalone service or gateway.
en.hot: It gained 3,351 stars this month (4,274 total), landing at No. 19 on GitHub Trending's monthly Go chart; amid LLM cost anxiety and the agent boom, a routing layer that saves money via an endpoint swap hits the sweet spot.
uses: Engineering teams building multi-agent or LLM apps who want to cut inference costs without code changes
AI platform and infra leads who need automatic model selection balancing quality and budget
Latency-sensitive real-time chat and agent scenarios requiring routing decisions under 50ms
Researchers and indie developers comparing model providers on quality and cost-efficiency

zh.tag: 可编程的混合模型路由层，为异构 LLM 推理按需选路
zh.what: vLLM Semantic Router 是一个可编程路由层，用于构建跨异构 LLM 基础设施的 Mixture-of-Models 系统。它根据请求信号、用户偏好和应用策略，为每个请求选择或组合合适的模型路径，从而在不改动应用代码的前提下优化质量、成本、延迟、隐私与安全。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的路由核心、安装脚本（install.sh）、在线 Playground 与文档站点（website/），以及面向 Hugging Face 的模型资源与博客、论文等资料。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go 1.25，提供 curl 一键安装脚本，并支持 pip、uv 及 agent 驱动安装；配套在线 Playground、文档站与 Hugging Face 模型仓库。
zh.hot: 作为 vLLM 项目旗下新作，它切中多模型混用与异构推理的痛点，本周新增 181 star、总数达 5741，登上 GitHub Trending Go 周榜第 8 名。
uses: AI 平台工程师：需要在多模型、多算力间做统一路由与成本优化
应用开发者：希望不写死路由逻辑就能按用户偏好切换或组合模型
企业架构师：关注数据边界、隐私与安全合规的推理部署
研究者与爱好者：想体验可编程 Mixture-of-Models 路由的实验能力

en.tag: A programmable Mixture-of-Models routing layer for heterogeneous LLM inference
en.what: vLLM Semantic Router is a programmable routing layer for building Mixture-of-Models systems across heterogeneous LLM infrastructure. It evaluates request signals, user preferences, and application policies to select or compose the right model path per request, improving quality, cost, latency, privacy, and safety without hard-coding routing logic into applications.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based routing core, an install script (install.sh), an online playground and documentation site (website/), plus Hugging Face model assets, blog posts, and publications.
en.stack: Main language is Go 1.25, with a curl one-liner installer and support for pip, uv, and agent-driven installation; it ships with an online playground, docs site, and Hugging Face model repo.
en.hot: As a new vLLM-project effort, it targets the pain of mixing multiple models and heterogeneous inference; it gained 181 stars this week to reach 5,741 total, ranking #8 on GitHub Trending's weekly Go chart.
uses: AI platform engineers: need unified routing and cost optimization across multiple models and compute
App developers: want to switch or compose models by user preference without hard-coding routing
Enterprise architects: care about data boundaries, privacy, and safety compliance in inference
Researchers and enthusiasts: want to experiment with programmable Mixture-of-Models routing

zh.tag: 从容器镜像与文件系统生成 SBOM 的 CLI 工具与 Go 库
zh.what: Syft 是一款用于从容器镜像、文件系统与归档文件中生成软件物料清单（SBOM）的命令行工具和 Go 库。它能识别数十种包管理生态中的依赖，并可与 Grype 等漏洞扫描器配合，实现精准的漏洞检测。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Syft 的 Go 源码、命令行入口、各包生态的解析器、多种 SBOM 格式（CycloneDX、SPDX、Syft JSON）的编解码器，以及文档和 CI 工作流。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 编写，依赖 Go 模块生态，支持 OCI、Docker、Singularity 等镜像格式，并遵循 in-toto 规范生成签名证明。
zh.hot: 随着软件供应链安全日益受重视，SBOM 成为合规与安全实践的关键环节，Syft 凭借 9557 颗星和本月 176 颗新增星，稳居 Go 语言月榜第 22 名。
uses: 安全工程师：为容器镜像和文件系统生成 SBOM，配合 Grype 进行漏洞扫描
DevOps/平台团队：在 CI/CD 流水线中集成 SBOM 生成，满足合规要求
开源维护者：分析项目依赖构成，追踪第三方组件与许可证信息
安全研究者：研究软件供应链与包生态的依赖关系

en.tag: CLI tool and Go library that generates SBOMs from container images and filesystems
en.what: Syft is a CLI tool and Go library that generates a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) from container images, filesystems, and archives. It detects dependencies across dozens of packaging ecosystems and pairs with scanners like Grype for precise vulnerability detection.
en.content: The repo contains Syft's Go source code, CLI entrypoint, parsers for many packaging ecosystems, encoders/decoders for SBOM formats (CycloneDX, SPDX, Syft JSON), plus docs and CI workflows.
en.stack: Written primarily in Go, it relies on the Go module ecosystem, supports OCI, Docker, and Singularity image formats, and follows the in-toto specification for signed attestations.
en.hot: As software supply chain security gains importance, SBOMs become key to compliance and security practices; with 9,557 stars and 176 added this month, Syft ranks 22nd on the monthly Go trending list.
uses: Security engineers: generate SBOMs for container images and filesystems, then scan with Grype
DevOps/platform teams: integrate SBOM generation into CI/CD pipelines for compliance
Open source maintainers: analyze dependency composition and track third-party components and licenses
Security researchers: study software supply chain and package ecosystem dependencies

zh.tag: 高性能内存数据存储，兼容 Redis 与 Memcached
zh.what: Dragonfly 是一个现代化的内存数据存储，专为现代应用负载设计。它完全兼容 Redis 和 Memcached API，无需修改代码即可迁移。相比传统内存存储，吞吐量提升 25 倍，资源消耗降低 80%。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心引擎源码、文档、基准测试、构建指南以及多语言 README。还提供了 Docker 镜像和云服务入口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Linux 内核特性如 epoll 和 io_uring。支持 Docker 部署，并提供 Helm charts 用于 Kubernetes。
zh.hot: 作为 Redis 和 Memcached 的现代替代品，凭借惊人的性能提升和资源节省，在 C++ 社区持续火爆，今日新增 77 星，总星数达 31150。
uses: 需要高吞吐、低延迟缓存服务的后端开发团队，可无缝替代 Redis。
希望在降低基础设施成本的同时提升性能的运维和架构师。
对内存数据库内部实现感兴趣的 C++ 开发者，可阅读源码学习。

en.tag: High-performance in-memory data store, Redis & Memcached compatible
en.what: Dragonfly is a modern in-memory data store built for modern application workloads. It is fully compatible with Redis and Memcached APIs, requiring no code changes to adopt. Compared to legacy in-memory datastores, it delivers 25X more throughput and uses up to 80% less resources.
en.content: The repository contains core engine source code, documentation, benchmarks, build guides, and multi-language READMEs. It also provides Docker images and a cloud service entry point.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, leveraging Linux kernel features like epoll and io_uring. Supports Docker deployment and provides Helm charts for Kubernetes.
en.hot: As a modern replacement for Redis and Memcached, it gains popularity in the C++ community due to its impressive performance gains and resource savings, with 77 new stars today and 31,150 total.
uses: Backend teams needing high-throughput, low-latency caching, seamlessly replacing Redis.
Ops and architects aiming to cut infrastructure costs while boosting performance.
C++ developers interested in the internals of in-memory databases for learning.

zh.tag: 3D打印切片与G代码生成工具
zh.what: PrusaSlicer 是一款将 3D 模型转换为 3D 打印指令（G-code）的软件，支持 FDM 和 mSLA 打印机。它由 Prusa Research 开发，兼容多种品牌打印机，并提供丰富的打印参数设置和模型编辑功能。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 源代码、构建文档（doc/Build.md）、资源文件（如图标）以及贡献指南。主要功能包括精确的打印参数设置、模型编辑（如涂色、切割、排列）、多项目多平台支持、多材料打印、3D 预览和命令行接口。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，基于 Slic3r 构建，依赖常见的图形和几何库。支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 平台，Linux 通过 Flathub 分发。
zh.hot: 作为 3D 打印领域的知名开源切片软件，PrusaSlicer 持续获得关注，今日新增 13 颗星，总星数达 9296，位列 C++ 趋势榜第三。其强大的功能和活跃的社区是热度来源。
uses: 3D 打印爱好者：使用 PrusaSlicer 将模型切片并生成打印指令，支持多种打印机。
专业用户：需要精细控制打印参数和进行多材料打印的工程师或设计师。
自动化工作流：通过命令行接口在无 GUI 环境下集成切片功能。

en.tag: 3D printing slicer and G-code generator
en.what: PrusaSlicer is a software that converts 3D models into 3D printing instructions (G-code), supporting FDM and mSLA printers. Developed by Prusa Research, it is compatible with a wide range of printer brands and offers extensive printing parameter settings and model editing features.
en.content: The repository contains the complete C++ source code, build documentation (doc/Build.md), resource files (e.g., icons), and contribution guidelines. Key features include precise printing parameter settings, model editing (painting, cutting, arranging), multi-project and multi-bed support, multi-material printing, 3D preview, and a command-line interface.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, built on Slic3r, and relies on common graphics and geometry libraries. Supports Windows, macOS, and Linux; Linux is distributed via Flathub.
en.hot: As a well-known open-source slicer in 3D printing, PrusaSlicer continues to gain attention, adding 13 stars today, reaching 9296 total, ranking third on the C++ trending list. Its powerful features and active community drive its popularity.
uses: 3D printing enthusiasts: use PrusaSlicer to slice models and generate print instructions for various printers.
Professional users: engineers or designers needing precise control over print parameters and multi-material printing.
Automation workflows: integrate slicing via command-line interface in headless environments.

zh.tag: 微软官方 WinUI 现代 Windows UI 框架
zh.what: WinUI 是微软推出的现代 UI 框架，提供丰富的控件和样式，用于构建高性能的 Windows 应用程序。当前版本 WinUI 3 作为 Windows App SDK 的一部分发布，支持 Fluent Design，并可通过 .NET 或 C++ 开发。
zh.content: 仓库包含 WinUI 的源代码、文档、示例和 WinUI 3 Gallery 交互式演示，涵盖控件库、样式、工具和迁移指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 实现，基于 Windows App SDK，支持 C#/.NET 和 C++ 开发，面向 x86、x64 和 ARM 架构。
zh.hot: 作为微软官方 UI 框架，WinUI 是 Windows 应用开发的核心，本月新增 140 星，位列 C++ 月榜第 5，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: Windows 桌面应用开发者，希望使用现代 Fluent Design 构建应用
需要跨版本兼容（Windows 10 1809+）的 Win32 或 UWP 开发者
学习微软官方 UI 框架和 Windows App SDK 的学生或爱好者

en.tag: Microsoft's official WinUI framework for modern Windows apps
en.what: WinUI is Microsoft's modern UI framework with a rich set of controls and styles for building high-performance Windows apps. The current version, WinUI 3, ships as part of the Windows App SDK, embracing Fluent Design and supporting development with .NET or C++.
en.content: The repo contains the source code, documentation, samples, and the WinUI 3 Gallery interactive demo, covering control libraries, styles, tools, and migration guides.
en.stack: Primarily implemented in C++, built on the Windows App SDK, supporting C#/.NET and C++ development for x86, x64, and ARM architectures.
en.hot: As Microsoft's official UI framework, WinUI is central to Windows app development, gaining 140 stars this month and ranking 5th in the C++ monthly trending, showing sustained developer interest.
uses: Windows desktop app developers wanting modern Fluent Design
Win32 or UWP developers needing cross-version compatibility (Windows 10 1809+)
Students or enthusiasts learning Microsoft's official UI framework and Windows App SDK

zh.tag: 跨平台开源多轨音频编辑器与录音软件
zh.what: Audacity 是一款易用的多轨音频编辑器和录音软件，支持 Windows、macOS、GNU/Linux 等系统。它提供录音、编辑、混音、效果处理等功能，适合播客、音乐制作和音频修复等场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Audacity 的完整源代码，包括核心编辑器、音频引擎、效果插件、UI 资源等。当前正在开发 Audacity 4，采用全新 UI 并进行大规模重构，同时保留 3.x 分支供维护。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 wxWidgets（UI）、PortAudio（音频 I/O）等库。构建系统支持 CMake，并提供针对不同平台的构建脚本。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源音频工具，Audacity 长期拥有稳定用户群。近期因 Audacity 4 的 UI 重构和功能更新引发关注，今日新增 272 星，位列 C++ 趋势榜第二。
uses: 播客制作者：录制和编辑多轨音频，添加效果和导出播客节目。
音乐爱好者：进行简单的录音、剪辑和混音，或修复老旧录音。
教育场景：用于音频教学、学生录音作业或声音实验。
音频修复：去除噪音、剪辑对话或恢复历史录音。

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source multi-track audio editor and recorder
en.what: Audacity is an easy-to-use, multi-track audio editor and recorder for Windows, macOS, GNU/Linux and other operating systems. It provides recording, editing, mixing, and effects processing, suitable for podcasting, music production, and audio restoration.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of Audacity, including the core editor, audio engine, effects plugins, and UI resources. It is currently undergoing major structural change for Audacity 4, with a brand-new UI and refactorings, while maintaining the 3.x branch.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, relying on wxWidgets for UI, PortAudio for audio I/O, and other libraries. The build system uses CMake, with platform-specific build scripts.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source audio tool, Audacity has a stable user base. Recent attention is driven by the UI overhaul and updates for Audacity 4, gaining 272 stars today and ranking #2 on the C++ trending list.
uses: Podcasters: record and edit multi-track audio, add effects, and export episodes.
Music enthusiasts: perform simple recording, editing, and mixing, or restore old recordings.
Educational settings: use for audio teaching, student recording assignments, or sound experiments.
Audio restoration: remove noise, edit dialogue, or recover historical recordings.

zh.tag: Google 官方 C++ 测试与模拟框架
zh.what: GoogleTest 是 Google 的 C++ 测试框架，用于编写和运行单元测试。它支持自动测试发现、丰富的断言、死亡测试、参数化测试等，并集成了 GoogleMock 用于模拟对象。
zh.content: 仓库包含 GoogleTest 和 GoogleMock 的源码、文档、示例以及构建配置。文档托管在 GitHub Pages 上，提供用户指南和入门教程。
zh.stack: 基于 C++，要求 C++17 或更高版本（1.18.x 分支）。计划依赖 Abseil 库。
zh.hot: 作为 Google 官方测试框架，拥有近 3.9 万 Star，是 C++ 社区的事实标准，持续维护并发布新版本。
uses: C++ 开发者编写单元测试，确保代码质量
需要模拟对象进行依赖隔离的测试场景
在 CI/CD 流程中集成自动化测试
学习 xUnit 测试框架设计的最佳实践

en.tag: Google's official C++ testing and mocking framework
en.what: GoogleTest is Google's C++ testing framework for writing and running unit tests. It supports automatic test discovery, rich assertions, death tests, parameterized tests, and integrates GoogleMock for mocking.
en.content: The repository contains source code, documentation, examples, and build configuration for GoogleTest and GoogleMock. Docs are hosted on GitHub Pages with user guide and primer.
en.stack: Built on C++, requires C++17 or later (1.18.x branch). Plans to depend on Abseil.
en.hot: As Google's official testing framework, it has nearly 39k stars, is the de facto standard in C++ community, and is actively maintained with new releases.
uses: C++ developers writing unit tests to ensure code quality
Scenarios requiring mocking objects for dependency isolation
Integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
Learning best practices of xUnit test framework design

zh.tag: 跨平台高性能机器学习推理与训练加速器
zh.what: ONNX Runtime 是一个跨平台的机器学习推理和训练加速器，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow/Keras 等深度学习框架以及 scikit-learn、LightGBM、XGBoost 等经典机器学习库。它通过硬件加速器、图优化和变换，在不同硬件、驱动和操作系统上提供最佳性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含 ONNX Runtime 的完整源代码、文档、示例和发布版本，以及用于推理和训练的示例仓库和插件执行提供程序（如 QNN）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，支持多种语言绑定（如 Python、C#、Java），并依赖 ONNX 格式和硬件加速库（如 CUDA、TensorRT）。
zh.hot: 作为微软开源的跨平台推理引擎，ONNX Runtime 在 AI 部署领域具有重要地位，本月新增 306 星，持续受到开发者关注。
uses: 需要在多种硬件（CPU、GPU、NPU）上部署机器学习模型的开发者
希望加速 PyTorch 或 TensorFlow 模型推理的工程团队
需要跨平台（Windows、Linux、macOS）统一推理解决方案的企业
研究模型优化和硬件加速的 AI 基础设施工程师

en.tag: Cross-platform, high-performance ML inference and training accelerator
en.what: ONNX Runtime is a cross-platform inference and training accelerator for machine learning, supporting models from deep learning frameworks like PyTorch and TensorFlow/Keras, as well as classical ML libraries such as scikit-learn, LightGBM, and XGBoost. It leverages hardware accelerators, graph optimizations, and transforms to deliver optimal performance across various hardware, drivers, and operating systems.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and releases for ONNX Runtime, along with companion sample repositories for inference and training, and plugin execution providers like QNN.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for multiple languages (e.g., Python, C#, Java), and relies on the ONNX format and hardware acceleration libraries (e.g., CUDA, TensorRT).
en.hot: As Microsoft's open-source cross-platform inference engine, ONNX Runtime holds a key position in AI deployment, gaining 306 stars this month and continuing to attract developer attention.
uses: Developers deploying ML models on diverse hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU)
Engineering teams looking to accelerate PyTorch or TensorFlow model inference
Enterprises needing a unified cross-platform (Windows, Linux, macOS) inference solution
AI infrastructure engineers researching model optimization and hardware acceleration

zh.tag: 轻量级多协议多源命令行下载工具
zh.what: aria2 是一个轻量级、跨平台的命令行下载工具，支持 HTTP/HTTPS、FTP、SFTP、BitTorrent 和 Metalink 等多种协议。它可以从多个源同时下载文件，并尝试利用最大下载带宽，还支持将 HTTP/FTP 下载的数据上传到 BitTorrent 群集。
zh.content: 仓库包含 aria2 的完整源代码，主要用 C++ 编写，包括核心下载引擎、协议实现、RPC 接口以及文档和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 OpenSSL、libssh2、libxml2、zlib 等库，支持在 Linux、macOS、Windows 等平台编译运行。
zh.hot: 作为一款经典且功能强大的下载工具，aria2 持续受到开发者欢迎，目前拥有超过 42,000 颗星，本周新增 198 星，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 分类第 18 名。
uses: 需要高效下载大文件或从多个源加速下载的用户
喜欢命令行操作和自动化脚本的开发者或系统管理员
需要集成下载功能到自有应用中的开发者（通过 JSON-RPC/XML-RPC）
希望利用 BitTorrent 协议进行文件分发和共享的用户

en.tag: Lightweight multi-protocol & multi-source command-line download utility
en.what: aria2 is a lightweight, cross-platform command-line download utility that supports multiple protocols including HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, SFTP, BitTorrent, and Metalink. It can download files from multiple sources simultaneously, aiming to utilize maximum download bandwidth, and can even upload data from HTTP/FTP downloads to the BitTorrent swarm.
en.content: The repository contains the complete source code of aria2, primarily written in C++, including the core download engine, protocol implementations, RPC interfaces, as well as documentation and build scripts.
en.stack: Primarily developed in C++, with dependencies on libraries such as OpenSSL, libssh2, libxml2, and zlib, and supports compilation and execution on Linux, macOS, Windows, and other platforms.
en.hot: As a classic and powerful download tool, aria2 continues to be popular among developers, with over 42,000 stars and 198 new stars this week, ranking 18th on the GitHub Trending weekly list for C++.
uses: Users who need to download large files efficiently or accelerate downloads from multiple sources
Developers or system administrators who prefer command-line operations and automation scripts
Developers who need to integrate download capabilities into their own applications (via JSON-RPC/XML-RPC)
Users who want to utilize the BitTorrent protocol for file distribution and sharing

zh.tag: 现代 C++ 格式化库，快速安全的 printf/iostream 替代品
zh.what: {fmt} 是一个开源格式化库，提供快速且安全的 C stdio 和 C++ iostreams 替代方案。它实现了 C++20 的 std::format 和 C++23 的 std::print，并支持类似 Python 的格式字符串语法。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的库源码、文档、示例和测试，核心文件包括 base.h、format.h 等，支持用户自定义类型和可移植的 Unicode。
zh.stack: 纯 C++ 实现，依赖少，支持 C++11 及以上标准，使用 Dragonbox 算法进行快速浮点格式化。
zh.hot: 今日新增 963 星，总星数达 25081，登顶 GitHub Trending 日榜。作为 C++ 标准库格式化功能的基础，其高性能和安全性备受开发者青睐。
uses: C++ 开发者需要比 printf 或 iostream 更安全、更快速的格式化输出时使用
库作者希望实现或扩展 C++20/23 格式化功能，或为自定义类型提供格式化支持
需要高精度浮点格式化且要求正确舍入和往返保证的数值计算场景

en.tag: A modern C++ formatting library, fast and safe alternative to printf and iostreams
en.what: {fmt} is an open-source formatting library providing a fast and safe alternative to C stdio and C++ iostreams. It implements C++20's std::format and C++23's std::print, with a format string syntax similar to Python's.
en.content: The repository contains full library source code, documentation, examples, and tests, with core files like base.h and format.h, supporting user-defined types and portable Unicode.
en.stack: Pure C++ implementation with minimal dependencies, supports C++11 and later, uses the Dragonbox algorithm for fast floating-point formatting.
en.hot: With 963 stars added today and 25,081 total, it tops the GitHub Trending daily chart. As the foundation for C++ standard formatting, its high performance and safety are widely appreciated.
uses: For C++ developers needing safer and faster formatting than printf or iostreams
For library authors implementing or extending C++20/23 formatting, or adding formatting support for custom types
For numerical computing scenarios requiring high-precision floating-point formatting with correct rounding and round-trip guarantees

zh.tag: 专为 RTX 5090 打造的单卡 C++/CUDA 推理引擎
zh.what: NInfer 是一个从零编写的 C++/CUDA 推理引擎，专门针对单张 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 上的特定 Qwen 检查点进行极致优化。它支持文本、图像和视频输入，可通过本地 CLI 或兼容 OpenAI/Anthropic 的 HTTP API 调用。运行时高度特化：单 GPU、单常驻模型、启动时固定 1 到 8 个并发请求容量。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++/CUDA 源码、CMake 构建系统，以及五个预注册的模型工件（Qwen3.6-27B、Qwen3.8-27B、Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 groupwise-int 与 nvfp4 版本）。每个工件内嵌 tokenizer、聊天模板和媒体前端资源，需从 Hugging Face 单独下载。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 C++20、CUDA 13.1+（仅支持 sm_120a 架构）、CMake 3.28+、Ninja，并依赖 FFmpeg 开发库（libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale）和 libcurl。要求 64 位 Linux 系统。
zh.hot: 本月新增 1306 颗星，总星数达 1600，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 10 名。它精准切中了 RTX 5090 用户对本地高性能单卡推理的需求，且以极致特化换取性能，在 AI 推理社区引发关注。
uses: 拥有 RTX 5090 并希望在本地运行 Qwen 大模型的开发者
需要低延迟、高吞吐单卡推理服务的 AI 应用部署者
对 C++/CUDA 推理引擎实现感兴趣的系统级工程师
想通过 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容 API 接入本地模型的研究人员

en.tag: A from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine tuned for single-GPU RTX 5090
en.what: NInfer is a from-scratch C++/CUDA inference engine purpose-built for explicitly registered Qwen checkpoints on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090. It handles text, image, and video prompts via a local CLI or OpenAI-/Anthropic-compatible HTTP APIs. The runtime is deliberately specialized: one GPU, one resident model, and a startup-fixed capacity of one to eight active requests.
en.content: The repo contains C++/CUDA source code, a CMake build system, and five pre-registered model artifacts (groupwise-int and nvfp4 variants of Qwen3.6-27B, Qwen3.8-27B, and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Each artifact embeds its tokenizer, chat template, and media frontend resources, and must be downloaded separately from Hugging Face.
en.stack: Tech stack: C++20, CUDA 13.1+ (sm_120a only), CMake 3.28+, Ninja, plus FFmpeg dev libraries (libavformat/libavcodec/libavutil/libswscale) and libcurl. Requires a 64-bit Linux system.
en.hot: It gained 1,306 stars this month (1,600 total), ranking #10 on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list. It hits a sweet spot for RTX 5090 owners seeking high-performance local single-GPU inference, and its extreme specialization for speed has caught the AI inference community's attention.
uses: Developers with an RTX 5090 who want to run Qwen models locally
AI application deployers needing low-latency, high-throughput single-GPU inference
Systems engineers interested in C++/CUDA inference engine implementation
Researchers wanting to access local models via OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible APIs

zh.tag: 跨平台开源密码管理器，离线加密存储敏感信息
zh.what: KeePassXC 是 Windows 应用 KeePass Password Safe 的社区驱动跨平台移植版，用于安全地存储和管理用户名、密码、URL、附件与笔记等敏感信息。所有数据保存在本地加密的 KDBX 文件中，可放在任意位置，包括私有或公有云盘。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++ 桌面应用源码，涵盖核心数据库逻辑、GUI、密码生成器、TOTP、浏览器集成与自动输入等模块，并配有测试、CI 配置和文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，依赖 libgcrypt、Argon2、zlib 等加密与压缩库，支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux。
zh.hot: 作为老牌开源密码管理器，它已积累 28739 颗星，本月新增 485 星并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 C++ 第 17 名，反映出用户对本地优先、可审计安全工具的持续需求。
uses: 注重隐私、希望密码完全离线自管的个人用户
需要在 Windows/macOS/Linux 多平台同步使用同一密码库的用户
想审计或自行编译安全软件的开发者与安全爱好者
为团队或家庭搭建本地密码共享方案的技术人员

en.tag: Cross-platform open-source password manager with offline encrypted storage
en.what: KeePassXC is a community-driven, cross-platform port of the Windows KeePass Password Safe, built to securely store and manage sensitive data such as usernames, passwords, URLs, attachments, and notes. Everything lives in a local encrypted KDBX file that can be kept anywhere, including private or public cloud storage.
en.content: The repo holds the full C++ desktop application source, covering core database logic, GUI, password generator, TOTP, browser integration, and auto-type modules, along with tests, CI configs, and docs.
en.stack: Built mainly in C++ with the Qt framework, depending on libgcrypt, Argon2, zlib and other crypto/compression libraries, targeting Windows, macOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As a long-standing open-source password manager, it has accumulated 28,739 stars with 485 added this month, ranking 17th on GitHub Trending's monthly C++ list, reflecting steady demand for local-first, auditable security tools.
uses: Privacy-conscious individuals who want fully offline, self-hosted password storage
Users who need the same password vault across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Developers and security enthusiasts who want to audit or self-compile security software
Technical users setting up local password sharing for teams or families

zh.tag: 英特尔开源深度学习推理优化与部署工具包
zh.what: OpenVINO 是英特尔开源的深度学习推理优化与部署工具包，可将训练好的模型转换并加速到 CPU、GPU、NPU 等硬件上运行。它覆盖计算机视觉、语音识别、生成式 AI 与 NLP 等常见任务，支持从边缘到云端的部署。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 推理引擎、模型转换与优化工具（如 Model Optimizer、NNCF 量化）、多语言绑定（Python/Node.js/C）、示例教程与文档，并有 openvino.genai 等配套仓库。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为核心，提供 Python、Node.js、C 等绑定，支持 PyTorch、TensorFlow、ONNX、Keras、PaddlePaddle、JAX/Flax 及 Hugging Face 模型，可通过 pip、conda、npm、brew 安装。
zh.hot: 作为英特尔主推的推理部署方案，OpenVINO 在边缘 AI 与本地大模型推理需求增长下持续受关注，本月新增 211 star，累计 10822，位列 GitHub C++ 月榜第 11。
uses: 需要在英特尔 CPU/GPU/NPU 上部署高性能推理的 AI 工程师
希望把 PyTorch/TensorFlow 模型优化并落地到边缘设备的开发者
从事计算机视觉、语音或生成式 AI 应用的产品与研究人员
想学习模型量化、转换与推理加速的学生和爱好者

en.tag: Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference
en.what: OpenVINO is Intel's open-source toolkit for optimizing and deploying deep learning inference, converting trained models to run fast on CPU, GPU, and NPU hardware. It covers computer vision, speech recognition, generative AI, and NLP, from edge to cloud.
en.content: The repo contains the core C++ inference engine, model conversion and optimization tools (Model Optimizer, NNCF quantization), multi-language bindings (Python/Node.js/C), samples, tutorials, and docs, plus companion repos like openvino.genai.
en.stack: Core in C++ with Python, Node.js, and C bindings; supports PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, Keras, PaddlePaddle, JAX/Flax, and Hugging Face models, installable via pip, conda, npm, and brew.
en.hot: As Intel's flagship inference deployment solution, OpenVINO keeps gaining traction amid rising edge AI and local LLM inference demand, adding 211 stars this month for 10,822 total and ranking 11th on GitHub's monthly C++ trending list.
uses: AI engineers deploying high-performance inference on Intel CPU/GPU/NPU
Developers optimizing and shipping PyTorch/TensorFlow models to edge devices
Product teams and researchers working on vision, speech, or generative AI apps
Students and hobbyists learning model quantization, conversion, and inference acceleration

zh.tag: 快速本地神经语音合成引擎，支持多语言与离线部署
zh.what: Piper 是一个快速、本地的神经文本转语音（TTS）引擎，使用 espeak-ng 进行音素化，支持多种语言和声音。它可以在本地运行，无需联网，适合隐私敏感和低延迟场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C++ 核心库 libpiper、Python 绑定、命令行工具、HTTP 服务器以及训练新声音的文档和脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 espeak-ng 进行音素化，提供 Python 包（piper-tts）和 C/C++ API，支持 pip 安装。
zh.hot: Piper 因其高质量、低延迟的本地 TTS 能力而受欢迎，已被 Home Assistant、NVDA 等知名项目采用。本月新增 459 星，总星数达 5536，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜（C++）第 14 名。
uses: 需要离线语音合成的开发者，用于智能家居、辅助工具等场景
无障碍应用开发者，为视障用户提供文本朗读功能
研究人员和爱好者，用于语音合成实验和自定义声音训练
嵌入式或边缘设备开发者，寻求轻量级 TTS 解决方案

en.tag: Fast local neural text-to-speech engine with offline, multilingual support
en.what: Piper is a fast, local neural text-to-speech engine that uses espeak-ng for phonemization and supports multiple languages and voices. It runs entirely offline, making it ideal for privacy-sensitive and low-latency applications.
en.content: The repository includes the C++ core library libpiper, Python bindings, a command-line interface, an HTTP server, and documentation/scripts for training new voices.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, depends on espeak-ng for phonemization, provides a Python package (piper-tts) and C/C++ API, and supports pip installation.
en.hot: Piper is popular for its high-quality, low-latency local TTS capabilities and has been adopted by well-known projects like Home Assistant and NVDA. It gained 459 stars this month, reaching 5,536 total, and ranked 14th on GitHub Trending monthly (C++).
uses: Developers needing offline speech synthesis for smart homes, accessibility tools, etc.
Accessibility app developers providing text-to-speech for visually impaired users
Researchers and hobbyists for speech synthesis experiments and custom voice training
Embedded or edge device developers seeking lightweight TTS solutions

zh.tag: 可扩展分布式梯度提升库，支持多语言多平台
zh.what: XGBoost 是一个优化的分布式梯度提升库，旨在高效、灵活且可移植。它实现了梯度提升框架下的机器学习算法，提供并行树提升（GBDT、GBM），能够快速准确地解决许多数据科学问题。同一套代码可在 Kubernetes、Hadoop、Spark 等分布式环境运行，处理数十亿样本。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 实现、多语言接口（Python、R、Java、Scala、C++ 等）、分布式集成（Spark、Dask、Flink 等）、文档、示例和测试。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，提供 Python、R、Java、Scala 等语言绑定，支持分布式框架如 Spark、Dask、Flink 和 DataFlow。
zh.hot: XGBoost 是机器学习竞赛和工业界的经典工具，拥有 28.7k 星标，本月新增 126 星，持续活跃。其高效性和多平台支持使其成为数据科学家的首选。
uses: 数据科学家和机器学习工程师用于构建高性能的梯度提升模型，解决分类、回归和排序问题。
需要在大规模数据集上训练模型的企业，利用其分布式能力处理海量数据。
Kaggle 竞赛参与者，利用其准确性和速度提升模型表现。
研究人员和开发者，通过其多语言接口集成到现有系统中。

en.tag: Scalable, portable, distributed gradient boosting library for multiple languages and platforms
en.what: XGBoost is an optimized distributed gradient boosting library designed to be highly efficient, flexible, and portable. It implements machine learning algorithms under the Gradient Boosting framework, providing parallel tree boosting (GBDT, GBM) that solves many data science problems fast and accurately. The same code runs on major distributed environments (Kubernetes, Hadoop, Spark, etc.) and can handle billions of examples.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ implementation, multi-language interfaces (Python, R, Java, Scala, C++), distributed integrations (Spark, Dask, Flink), documentation, examples, and tests.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, with bindings for Python, R, Java, Scala, and more; supports distributed frameworks like Spark, Dask, Flink, and DataFlow.
en.hot: XGBoost is a classic tool in ML competitions and industry, with 28.7k stars and 126 new stars this month, remaining active. Its efficiency and multi-platform support make it a top choice for data scientists.
uses: Data scientists and ML engineers use it to build high-performance gradient boosting models for classification, regression, and ranking.
Enterprises needing to train models on large-scale datasets leverage its distributed capabilities to handle massive data.
Kaggle competitors utilize its accuracy and speed to improve model performance.
Researchers and developers integrate it into existing systems via its multi-language interfaces.

zh.tag: 进程内分析型 SQL 数据库，极速查询 CSV/Parquet
zh.what: DuckDB 是一个高性能的分析型数据库系统，设计为快速、可靠、可移植且易于使用。它支持丰富的 SQL 方言，包括复杂子查询、窗口函数、复杂类型等，并可直接查询 CSV 和 Parquet 文件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DuckDB 的完整源代码、文档、扩展机制以及多种客户端（Python、R、Java、Wasm 等）的集成。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++17 编写，依赖 CMake 构建系统，支持 Python 3 等开发环境。
zh.hot: 作为进程内分析数据库的标杆，DuckDB 凭借其极简部署和高性能查询，在数据科学领域迅速走红，star 数已突破 4 万，今日新增 69 个。
uses: 数据科学家和分析师，希望在 Python 或 R 环境中快速分析大型数据集，无需单独部署数据库服务器。
数据工程师，需要将 CSV/Parquet 文件直接作为 SQL 查询源，简化数据管道。
应用开发者，希望嵌入分析能力到现有应用中，提供轻量级 OLAP 功能。

en.tag: In-process analytical SQL database, blazing fast queries on CSV/Parquet
en.what: DuckDB is a high-performance analytical database system designed to be fast, reliable, portable, and easy to use. It supports a rich SQL dialect including complex subqueries, window functions, complex types, and can directly query CSV and Parquet files.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, extension mechanisms, and integrations for multiple clients (Python, R, Java, Wasm, etc.).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++17, built with CMake, and supports Python 3 for development.
en.hot: As a benchmark for in-process analytical databases, DuckDB has gained rapid popularity in data science due to its minimal deployment and high-performance queries, with over 40k stars and 69 new today.
uses: Data scientists and analysts who want to quickly analyze large datasets in Python or R without deploying a separate database server.
Data engineers who need to query CSV/Parquet files directly as SQL sources to simplify data pipelines.
Application developers who want to embed analytical capabilities into existing applications for lightweight OLAP functionality.

zh.tag: 用 Web 技术构建跨平台桌面应用的开源框架
zh.what: Electron 是一个开源框架，允许开发者使用 JavaScript、HTML 和 CSS 构建跨平台桌面应用。它基于 Node.js 和 Chromium，被 Visual Studio Code 等众多知名应用采用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Electron 的完整源代码、文档、示例以及构建和测试脚本。它提供了预编译的二进制文件，支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 平台。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 和 JavaScript，依赖 Chromium 和 Node.js。通过 npm 安装，支持多种平台架构。
zh.hot: 拥有超过 12 万颗星，是 GitHub 上最受欢迎的桌面应用框架之一。今日新增 8 颗星，持续保持高热度。
uses: 开发者：希望用 Web 技术快速构建跨平台桌面应用的开发者
团队：需要为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供一致体验的产品团队
学习者：想学习桌面应用开发或了解 Chromium 和 Node.js 集成的学习者

en.tag: Open-source framework for building cross-platform desktop apps with web tech
en.what: Electron is an open-source framework that lets developers build cross-platform desktop apps using JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. It is based on Node.js and Chromium and is used by many well-known apps like Visual Studio Code.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code, documentation, examples, and build/test scripts for Electron. It provides prebuilt binaries for macOS, Windows, and Linux.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++ and JavaScript, relying on Chromium and Node.js. Installed via npm, supporting multiple platforms and architectures.
en.hot: With over 120k stars, it's one of the most popular desktop app frameworks on GitHub. Gained 8 stars today, maintaining high popularity.
uses: Developers: those who want to quickly build cross-platform desktop apps using web technologies
Teams: product teams needing consistent experience across Windows, macOS, and Linux
Learners: those interested in desktop app development or the integration of Chromium and Node.js

zh.tag: 开源 Minecraft 多实例启动器，MultiMC 的社区分支
zh.what: Prism Launcher 是一款自定义 Minecraft 启动器，让玩家可以同时管理多个相互隔离的游戏实例，每个实例可独立配置版本、模组加载器和资源。它是 MultiMC 的社区分支，但与原项目并无隶属关系。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++/Qt 编写的启动器源码，包含构建脚本、打包配置（Flatpak、各发行版）、翻译文件与 CI 工作流，另有官网与文档资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架，依赖 CMake 构建，通过 GitHub Actions 产出 Linux、Windows、macOS 构建，翻译托管在 Weblate。
zh.hot: 作为 MultiMC 的活跃分支，它凭借更快的更新、对模组加载器的友好支持和跨平台打包，积累了 10385 颗星，本月再增 309 星并登上 C++ 月榜第 22 名。
uses: Minecraft 玩家：需要同时管理多个版本与模组整合包的玩家
模组开发者：想快速切换不同游戏版本与加载器进行测试
Linux 用户：希望通过 Flatpak 或发行版包安装启动器的用户
开源贡献者：对 C++/Qt 桌面应用和本地化翻译感兴趣的人

en.tag: An open-source Minecraft launcher for managing multiple instances, forked from MultiMC
en.what: Prism Launcher is a custom Minecraft launcher that lets players manage multiple isolated game instances at once, each with its own version, mod loader and assets. It is a community fork of MultiMC and is not endorsed by the original project.
en.content: The repo holds the C++/Qt launcher source, build scripts, packaging configs (Flatpak, distro packages), translation files and CI workflows, plus website and documentation assets.
en.stack: Built mainly with C++ and the Qt framework via CMake, with GitHub Actions producing Linux, Windows and macOS builds and translations hosted on Weblate.
en.hot: As an actively maintained MultiMC fork, it has earned 10,385 stars thanks to faster updates, friendly mod-loader support and cross-platform packaging, adding 309 stars this month and ranking 22nd on the C++ monthly trending list.
uses: Minecraft players: those who need to manage multiple versions and modpacks at once
Mod developers: those who want to quickly switch game versions and loaders for testing
Linux users: those who prefer installing via Flatpak or distro packages
Open-source contributors: people interested in C++/Qt desktop apps and localization

zh.tag: 把整个项目文件夹变成可查询知识图谱的 AI 技能
zh.what: 给 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor、Gemini CLI 等 AI 编码助手用的 skill：输入 /graphify，它就把整个项目（代码、SQL schema、文档、PDF、图片、视频）映射成一张可查询的知识图谱，代替 grep 翻文件。代码解析走 tree-sitter AST —— 确定性、不用 LLM、完全本地；文档类内容才走模型做语义处理。不是向量索引，是真图谱，每条边标注 EXTRACTED（直接读到）还是 INFERRED（推断出来）。
zh.content: 以 CLI 形式分发（PyPI 包 graphifyy，uv tool install 或 pipx 安装），仓库含 docs/（30 多种语言 README 翻译）和交互式 graph.html 可视化产物；默认分支 v8，迭代很快。
zh.stack: Python + tree-sitter 代码解析，产出力导向 HTML 图；挂到各家 CLI 助手上当 skill 用。
zh.hot: 它用知识图谱补足纯向量检索的局限，直接回应团队构建上下文型 AI 助手时遇到的 RAG 难题。
uses: 接手中大型老项目的开发者 —— 一条命令生成知识图谱，快速搞清代码结构
AI 重度用户 —— 给 agent 换图谱上下文，替代检索不准的向量 RAG
技术文档团队 —— 把文档 / PDF / 图纸一起纳入可查询图谱

en.tag: An AI skill that turns a whole project folder into a queryable knowledge graph
en.what: A skill for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more: type /graphify and your entire project — code, SQL schemas, docs, PDFs, images, videos — is mapped into a queryable knowledge graph, replacing grep-and-scroll. Code parsing uses tree-sitter AST: deterministic, no LLM, fully local; only document content goes through a model. Not a vector index — a real graph, with every edge labeled EXTRACTED (read directly) or INFERRED.
en.content: Distributed as a CLI (PyPI package graphifyy, install via uv tool install or pipx); the repo holds docs/ (README translations in 30+ languages) and interactive graph.html visualizations; default branch v8, iterating fast.
en.stack: Python + tree-sitter, outputting force-directed HTML graphs; hooks into each CLI assistant as a skill.
en.hot: Its knowledge-graph alternative to vector-only retrieval speaks directly to limitations teams encounter when building contextual AI assistants.
uses: Developers inheriting large legacy projects — one command maps the codebase into a knowledge graph
Heavy AI users — swap vector RAG for graph context that retrieves the right thing
Docs teams — fold docs, PDFs and diagrams into one queryable graph

zh.tag: 港大出品的 AI 私人家教：个性化终身学习工作区
zh.what: 香港大学 HKUDS 实验室的「agent 原生」学习平台：聊天辅导、刷题测验、深度研究、可视化、解题、Mastery Path 掌握度练习跑在同一套 agent 循环上。支持多引擎 RAG 知识库（LlamaIndex、PageIndex、GraphRAG、LightRAG，可挂 Obsidian 库），可从任意对话呼叫 Claude Code / Codex 等子 agent；带三层可检查记忆（L1 trace / L2 摘要 / L3 综合）和 Memory Graph 溯源。
zh.content: 完整 Web 应用（Python 后端 + Next.js 16 前端），附 11 种语言 README、Docker 部署、CLI/agent-native 接口、EduHub 社区 skills 生态；发版极勤。
zh.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16，RAG 多引擎 + MCP 工具 + FAISS 向量库，Apache-2.0；2025 年 12 月底创建，有 arXiv 论文背书。
zh.hot: 它把 AI 教育与 Agent 原生工作流结合，并由高校实验室持续维护，概念清晰、可体验性强。
uses: 学生 / 自学者 —— 把教材和论文喂进去，得到 24 小时私人家教
考研 / 考证党 —— 用刷题测验 + 掌握度路径系统备考
知识管理玩家 —— 直接挂 Obsidian 库做 RAG 问答

en.tag: An AI personal tutor from HKU: a lifelong, personalized learning workspace
en.what: An 'agent-native' learning platform from HKU's HKUDS lab: chat tutoring, quizzes, deep research, visualization, problem solving and Mastery-Path practice all run on one agent loop. It supports multi-engine RAG knowledge bases (LlamaIndex, PageIndex, GraphRAG, LightRAG — even your Obsidian vault), lets you call Claude Code / Codex sub-agents from any conversation, and ships three-layer inspectable memory (L1 trace / L2 summary / L3 synthesis) with a Memory Graph for provenance.
en.content: A full web app (Python backend + Next.js 16 frontend) with READMEs in 11 languages, Docker deployment, CLI/agent-native interfaces and the EduHub community skills ecosystem; releases ship very frequently.
en.stack: Python 3.11+ + Next.js 16, multi-engine RAG + MCP tools + FAISS; Apache-2.0; created late December 2025 with an arXiv paper behind it.
en.hot: It combines AI education with an agent-native workflow and carries the credibility of a university research lab, making the concept easy to evaluate and share.
uses: Students & self-learners — feed in textbooks and papers, get a 24/7 personal tutor
Exam candidates — prepare systematically with quizzes and the mastery path
PKM enthusiasts — plug your Obsidian vault straight in for RAG Q&A

zh.tag: 专治「AI 味」网页的设计 skill，让 AI 生成的 UI 不像模板货
zh.what: Together AI 出品的设计 skill 包：装进 Claude Code、Cursor 或 Codex 后，AI 生成网页 UI 时会从 20 套主题里选宏观结构，并跑 57 项「anti-slop」检查加自我批判，拒绝 LLM 默认那套千篇一律的渐变卡片风。提供生成、hallmark audit（给现有代码打分）、hallmark redesign（换结构重写）、hallmark study（从截图/URL 提取设计 DNA）四个动词。
zh.content: 核心是 skills/hallmark/ 下的 SKILL.md + references/ 规则文件；docs/ 有 recipes 和示例，site/ 是官网及大量自包含 HTML+CSS 示例页（语言占比因此显示为 CSS）。
zh.stack: Markdown 规则 + 参考文档的 skill 包（符合 Agent Skills 规范），示例为纯 HTML/CSS，MIT，无运行时依赖，一行 npx skills add nutlope/hallmark 安装。
zh.hot: 它直指 AI 生成网站同质化这一普遍痛点，并用在线 Demo 降低验证门槛，定位清晰且易于传播。
uses: 独立开发者 / 小团队 —— 没有设计师，也能让 AI 生成不撞脸的官网和落地页
设计师 —— 用 hallmark study 从优秀网站提取设计 DNA 做参考
前端工程师 —— 用 audit 给存量项目打分，找出「AI 味」重灾区

en.tag: The anti-'AI-slop' design skill — AI-built UIs that don't look like templates
en.what: A design skill pack from Together AI: once installed in Claude Code, Cursor or Codex, your agent picks a macro-structure from 20 themes when generating web UIs, then runs 57 'anti-slop' checks plus self-critique — rejecting the default LLM look of identical gradient cards. Four verbs: generate, hallmark audit (score existing code), hallmark redesign (rewrite with a new structure), hallmark study (extract design DNA from a screenshot or URL).
en.content: The core is SKILL.md plus rule files under skills/hallmark/ and references/; docs/ holds recipes and examples; site/ contains the homepage and many self-contained HTML+CSS example pages (which is why the language stat reads CSS).
en.stack: A Markdown-rules skill pack (Agent Skills compliant) with pure HTML/CSS examples; MIT, zero runtime dependencies; install via npx skills add nutlope/hallmark.
en.hot: Its anti-slop positioning addresses a common complaint about AI-generated websites, while the live demo makes the claim easy to evaluate.
uses: Indie devs & small teams — generate distinctive sites and landing pages without a designer
Designers — extract design DNA from great sites with hallmark study
Frontend engineers — audit existing projects to find the worst 'AI-slop' offenders

zh.tag: 开源版 CapCut（剪映），免费跨平台视频编辑器
zh.what: 免费开源视频编辑器，对标 CapCut，目标覆盖 Web、桌面和移动端。项目正在从零重写：Editor API、插件优先架构、Rust 核心（一套代码跑桌面/移动/浏览器）、供 AI agent 调用的 MCP server、无头批量渲染模式和编辑器内置脚本页。旧版代码已迁至 opencut-classic 继续维护。
zh.content: monorepo：apps/web、apps/desktop、apps/api 三个应用，根目录 Cargo.toml（Rust 核心）；用 moonrepo + proto 管理工具链，moon run web:dev 即可起本地开发。
zh.stack: TypeScript（Web 前端）+ Rust 核心，Bun 包管理，MIT；重写期间暂不接受外部代码贡献。
zh.hot: 「开源视频剪辑工具」满足了广泛需求，Rust 重写与基于 MCP 的 AI 剪辑能力又形成了清晰的技术差异。
uses: 自媒体创作者 —— 免费替代剪映专业版，无水印跨平台剪片
开发者 / 自动化团队 —— 通过 MCP server 让 AI agent 批量剪视频
企业 —— 基于 Editor API 和插件架构搭建内部视频流水线

en.tag: The open-source CapCut alternative — free, cross-platform video editing
en.what: A free, open-source video editor rivaling CapCut, targeting web, desktop and mobile. The project is being rewritten from scratch: an Editor API, plugin-first architecture, a Rust core (one codebase for desktop/mobile/browser), an MCP server so AI agents can edit video, a headless mode for automated batch rendering, and built-in editor scripting. Legacy code lives on in opencut-classic.
en.content: A monorepo: apps/web, apps/desktop and apps/api, with a root Cargo.toml for the Rust core; toolchain managed by moonrepo + proto — `moon run web:dev` starts local dev.
en.stack: TypeScript (web frontend) + Rust core, Bun for packages, MIT; external code contributions are paused during the rewrite.
en.hot: The open-source alternative to CapCut addresses broad latent demand, while the Rust rewrite and MCP-based AI editing story give the project a distinct technical direction.
uses: Content creators — a free, watermark-free CapCut Pro alternative across platforms
Dev & automation teams — batch-edit video via AI agents over the MCP server
Companies — build internal video pipelines on the Editor API and plugin architecture

zh.tag: 开源一体化产品数据平台：分析、回放、实验、LLM 观测全包
zh.what: 知名开源产品数据平台：产品分析、Web 分析、session 回放、feature flag、A/B 实验、错误追踪、日志、问卷、数据仓库、CDP、LLM 可观测性全部集成在一个系统。最新定位「构建自驱动产品（self-driving products）」：把错误、rage click 等产品信号自动转成分析报告和 PR 供你 review 合并，可从 Slack、Web、桌面端或 MCP 操作，支持 Docker 自托管。
zh.content: 超大型 monorepo：posthog/（Django 后端）、frontend/、products/（各产品线）、rust/、services/、ee/（企业版，单独授权），大量 docker-compose 部署文件与全平台 SDK。
zh.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust 服务，底层 ClickHouse；MIT（ee/ 目录除外）。
zh.hot: 它把完整的产品分析套件与面向 Agent 的自动化能力结合，既有成熟开发者用户，也有清晰的新使用场景。
uses: 产品团队 —— 一个平台替代 GA + 回放 + 实验工具的组合订阅
注重数据合规的公司 —— 自托管部署，用户数据不出机房
AI 产品团队 —— 用 LLM 可观测性追踪自家 agent 的成本与质量

en.tag: The open-source all-in-one product data platform
en.what: The well-known open-source product data platform: product analytics, web analytics, session replay, feature flags, A/B experiments, error tracking, logs, surveys, a data warehouse, CDP pipelines and LLM observability in one system. Its latest positioning is 'self-driving products': product signals like errors and rage clicks are automatically turned into analysis reports and PRs for you to review and merge — operable from Slack, web, desktop or MCP, and self-hostable via Docker.
en.content: A huge monorepo: posthog/ (Django backend), frontend/, products/ (each product line), rust/, services/, ee/ (enterprise code, separately licensed), lots of docker-compose files and SDKs for every platform.
en.stack: Python/Django + TypeScript/React + Rust services over ClickHouse; MIT (except ee/).
en.hot: The project combines a broad product-analytics suite with an agent-facing automation narrative, giving an established developer audience a clear reason to revisit it.
uses: Product teams — replace the GA + replay + experimentation stack with one platform
Compliance-sensitive companies — self-host so user data never leaves your infra
AI product teams — track your agents' cost and quality with LLM observability

zh.tag: 1-bit/三值超压缩大模型 Bonsai 的本地运行 demo
zh.what: PrismML 的 Bonsai 系列语言模型官方演示仓库，主打极致量化：1-bit 版每权重约 1.125 bit，27B 模型能塞进现代 iPhone；三值（Ternary）版约 1.7 bit，是质量更高的默认选项。最新 27B 是视觉语言模型，支持看图、tool calling、MCP、256k+ 长上下文和推理努力度调节。
zh.content: 纯 Shell 脚本工程：setup.sh / setup.ps1 一键装依赖下模型，scripts/ 放运行和下载脚本，另有三份白皮书 PDF、AGENTS.md（写给 AI agent 看的配置指南）、VISION/TOOLS 等专题文档与社区 benchmark。
zh.stack: Shell + llama.cpp 服务端，模型托管在 HuggingFace；支持 Mac Metal、CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm 和纯 CPU，Apache-2.0。
zh.hot: 视觉语言模型与 iPhone 端侧演示把技术卖点变得直观，配套脚本也降低了上手与复现实验的门槛。
uses: 手机 / 边缘设备开发者 —— 在 iPhone 上离线跑 27B 视觉语言模型
隐私敏感场景 —— 医疗、法律等数据不出本地的本地 AI 助手
硬件玩家 —— 在树莓派等低功耗设备上体验大模型

en.tag: Local-run demo of Bonsai, the 1-bit / ternary ultra-compressed LLMs
en.what: The official demo repo for PrismML's Bonsai model family, built around extreme quantization: the 1-bit version uses ~1.125 bits per weight so a 27B model fits a modern iPhone; the ternary version (~1.7 bits) is the higher-quality default. The newest 27B is a vision-language model with image input, tool calling, MCP, 256k+ context and adjustable reasoning effort.
en.content: A pure Shell project: setup.sh / setup.ps1 one-liners install dependencies and pull models, scripts/ holds run/download scripts, plus three whitepaper PDFs, an AGENTS.md (a config guide written for AI agents), topical docs (VISION/TOOLS/…) and community benchmarks.
en.stack: Shell + a llama.cpp server, models hosted on HuggingFace; runs on Mac Metal, CUDA/Vulkan/ROCm or plain CPU; Apache-2.0.
en.hot: The vision-language model and on-device iPhone demo make a technically ambitious claim concrete, while the included scripts reduce trial friction.
uses: Mobile / edge developers — run a 27B vision-language model offline on an iPhone
Privacy-sensitive settings — local AI assistants for medical or legal data that can't leave the device
Hardware tinkerers — run LLMs on low-power boards like a Raspberry Pi

zh.tag: GTA 5 增强版的开源作弊菜单 DLL
zh.what: 《GTA 5: Enhanced》的实验性修改菜单（mod menu）：编译成 DLL 后用 Xenos 等注入器在游戏主菜单注入，按 INSERT 或 Ctrl+\ 呼出菜单。建议配合 FSL 把存档数据重定向到本地磁盘以保号，且需要关闭 BattlEye 反作弊（目前没有 BE 绕过，公共战局会被心跳检测踢出）。
zh.content: C++ 源码 + 一份简短 README，讲清使用步骤（FSL → 下载 nightly release → 注入器 → 关 BattlEye → 注入）和常见问题修复（掉线、存档消失、游戏起不来）。
zh.stack: C++，DLL 注入式单机/联机修改器，依赖外部注入器和 FSL，GPL-2.0；默认分支 enhanced。
zh.hot: 它面向 GTA5 增强版 Mod 社区的具体需求，并延续 YimMenu 项目路线，为需要开源菜单的用户提供选择。
uses: GTA5 单机玩家 —— 刷车刷钱体验全部游戏内容
mod 开发者 —— 基于源码学习或二次开发游戏菜单
离线娱乐 —— 关 BattlEye 后在私人战局整活

en.tag: The open-source mod menu DLL for GTA 5: Enhanced
en.what: An experimental mod menu for GTA 5: Enhanced: compile to a DLL, inject at the main menu with an injector like Xenos, then press INSERT or Ctrl+\ to open. Pairing with FSL (redirecting save data to local disk) is recommended to protect your account, and BattlEye anti-cheat must be disabled (there's no BE bypass — public sessions will kick you via heartbeat checks).
en.content: C++ source plus a short README covering the workflow (FSL → nightly release → injector → disable BattlEye → inject) and fixes for common issues (disconnects, missing saves, game won't launch).
en.stack: C++, a DLL-injection single/multiplayer mod menu relying on external injectors and FSL; GPL-2.0; default branch enhanced.
en.hot: It targets a concrete need in the GTA5 Enhanced modding community and continues the familiar YimMenu project line for users seeking an open menu.
uses: GTA5 single-player fans — unlock vehicles and cash to experience all content
mod developers — learn from or fork the source for custom game menus
Offline fun — mess around in private sessions with BattlEye off

zh.tag: 教你从零重写各种技术的教程大合集
zh.what: CodeCrafters 维护的著名教程索引仓库，理念是费曼那句「我不能创造的东西，我就不理解」。收录大量「从零重写某技术」的 step-by-step 教程链接，覆盖数据库、操作系统、Git、Docker、编程语言、神经网络、Web 浏览器等约 30 个类别。
zh.content: 主体是一个巨大的 README 列表，按「Build your own X」分类组织，每条标注所用编程语言和链接（如用 Python 写 LLM、用 C++ 写光线追踪）；无代码本体。
zh.stack: 纯 Markdown 文档；收录的教程本身横跨 C/C++/Python/Go/Rust 等各种语言。
zh.hot: 它用「亲手实现一遍」把抽象的计算机科学原理变成具体项目，学习路径清晰，因此长期具有传播力。
uses: 在校生 / 转行者 —— 按「造一遍」路线真正理解数据库、操作系统原理
资深工程师 —— 面试前用手写 Git / Docker 项目补底层功底
技术布道者 —— 按分类找写作和分享素材

en.tag: The giant collection of 'rebuild your favorite tech from scratch' tutorials
en.what: CodeCrafters' famous tutorial index, founded on Feynman's 'What I cannot create, I do not understand'. It collects step-by-step 'build your own X' tutorial links across ~30 categories: databases, operating systems, Git, Docker, programming languages, neural networks, web browsers and more.
en.content: Essentially one huge README list organized by 'Build your own X' categories, each entry tagged with its language and link (e.g. write an LLM in Python, a raytracer in C++); no code of its own.
en.stack: Pure Markdown; the tutorials themselves span C/C++/Python/Go/Rust and more.
en.hot: Its learn-by-building catalog remains useful because it turns abstract computer-science concepts into concrete implementation projects.
uses: Students & career switchers — truly understand databases and OS internals by building them
Senior engineers — shore up fundamentals before interviews by hand-rolling Git / Docker
Tech writers — find writing and talk material by category

zh.tag: 把 GitHub Copilot 智能体嵌进你自己应用的官方 SDK
zh.what: GitHub 官方出的多语言 SDK：在自己的应用或服务里直接调用 Copilot Agent 的能力。它暴露的是 Copilot CLI 背后同一套经过生产验证的 agent 运行时 —— 你不用自己搭编排层，定义好 agent 行为，规划、工具调用、文件编辑都交给 Copilot 处理。
zh.content: 单仓库 6 套 SDK，按目录分：nodejs/、python/、go/、dotnet/、java/、rust/，另有 docs/、test/ 和 cookbook 示例；各语言经 npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io 分发。
zh.stack: 多语言 monorepo（TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust 六个 SDK），MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，推送非常活跃。
zh.hot: 「Copilot agent 能力开放给第三方应用」的定位自带关注度，GitHub 官方背书。
uses: SaaS 厂商 —— 在产品里内嵌 Copilot 级 AI 助手（IDE、低代码平台等）
企业内部工具 —— 快速给内部系统加 agent 能力，不用自研编排
多语言团队 —— JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust 任选

en.tag: GitHub's official SDK for embedding the Copilot agent in your own apps
en.what: GitHub's official multi-language SDK: call the Copilot Agent's capabilities directly from your own apps and services. It exposes the same production-proven agent runtime behind the Copilot CLI — no need to build your own orchestration layer: define the agent's behavior and let Copilot handle planning, tool calls and file edits.
en.content: Six SDKs in one repo, by directory: nodejs/, python/, go/, dotnet/, java/, rust/, plus docs/, test/ and cookbook examples; distributed via npm / PyPI / NuGet / Maven Central / crates.io.
en.stack: A multi-language monorepo (TS/Python/Go/.NET/Java/Rust), MIT; created January 2026, committing very actively.
en.hot: 'Copilot agent capabilities opened to third-party apps' draws attention by itself — with GitHub's official stamp on it.
uses: SaaS vendors — embed Copilot-grade AI assistance into products (IDEs, low-code platforms)
Internal tooling — add agent capabilities to internal systems without building orchestration
Polyglot teams — pick from JS / Python / Go / .NET / Java / Rust

zh.tag: 给设计工程师准备的一套 UI 类 Agent Skills
zh.what: 知名设计工程师 ibelick 出品的 UI 技能包集合：让 AI 编码 agent 按任务自动走对应的 UI 技能流程，跑一行 npx ui-skills start 就能把 agent 路由到合适的技能集。
zh.content: skills/ 目录下 6 个技能：baseline-ui、improve-ui、fixing-accessibility、fixing-metadata、fixing-motion-performance、ui-skills-root；另有 bin/（CLI 入口）和配套网站（Astro + Cloudflare Workers）。
zh.stack: TypeScript，CLI 走 npx 分发，MIT；2026 年 1 月创建，官网 ui-skills.com。
zh.hot: 把设计判断封装成 AI Agent 可复用技能，这一思路对设计工程师直观易懂，也便于立刻试用。
uses: 前端开发者 —— 让 agent 按设计规范生成和改进 UI，告别「能跑但丑」
设计工程师 —— 把无障碍、metadata、动效性能检查自动化
独立开发者 —— 一人兼顾开发和设计时的品味兜底

en.tag: A set of UI Agent Skills for design engineers
en.what: A UI skill-pack collection from well-known design engineer ibelick: routes your AI coding agent through the right UI skill workflow per task — run npx ui-skills start and the agent picks the appropriate skill set.
en.content: Six skills under skills/: baseline-ui, improve-ui, fixing-accessibility, fixing-metadata, fixing-motion-performance and ui-skills-root; plus bin/ (the CLI entry) and the companion site (Astro on Cloudflare Workers).
en.stack: TypeScript, CLI distributed via npx, MIT; created January 2026, site at ui-skills.com.
en.hot: The idea of packaging design judgment as reusable skills for AI agents is easy for design engineers to understand and immediately test.
uses: Frontend developers — let agents generate and improve UI to design standards, no more 'works but ugly'
Design engineers — automate accessibility, metadata and motion-performance checks
Indie hackers — a taste safety net when you cover both dev and design

zh.tag: 你的「AI 团队总管」：把一堆 agent 组织起来 7×24 干活
zh.what: 定位「Chief Agent Operator」：把多个 AI agent 当工作单元统一招聘、调度和汇报。核心功能包括 Agent Builder（描述需求即可自动配置出可用 agent）、Agent Groups（多 agent 并行协作）、Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace 协作面板，以及白盒可编辑的 Personal Memory；支持接入任意模型和模态，号称 10000+ skills 和 MCP 插件生态。
zh.content: 可自部署的 Web 应用（Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos 一键部署），仓库含完整中英文档、Changelog、插件体系和本地开发指南；默认分支 canary，今天仍在高频 push。
zh.stack: TypeScript + Next.js 系 Web 应用，Docker 自托管，插件走 MCP 协议；许可证为自定义（非标准）。
zh.hot: 多 Agent 调度与即时通信网关的组合，让这一成熟 AI 应用平台形成了明确的协作化方向。
uses: 一人公司 / 自由职业者 —— 组建 7×24 自动干活的 agent 团队处理重复工作
运营团队 —— 定时调度 agent 做日报、巡检、内容分发
进阶玩家 —— 用 Personal Memory 和 10000+ skills 定制专属助手

en.tag: Your 'Chief Agent Operator' — an AI team working 7×24
en.what: Positioned as a 'Chief Agent Operator': hire, schedule and hear reports from multiple AI agents as work units. Key features: Agent Builder (describe the need, get a configured agent), Agent Groups (parallel multi-agent collaboration), Pages/Schedule/Project/Workspace panels, and a white-box editable Personal Memory; any model and modality, with a claimed 10,000+ skills and MCP plugin ecosystem.
en.content: A self-deployable web app (one-click Vercel/Docker/Zeabur/Sealos), with full bilingual docs, a changelog, the plugin system and local dev guides; default branch canary, still pushing frequently today.
en.stack: TypeScript + Next.js, self-hosted via Docker, plugins over MCP; custom (non-standard) license.
en.hot: Its combination of multi-agent orchestration and messaging gateways gives an established AI application platform a clear collaboration-focused direction.
uses: Solo founders & freelancers — run a 7×24 agent team for repetitive work
Ops teams — schedule agents for daily reports, patrols and content distribution
Power users — craft custom assistants with Personal Memory and 10,000+ skills

zh.tag: 终端里的编程 agent，专为便宜小模型优化
zh.what: 跑在终端里的 AI 编程助手（OpenAI Codex 的 fork），核心思路「换 harness 不换模型」：内置 claude-code、kimi-cli、qwen-code、deepseek-tui 等多种 agent 运行框架，让低成本开源模型也打出好表现。自带 QA 技能，可驱动真实浏览器或原生 App 做界面测试，支持 macOS/Linux/Windows 原生沙箱执行。
zh.content: 完整 Rust 工程：终端 TUI、文档站（openinterpreter.com/docs）、安装脚本；配置与会话存本地 ~/.openinterpreter，支持 /model 切模型、/harness 切框架、MCP、hooks、AGENTS.md。
zh.stack: Rust（2023 年创建的老牌项目，刚从 Python 重写），Apache-2.0；支持 ACP 协议接入编辑器，可接多家模型 provider。
zh.hot: Rust 重写与「低成本模型运行框架」定位，正好契合开发者对更高效编程 Agent 基础设施的需求。
uses: 预算有限的开发者 —— 用 DeepSeek / Qwen 等便宜模型跑编程 agent，成本降一个量级
多工具用户 —— 一套终端切换 claude-code、kimi-cli 等不同框架
QA 团队 —— 让 agent 驱动真实浏览器做界面自动化测试

en.tag: A coding agent in your terminal, tuned for low-cost models
en.what: An AI coding assistant in your terminal (a fork of OpenAI Codex) built on the idea of 'swap the harness, not the model': it bundles multiple agent runtimes — claude-code, kimi-cli, qwen-code, deepseek-tui — so cheap open models still perform well. It ships a QA skill that drives real browsers or native apps for UI testing, with native sandboxing on macOS/Linux/Windows.
en.content: A full Rust project: the terminal TUI, a docs site (openinterpreter.com/docs) and install scripts; config and sessions live in ~/.openinterpreter, with /model to switch models, /harness to switch runtimes, plus MCP, hooks and AGENTS.md support.
en.stack: Rust (a 2023 veteran, freshly rewritten from Python), Apache-2.0; supports ACP (Agent Client Protocol) for editors and multiple model providers.
en.hot: The Rust rewrite and focus on serving as a harness for lower-cost models align with demand for efficient coding-agent infrastructure.
uses: Budget-conscious devs — run coding agents on cheap models like DeepSeek / Qwen, an order of magnitude cheaper
Multi-tool users — swap between claude-code, kimi-cli and other harnesses in one terminal
QA teams — let agents drive real browsers for UI automation testing
